sqls.sql_annotated:
-- 修订 20260723_150836：死亡=DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION2='3'；年度区间 [2022-01-01, 2025-01-01)；列=N；写入=0
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM ORDADM.ORDERS o
        WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND o.ENTER_DATE_TIME >= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
          AND o.ENTER_DATE_TIME <= v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME
          AND o.ORDER_STATUS <> '4'
          AND (o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%CT肺动脉造影%' OR o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%肺动脉血管成像%' OR o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%肺动脉成像%' OR o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%CTPA%' OR o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%肺通气/灌注%' OR o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%V/Q%' OR o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%磁共振肺动脉造影%' OR o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%MRPA%' OR o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%肺动脉造影%' OR o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%DSA%')
    ) THEN v.PATIENT_ID||'-'||TO_CHAR(v.VISIT_ID) END) AS 分子
FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN COMM.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('呼吸内科','呼吸内科一','呼吸与危重症医学科一','呼吸与危重症医学科二','呼吸与危重症医学科三','PCCM[Ⅰ-Ⅱ部]','PCCM[Ⅴ-Ⅵ部]','PCCM VII','呼吸内科二','PCCM[Ⅲ-Ⅳ部]','PCCM Ⅷ','RICU','PCCM','呼吸内科三','PCCM[Ⅶ-Ⅷ部]','PCCM[Ⅸ-Ⅹ部][RICU]')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND (dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'I26%'
           OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺栓塞%'
           OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺血栓栓塞%'
           OR UPPER(dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC) LIKE '%PTE%')
)
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy')
ORDER BY 年份

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('呼吸内科','呼吸内科一','呼吸与危重症医学科一','呼吸与危重症医学科二','呼吸与危重症医学科三','PCCM[Ⅰ-Ⅱ部]','PCCM[Ⅴ-Ⅵ部]','PCCM VII','呼吸内科二','PCCM[Ⅲ-Ⅳ部]','PCCM Ⅷ','RICU','PCCM','呼吸内科三','PCCM[Ⅶ-Ⅷ部]','PCCM[Ⅸ-Ⅹ部][RICU]')
  AND EXISTS (

      AND (dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'I26%'

    )

FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') 年份,pmi.INP_NO 住院号,v.PATIENT_ID 患者ID,
 pmi.NAME 姓名,v.VISIT_ID 住院次数,
 (SELECT d.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS d WHERE d.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND d.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND d.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) 出院主要诊断编码,
 (SELECT d.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS d WHERE d.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND d.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND d.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) 诊断名称,
 (SELECT o.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) 第一位手术编码,

 adm.DEPT_NAME 入院科室,dd.DEPT_NAME 出院科室,v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME 入院时间,v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME 出院时间,

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO=pmi.INP_NO AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc ON doc.UHID=dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK,0)=0 
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c ON c.UHID=doc.UHID AND c.段落编号=doc.ID

 (SELECT o.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1),
 adm.DEPT_NAME,dd.DEPT_NAME,v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME,v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,
 'JHEMR',idx.TOPIC,idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID),DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT,2000,1)

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME>=DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME<DATE '2026-01-01'
 AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('呼吸内科','呼吸内科一','呼吸与危重症医学科一','呼吸与危重症医学科二','呼吸与危重症医学科三','PCCM[Ⅰ-Ⅱ部]','PCCM[Ⅴ-Ⅵ部]','PCCM VII','呼吸内科二','PCCM[Ⅲ-Ⅳ部]','PCCM Ⅷ','RICU','PCCM','呼吸内科三','PCCM[Ⅶ-Ⅷ部]','PCCM[Ⅸ-Ⅹ部][RICU]') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID

sqls.sql_annotated:
-- 修订 20260723_150836：死亡=DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION2='3'；年度区间 [2025-01-01, 2026-01-01)；列=P；写入=0
-- RES-CAP-01 病历正文分子，MTL与JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL
SELECT 年份,COUNT(DISTINCT 患者ID||'-'||TO_CHAR(住院次数)) 分子
FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') 年份,pmi.INP_NO 住院号,v.PATIENT_ID 患者ID,
 pmi.NAME 姓名,v.VISIT_ID 住院次数,
 (SELECT d.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS d WHERE d.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND d.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND d.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) 出院主要诊断编码,
 (SELECT d.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS d WHERE d.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND d.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND d.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) 诊断名称,
 (SELECT o.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) 第一位手术编码,
 (SELECT o.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) 第一位手术名称,
 adm.DEPT_NAME 入院科室,dd.DEPT_NAME 出院科室,v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME 入院时间,v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME 出院时间,
 'MTL' 文书系统,doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME 文书名称,doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE 文书时间,
 dix.UHID||'-'||TO_CHAR(doc.ID) 文书唯一标识,DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容,2000,1) 文书内容
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT adm ON adm.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO=pmi.INP_NO AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc ON doc.UHID=dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK,0)=0 
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c ON c.UHID=doc.UHID AND c.段落编号=doc.ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME>=DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME<DATE '2026-01-01'
 AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('呼吸内科','呼吸内科一','呼吸与危重症医学科一','呼吸与危重症医学科二','呼吸与危重症医学科三','PCCM[Ⅰ-Ⅱ部]','PCCM[Ⅴ-Ⅵ部]','PCCM VII','呼吸内科二','PCCM[Ⅲ-Ⅳ部]','PCCM Ⅷ','RICU','PCCM','呼吸内科三','PCCM[Ⅶ-Ⅷ部]','PCCM[Ⅸ-Ⅹ部][RICU]') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
 AND (dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'J13%' OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'J14%' OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'J15%'

sqls.source_ref: 九、病案管理质量控制指标（2021 年版）.xlsx!Sheet1!R8C13
sqls.sql_annotated:
-- MER-TL-01 入院记录24小时内完成分子
-- MTL与JHEMR使用UNION ALL统一维护，外层按患者ID+住院次数去重。
-- 统计年份统一按HIS出院时间，不按文书创建时间归年。
SELECT
    x."年份",
    COUNT(*) "数量"
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        y."年份",
        y.PATIENT_ID,
        y.VISIT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT
            TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') "年份",
            v.PATIENT_ID,
            v.VISIT_ID
        FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
        JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
          ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX di
          ON di.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
         AND di.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
        JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT d
          ON d.UHID = di.UHID
        WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
          AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
          AND 1=1
          AND (d.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%' AND d.DOC_FINISH_DATE <= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME + 1)

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') "年份",
            v.PATIENT_ID,
            v.VISIT_ID
        FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
        JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX fi
          ON fi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
         AND fi.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
          AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
          AND 1=1
          AND NVL(fi.DELETE_FLAG, '0') = '0'
          AND (fi.MR_CLASS = 'EMR09.00.01' AND fi.CAPTION_DATE_TIME <= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME + 1)
    ) y
) x
GROUP BY x."年份"
ORDER BY x."年份"

SELECT

-- 统计粒度：患者ID+住院次数，一次住院一行
-- 文书：MTL与JHEMR入院记录、出院记录合并后，各取同次住院最新一份
WITH 基础患者 AS (
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    (SELECT pmi.INP_NO FROM HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
      WHERE pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    (SELECT pmi.NAME FROM HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
      WHERE pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
      WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT dd1.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT dd1
      WHERE dd1.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经外二科','神经外二科一','神经外二科二','神经外二科三')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'I61%'
    ))
),
文书合集 AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) LIKE '%出院记录%'
             THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END AS 文书类型,
        'MTL' AS 文书系统,
        NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM 基础患者 b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END AS 文书类型,
        'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
        idx.TOPIC AS 文书名称,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM 基础患者 b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
文书去重 AS (
    SELECT
        d.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类型
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST,
                     CASE d.文书系统 WHEN 'JHEMR' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
        ) AS 序号
    FROM 文书合集 d
)
SELECT
    b.*,
    ai.文书系统 AS 入院记录系统,
    ai.文书名称 AS 入院记录名称,
    ai.文书时间 AS 入院记录时间,
    ai.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dd.文书系统 AS 出院记录系统,
    dd.文书名称 AS 出院记录名称,
    dd.文书时间 AS 出院记录时间,
    dd.文书内容 AS 出院记录
FROM 基础患者 b
LEFT JOIN 文书去重 ai
  ON ai.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND ai.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND ai.文书类型 = '入院记录'
 AND ai.序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN 文书去重 dd
  ON dd.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dd.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dd.文书类型 = '出院记录'
 AND dd.序号 = 1
ORDER BY b.出院时间, b.患者ID, b.住院次数

-- 规则：出院时间2025；出院科室=神经外四科；按统计口径中文匹配，不扩ICD
-- 修订项：I61%→诊断描述含脑出血, MTL正文LEFT JOIN

SELECT

    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
      WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT dd1.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT dd1
      WHERE dd1.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经外四科')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%脑出血%'
    ))
  AND ((EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.EXAM_MASTER em
        JOIN HIS.EXAM_REPORT er ON er.EXAM_NO = em.EXAM_NO
        WHERE em.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND em.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND NVL(em.REPORT_DATE_TIME, em.EXAM_DATE_TIME) >= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
            AND NVL(em.REPORT_DATE_TIME, em.EXAM_DATE_TIME) <= v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME
          AND (UPPER(
              NVL(em.EXAM_CLASS,'') || NVL(em.EXAM_SUB_CLASS,'') ||
              NVL(er.EXAM_ITEMS,'') || NVL(er.EXAM_DIAG,'') || NVL(er.DESCRIPTION,'')
            ) LIKE UPPER('%颅脑CTA%') OR UPPER(
              NVL(em.EXAM_CLASS,'') || NVL(em.EXAM_SUB_CLASS,'') ||
              NVL(er.EXAM_ITEMS,'') || NVL(er.EXAM_DIAG,'') || NVL(er.DESCRIPTION,'')
            ) LIKE UPPER('%脑血管CTA%') OR UPPER(
              NVL(em.EXAM_CLASS,'') || NVL(em.EXAM_SUB_CLASS,'') ||
              NVL(er.EXAM_ITEMS,'') || NVL(er.EXAM_DIAG,'') || NVL(er.DESCRIPTION,'')
            ) LIKE UPPER('%CT血管造影%') OR UPPER(
              NVL(em.EXAM_CLASS,'') || NVL(em.EXAM_SUB_CLASS,'') ||
              NVL(er.EXAM_ITEMS,'') || NVL(er.EXAM_DIAG,'') || NVL(er.DESCRIPTION,'')
            ) LIKE UPPER('%CT血管成像%'))
    )))

),

WITH 基础患者 AS (
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,

    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad ON ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM

          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%脑出血%'
    ) AND EXISTS (

          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%高血压%'
    )))

        AND (o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%硝苯地平%'

     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc

     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) LIKE '%入院记录%'

    ai.文书名称 AS 入院记录名称,
    ai.文书时间 AS 入院记录时间,
    ai.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dd.文书系统 AS 出院记录系统,
    dd.文书名称 AS 出院记录名称,
    dd.文书时间 AS 出院记录时间,
    dd.文书内容 AS 出院记录

 AND ai.住院次数 = b.住院次数

 AND dd.序号 = 1
ORDER BY b.出院时间, b.患者ID, b.住院次数

WITH 基础患者 AS (
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,

      WHERE pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
      WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT dd1.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT dd1
      WHERE dd1.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经外二科','神经外二科一','神经外二科二','神经外二科三')
  AND ((EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'I63%'
    ) AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT pv0
            JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd0 ON dd0.DEPT_CODE = pv0.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
            WHERE pv0.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
              AND pv0.VISIT_ID < v.VISIT_ID
              AND dd0.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经外二科','神经外二科一','神经外二科二','神经外二科三')
        )))
  AND (((EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.EXAM_MASTER em
        JOIN HIS.EXAM_REPORT er ON er.EXAM_NO = em.EXAM_NO
        WHERE em.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND em.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND NVL(em.REPORT_DATE_TIME, em.EXAM_DATE_TIME) >= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
            AND NVL(em.REPORT_DATE_TIME, em.EXAM_DATE_TIME) <= v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME
          AND (UPPER(
              NVL(em.EXAM_CLASS,'') || NVL(em.EXAM_SUB_CLASS,'') ||
              NVL(er.EXAM_ITEMS,'') || NVL(er.EXAM_DIAG,'') || NVL(er.DESCRIPTION,'')
            ) LIKE UPPER('%颅脑CTA%') OR UPPER(
              NVL(em.EXAM_CLASS,'') || NVL(em.EXAM_SUB_CLASS,'') ||
              NVL(er.EXAM_ITEMS,'') || NVL(er.EXAM_DIAG,'') || NVL(er.DESCRIPTION,'')
            ) LIKE UPPER('%脑血管CTA%') OR UPPER(
              NVL(em.EXAM_CLASS,'') || NVL(em.EXAM_SUB_CLASS,'') ||
              NVL(er.EXAM_ITEMS,'') || NVL(er.EXAM_DIAG,'') || NVL(er.DESCRIPTION,'')
            ) LIKE UPPER('%颅脑MRA%') OR UPPER(

              NVL(er.EXAM_ITEMS,'') || NVL(er.EXAM_DIAG,'') || NVL(er.DESCRIPTION,'')
            ) LIKE UPPER('%脑血管MRA%'))
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.OPERATION op
        WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND op.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%脑血管造影%'
    ))))

-- ============================================================
-- （二）APACHEⅡ≥15 收治率 · 分子候选（人工筛选）
-- 病程记录含 APACHE（不区分大小写）；人工筛 ≥15 分
-- MTL + JHEMR 病程 UNION ALL
-- ============================================================
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    emo.文书系统,
    emo.文书名称,
    emo.文书时间,
    emo.文书唯一标识,
    emo.文书正文_前2000字
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
JOIN (
    SELECT
        mid.P_INPATIENT_NO AS INP_NO,
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS PAT_ID,
        mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES AS VISIT_TIMES,
        'MTL' AS 文书系统,
        NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE, mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
        NVL(mi.DOC_SIGN_DATE, mi.DOC_CREATE_DATE) AS 文书时间,
        mid.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(mi.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书正文_前2000字
    FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi
      ON mi.UHID = mid.UHID
     AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (
           mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%病程%'
        OR NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE, ' ') LIKE '%病程%'
     )
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc
      ON mc.UHID = mi.UHID
     AND mc.段落编号 = mi.ID
    WHERE NVL(mid.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
      AND (
            DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, 'APACHE') > 0
         OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, 'Apache') > 0
         OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, 'apache') > 0
         OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(UPPER(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容, 1500, 1)), 'APACHE') > 0
      )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS INP_NO,
        ji.PATIENT_ID AS PAT_ID,
        ji.VISIT_ID AS VISIT_TIMES,
        'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
        ji.TOPIC AS 文书名称,
        NVL(ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME, ji.CREATE_DATE_TIME) AS 文书时间,
        TO_CHAR(ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书正文_前2000字
    FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
    LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct
      ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE NVL(ji.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
      AND NVL(ji.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%病程%'
      AND ct.MR_CONTENT IS NOT NULL
      AND (
            DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, 'APACHE') > 0
         OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, 'Apache') > 0
         OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, 'apache') > 0
         OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(UPPER(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, 1500, 1)), 'APACHE') > 0
      )
) emo
  ON (
        (emo.INP_NO IS NOT NULL AND emo.INP_NO = pmi.INP_NO AND emo.VISIT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID)
     OR (emo.PAT_ID IS NOT NULL AND emo.PAT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND emo.VISIT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID)
     )
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND (
  v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('030210','030224')
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ADT_LOG a
    WHERE a.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND a.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND a.DEPT_CODE IN ('030210','030224')
  )
)
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, v.PATIENT_ID, v.VISIT_ID, emo.文书系统

-- 03 感染性休克bundle 分母 | 诊断含感染性休克/脓毒性休克 | 分子=手工 | 新发排除=用户跳过自动 | 写入=0
SELECT 
TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
(SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
(SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
(SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
(SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND 
(
  v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('030210','030224')
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ADT_LOG a
    WHERE a.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND a.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND a.DEPT_CODE IN ('030210','030224')
  )
)

  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
    WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
      AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%感染性休克%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%脓毒性休克%')
  )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

SELECT

  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,

  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,

  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,

  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND (
    v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('030210','030224')
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ADT_LOG a
      WHERE a.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND a.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND a.DEPT_CODE IN ('030210','030224')

        OR o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%那屈肝素%'
        OR o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%磺达肝癸%'
      )
  )

-- （八）ICU镇静评估率分子：护理记录单I评分 + MTL/JHEMR病程关键词
-- Oracle 11g；只读查询；按 PATIENT_ID + VISIT_ID 保留一行；写入=0
-- 口径：三类来源任一命中即计入分子，同时输出来源标志用于复核。
WITH icu_visits AS (
  SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO,
    v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
  FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
  JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
    ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
  WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND (
      v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('030210', '030224')
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.ADT_LOG a
        WHERE a.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND a.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND a.DEPT_CODE IN ('030210', '030224')
      )
    )
),
source_flags AS (
  SELECT
    b.*,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM YDHL.INPATIENTS i
      JOIN YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM f
        ON f.PATIENT_UID = i.PAT_INDEX_NO
      WHERE i.MRN = b.住院号
        AND i.SERIES = b.住院次数
        AND f.TEMPLATE_CODE IN (751, 771)
        AND NVL(f.IS_VALID, '1') = '1'
        AND f.FORM_TIME >= b.入院时间
        AND f.FORM_TIME <  b.出院时间 + 1
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM_RECORDS r
          WHERE r.FORM_ID = f.ID
            AND r.NODE_CODE  in ( '00038','00037')
            AND r.NUMBER_VALUE IS NOT NULL
        )
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS 护理评分命中,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
      JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi
        ON mi.UHID = mid.UHID
       AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
      JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc
        ON mc.UHID = mi.UHID
       AND mc.段落编号 = mi.ID
      WHERE mid.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
        AND mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
        AND NVL(mid.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
        AND mid.P_OUTDATE >= DATE '2022-01-01'
        AND mid.P_OUTDATE <  DATE '2026-01-01'
        AND (INSTR(NVL(mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME, ''), '病程') > 0
             OR INSTR(NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE, ''), '病程') > 0)
        AND (
          INSTR(mc.段落内容, '镇痛镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(mc.段落内容, '镇痛、镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(mc.段落内容, '镇痛与镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(mc.段落内容, '镇痛/镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(mc.段落内容, '镇痛及镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(UPPER(mc.段落内容), 'RASS') > 0
          OR INSTR(UPPER(mc.段落内容), 'RAMSAY') > 0
          OR INSTR(mc.段落内容, '镇静评分') > 0
          OR INSTR(mc.段落内容, '镇静评估') > 0
        )
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MTL病程命中,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
      JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct
        ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
      WHERE ji.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
        AND ji.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
        AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
        AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
        AND (INSTR(NVL(ji.MR_CLASS, ''), 'EMR10.00.0') > 0
             OR INSTR(NVL(ji.TOPIC, ''), '病程') > 0)
        AND (
          INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇痛镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇痛、镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇痛') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇痛与镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇痛/镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇痛及镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(UPPER(ct.MR_CONTENT), 'RASS') > 0
          OR INSTR(UPPER(ct.MR_CONTENT), 'RAMSAY') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇静评分') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇静评估') > 0
        )
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS JHEMR病程命中
  FROM icu_visits b
)
SELECT
  s.年份,
  s.住院号,
  s.患者ID,
  s.姓名,
  s.住院次数,
  (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
   FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
   WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
     AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
     AND ds.PATIENT_ID = s.患者ID
     AND ds.VISIT_ID = s.住院次数
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
  (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
   FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
   WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
     AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
     AND ds.PATIENT_ID = s.患者ID
     AND ds.VISIT_ID = s.住院次数
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
  (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE
   FROM HIS.OPERATION op
   WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = s.患者ID
     AND op.VISIT_ID = s.住院次数
     AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
  (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC
   FROM HIS.OPERATION op
   WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = s.患者ID
     AND op.VISIT_ID = s.住院次数
     AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
  (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d
   WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = s.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
  (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d
   WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = s.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
  s.入院时间,
  s.出院时间,
  s.护理评分命中,
  s.MTL病程命中,
  s.JHEMR病程命中,
  1 AS 镇静评估分子
FROM source_flags s
WHERE s.护理评分命中 = 1
   OR s.MTL病程命中 = 1

sqls.sql_executable:
WITH icu_visits AS (
  SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO,
    v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
  FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
  JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
    ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
  WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND (
      v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('030210', '030224')
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.ADT_LOG a
        WHERE a.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND a.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND a.DEPT_CODE IN ('030210', '030224')
      )
    )
),
source_flags AS (
  SELECT
    b.*,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM YDHL.INPATIENTS i
      JOIN YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM f
        ON f.PATIENT_UID = i.PAT_INDEX_NO
      WHERE i.MRN = b.住院号
        AND i.SERIES = b.住院次数
        AND f.TEMPLATE_CODE IN (751, 771)
        AND NVL(f.IS_VALID, '1') = '1'
        AND f.FORM_TIME >= b.入院时间
        AND f.FORM_TIME <  b.出院时间 + 1
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM_RECORDS r
          WHERE r.FORM_ID = f.ID
            AND r.NODE_CODE  in ( '00038','00037')
            AND r.NUMBER_VALUE IS NOT NULL
        )
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS 护理评分命中,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
      JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi
        ON mi.UHID = mid.UHID
       AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
      JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc
        ON mc.UHID = mi.UHID
       AND mc.段落编号 = mi.ID
      WHERE mid.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
        AND mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
        AND NVL(mid.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
        AND mid.P_OUTDATE >= DATE '2022-01-01'
        AND mid.P_OUTDATE <  DATE '2026-01-01'
        AND (INSTR(NVL(mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME, ''), '病程') > 0
             OR INSTR(NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE, ''), '病程') > 0)
        AND (
          INSTR(mc.段落内容, '镇痛镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(mc.段落内容, '镇痛、镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(mc.段落内容, '镇痛与镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(mc.段落内容, '镇痛/镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(mc.段落内容, '镇痛及镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(UPPER(mc.段落内容), 'RASS') > 0
          OR INSTR(UPPER(mc.段落内容), 'RAMSAY') > 0
          OR INSTR(mc.段落内容, '镇静评分') > 0
          OR INSTR(mc.段落内容, '镇静评估') > 0
        )
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MTL病程命中,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
      JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct
        ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
      WHERE ji.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
        AND ji.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
        AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
        AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
        AND (INSTR(NVL(ji.MR_CLASS, ''), 'EMR10.00.0') > 0
             OR INSTR(NVL(ji.TOPIC, ''), '病程') > 0)
        AND (
          INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇痛镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇痛、镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇痛') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇痛与镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇痛/镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇痛及镇静') > 0
          OR INSTR(UPPER(ct.MR_CONTENT), 'RASS') > 0
          OR INSTR(UPPER(ct.MR_CONTENT), 'RAMSAY') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇静评分') > 0
          OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '镇静评估') > 0
        )
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS JHEMR病程命中
  FROM icu_visits b
)
SELECT
  s.年份,
  s.住院号,
  s.患者ID,
  s.姓名,
  s.住院次数,
  (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
   FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
   WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
     AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
     AND ds.PATIENT_ID = s.患者ID
     AND ds.VISIT_ID = s.住院次数
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
  (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
   FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
   WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
     AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
     AND ds.PATIENT_ID = s.患者ID
     AND ds.VISIT_ID = s.住院次数
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
  (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE
   FROM HIS.OPERATION op
   WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = s.患者ID
     AND op.VISIT_ID = s.住院次数
     AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
  (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC
   FROM HIS.OPERATION op
   WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = s.患者ID
     AND op.VISIT_ID = s.住院次数
     AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
  (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d
   WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = s.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
  (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d
   WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = s.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
  s.入院时间,
  s.出院时间,
  s.护理评分命中,
  s.MTL病程命中,
  s.JHEMR病程命中,
  1 AS 镇静评估分子
FROM source_flags s
WHERE s.护理评分命中 = 1
   OR s.MTL病程命中 = 1
   OR s.JHEMR病程命中 = 1
ORDER BY s.出院时间, s.患者ID, s.住院次数

-- ============================================================
-- （十二）非计划转入 ICU 率 · 分子 2025
-- 口径：手术后回原科室已下医嘱，后转入我科
-- 规则：有手术 + 回原科室医嘱(开立科室=手术科室或文本含科室名, 时间>手术)
--       + 转入ICU医嘱时间 > 回原科室医嘱时间
-- ============================================================
WITH

OP_FIRST AS (
    SELECT o.PATIENT_ID, o.VISIT_ID, MIN(o.OPERATING_DATE) AS FIRST_OP_TIME
    FROM HIS.OPERATION o
    WHERE o.OPERATING_DATE IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY o.PATIENT_ID, o.VISIT_ID
),
OP_DEPT AS (
    SELECT
        s.PATIENT_ID,
        s.VISIT_ID,
        s.FIRST_OP_TIME,
        NVL(
            (
                SELECT MAX(a.DEPT_CODE)
                FROM HIS.ADT_LOG a
                WHERE a.PATIENT_ID = s.PATIENT_ID
                  AND a.VISIT_ID = s.VISIT_ID
                  AND a.DEPT_CODE NOT IN ('030210','030224')
                  AND a.LOG_DATE_TIME = (
                        SELECT MAX(a2.LOG_DATE_TIME)
                        FROM HIS.ADT_LOG a2
                        WHERE a2.PATIENT_ID = s.PATIENT_ID
                          AND a2.VISIT_ID = s.VISIT_ID
                          AND a2.LOG_DATE_TIME <= s.FIRST_OP_TIME
                          AND a2.DEPT_CODE NOT IN ('030210','030224')
                  )
            ),
            CASE WHEN v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO NOT IN ('030210','030224') THEN v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO ELSE v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM END
        ) AS OP_DEPT_CODE
    FROM OP_FIRST s
    JOIN HIS.PAT_VISIT v ON v.PATIENT_ID = s.PATIENT_ID AND v.VISIT_ID = s.VISIT_ID
),
TO_ICU AS (
    SELECT
        oo.PATIENT_ID,
        oo.VISIT_ID,
        MIN(NVL(oo.ENTER_DATE_TIME, oo.START_DATE_TIME)) AS FIRST_TO_ICU_TIME
    FROM HIS.ORDERS oo
    WHERE NVL(oo.ORDER_STATUS, '1') <> '4'
      AND (
           oo.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%转入重症医学科%'
        OR oo.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%转重症医学科%'
        OR oo.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%转ICU%'
        OR oo.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%转入ICU%'
      )
    GROUP BY oo.PATIENT_ID, oo.VISIT_ID
),
BACK_HOME AS (
    SELECT
        r.PATIENT_ID,
        r.VISIT_ID,
        MIN(NVL(r.ENTER_DATE_TIME, r.START_DATE_TIME)) AS FIRST_BACK_TIME
    FROM HIS.ORDERS r
    JOIN OP_DEPT sk
      ON sk.PATIENT_ID = r.PATIENT_ID
     AND sk.VISIT_ID = r.VISIT_ID
    JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT sd ON sd.DEPT_CODE = sk.OP_DEPT_CODE
    WHERE NVL(r.ORDER_STATUS, '1') <> '4'
      AND NVL(r.ENTER_DATE_TIME, r.START_DATE_TIME) > sk.FIRST_OP_TIME
      AND (
            r.ORDERING_DEPT = sk.OP_DEPT_CODE
         OR r.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%' || sd.DEPT_NAME || '%'
      )
      AND (r.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%转%' OR r.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%回%')
      AND r.ORDER_TEXT NOT LIKE '%重症%'
      AND r.ORDER_TEXT NOT LIKE '%ICU%'
      AND r.ORDER_TEXT NOT LIKE '%转入重症%'
      AND r.ORDER_TEXT NOT LIKE '%转重症%'
    GROUP BY r.PATIENT_ID, r.VISIT_ID
)

SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    sk.FIRST_OP_TIME AS 首次手术时间,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = sk.OP_DEPT_CODE) AS 手术科室,
    hb.FIRST_BACK_TIME AS 首次回原科室医嘱时间,
    ti.FIRST_TO_ICU_TIME AS 首次转入ICU医嘱时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
JOIN OP_DEPT sk ON sk.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND sk.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
JOIN BACK_HOME hb ON hb.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND hb.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
JOIN TO_ICU ti ON ti.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ti.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND hb.FIRST_BACK_TIME > sk.FIRST_OP_TIME
  AND ti.FIRST_TO_ICU_TIME > hb.FIRST_BACK_TIME
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

WITH

OP_FIRST AS (
    SELECT o.PATIENT_ID, o.VISIT_ID, MIN(o.OPERATING_DATE) AS FIRST_OP_TIME
    FROM HIS.OPERATION o
    WHERE o.OPERATING_DATE IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY o.PATIENT_ID, o.VISIT_ID
),
OP_DEPT AS (
    SELECT
        s.PATIENT_ID,
        s.VISIT_ID,
        s.FIRST_OP_TIME,
        NVL(
            (
                SELECT MAX(a.DEPT_CODE)
                FROM HIS.ADT_LOG a
                WHERE a.PATIENT_ID = s.PATIENT_ID
                  AND a.VISIT_ID = s.VISIT_ID
                  AND a.DEPT_CODE NOT IN ('030210','030224')
                  AND a.LOG_DATE_TIME = (
                        SELECT MAX(a2.LOG_DATE_TIME)
                        FROM HIS.ADT_LOG a2
                        WHERE a2.PATIENT_ID = s.PATIENT_ID
                          AND a2.VISIT_ID = s.VISIT_ID
                          AND a2.LOG_DATE_TIME <= s.FIRST_OP_TIME
                          AND a2.DEPT_CODE NOT IN ('030210','030224')
                  )
            ),
            CASE WHEN v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO NOT IN ('030210','030224') THEN v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO ELSE v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM END
        ) AS OP_DEPT_CODE
    FROM OP_FIRST s
    JOIN HIS.PAT_VISIT v ON v.PATIENT_ID = s.PATIENT_ID AND v.VISIT_ID = s.VISIT_ID
),
TO_ICU AS (
    SELECT
        oo.PATIENT_ID,
        oo.VISIT_ID,
        MIN(NVL(oo.ENTER_DATE_TIME, oo.START_DATE_TIME)) AS FIRST_TO_ICU_TIME
    FROM HIS.ORDERS oo
    WHERE NVL(oo.ORDER_STATUS, '1') <> '4'
      AND (
           oo.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%转入重症医学科%'
        OR oo.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%转重症医学科%'
        OR oo.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%转ICU%'
        OR oo.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%转入ICU%'
      )
    GROUP BY oo.PATIENT_ID, oo.VISIT_ID
),
BACK_HOME AS (
    SELECT
        r.PATIENT_ID,
        r.VISIT_ID,
        MIN(NVL(r.ENTER_DATE_TIME, r.START_DATE_TIME)) AS FIRST_BACK_TIME
    FROM HIS.ORDERS r
    JOIN OP_DEPT sk
      ON sk.PATIENT_ID = r.PATIENT_ID
     AND sk.VISIT_ID = r.VISIT_ID
    JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT sd ON sd.DEPT_CODE = sk.OP_DEPT_CODE
    WHERE NVL(r.ORDER_STATUS, '1') <> '4'
      AND NVL(r.ENTER_DATE_TIME, r.START_DATE_TIME) > sk.FIRST_OP_TIME
      AND (
            r.ORDERING_DEPT = sk.OP_DEPT_CODE
         OR r.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%' || sd.DEPT_NAME || '%'
      )
      AND (r.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%转%' OR r.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%回%')
      AND r.ORDER_TEXT NOT LIKE '%重症%'
      AND r.ORDER_TEXT NOT LIKE '%ICU%'
      AND r.ORDER_TEXT NOT LIKE '%转入重症%'
      AND r.ORDER_TEXT NOT LIKE '%转重症%'
    GROUP BY r.PATIENT_ID, r.VISIT_ID
)

,

  GROUP BY o.PATIENT_ID, o.VISIT_ID

-- 指标：NEU-EPI-01；部分：分母；负责科室：神经内二科
-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND ((EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G40%'
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    )))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND adm.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND adm.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC

          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID

            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,

           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,

LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND ((EXISTS (

        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID

doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,

    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(

        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID

 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1

        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'

        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE

            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID

        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')

doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d

 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,

    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,

    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,

        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
      WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1),

  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID

 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID

 AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%')
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
  ON content.UHID = doc.UHID

-- 指标：NEU-EPI-04；部分：分母；负责科室：神经内二科
-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND ((EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G40%'
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    )))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND adm.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND adm.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND ((EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G40%'
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    )))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND adm.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND adm.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

-- 指标：NEU-EPI-05；部分：分母；负责科室：神经内二科
-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND ((EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G40%'
    ) OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    )))
      AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.ORDERS od
        WHERE od.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND od.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND od.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL
          AND (od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%西酞普兰%' OR od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%氟哌噻吨美利曲辛%' OR od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%舍曲林%' OR od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%帕罗西汀%' OR od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%奥氮平%')
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

        b.患者ID,

        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND adm.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND adm.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)

      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)

    b.年份 AS 年份,

    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND adm.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND adm.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

-- 指标：NEU-EPI-12；部分：分母；负责科室：神经内二科
-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND adm.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND adm.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1
