        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',

    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm

 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

-- 指标：NEU-EPI-13；部分：分母；科室：神经内一科
-- 科室严格采用原表“科室范围”；按出院时间归年
-- 入院记录仅提取“主诉”；MTL与JHEMR并行期按既定规则UNION ALL
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
      WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1),
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%')
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
  ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内一科一','神经内一科二','神经内一科三','神经内一科四','神经内科医疗组','神经功能性疾病与感染免疫专业','老年病与发作性疾病专业','神经介入与认知障碍专业','帕金森病与头痛头晕专业','神经电生理专业','神经内科')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    ))
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
      WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
    idx.TOPIC AS 文书名称,
    idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间,
    TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1),
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%'
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
  ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内一科一','神经内一科二','神经内一科三','神经内一科四','神经内科医疗组','神经功能性疾病与感染免疫专业','老年病与发作性疾病专业','神经介入与认知障碍专业','帕金森病与头痛头晕专业','神经电生理专业','神经内科')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    ))
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01'

-- 指标：NEU-EPI-13；部分：分子；负责科室：神经内二科
-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    ))
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.ORDERS od
        WHERE od.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND od.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND od.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL
          AND (od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%丙泊酚%' OR od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%咪达唑仑%')
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,

-- 指标：NEU-EPI-14；部分：分子；负责科室：神经内二科
-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    ))
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.ORDERS od
        WHERE od.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND od.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND od.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL
          AND (od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%气管插管%' OR od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%呼吸机辅助呼吸%' OR od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%机械通气%')
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND adm.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND adm.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

-- 入院记录仅提取“主诉”；MTL与JHEMR并行期按既定规则UNION ALL
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
      WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1),
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%')
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
  ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID

-- 指标：NEU-EPI-15；部分：分子；负责科室：神经内二科
-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    ))
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.ORDERS od
        WHERE od.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND od.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND od.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL
          AND od.ENTER_DATE_TIME < v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME + 24/24
          AND (od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%脑电图%' OR od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%动态脑电图%' OR od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%视频脑电图%')
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,

        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,

    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,

FROM base_cohort b

 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

-- 入院记录仅提取“主诉”；MTL与JHEMR并行期按既定规则UNION ALL
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
      WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1),
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%')
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
  ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID

  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'

-- 指标：NEU-EPI-17；部分：分子；负责科室：神经内二科
-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    ))
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.ORDERS od
        WHERE od.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND od.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND od.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL
          AND od.ENTER_DATE_TIME < v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME + 72/24
          AND (od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%腰椎穿刺%')
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,

          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'

        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)

-- 指标：NEU-EPI-19；部分：分子；负责科室：神经内二科
-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    ))
  AND (v.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION = '3')
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND adm.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND adm.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

-- 指标：NEU-EPI-20；部分：分母；负责科室：神经内二科
-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'G41%'
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND adm.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND adm.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,

    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',

    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID

 AND adm.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数

-- 指标：NEU-STK-01；部分：分母；负责科室：神经内二科
-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'I63%'
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND adm.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND adm.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1

        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1

-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'I63%'
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND adm.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND adm.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'I63%'
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND adm.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND adm.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

-- 指标：NEU-STK-04；部分：分母；负责科室：神经内二科
-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'I63%'
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)

    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,

-- 入院记录仅提取“主诉”；MTL与JHEMR并行期按既定规则UNION ALL
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
      WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1),
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%')
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
  ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID

-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'I63%'
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)

    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(

        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',

LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm

 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1

        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC

-- 指标：NEU-STK-08；部分：分母；科室：神经内一科
-- 科室严格采用原表“科室范围”；按出院时间归年
-- 入院记录仅提取“主诉”；MTL与JHEMR并行期按既定规则UNION ALL
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
      WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1),
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%')
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
  ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内一科一','神经内一科二','神经内一科三','神经内一科四','神经内科医疗组','神经功能性疾病与感染免疫专业','老年病与发作性疾病专业','神经介入与认知障碍专业','帕金森病与头痛头晕专业','神经电生理专业','神经内科')

          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'I63%'
    ))
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01'
UNION ALL

        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC

WITH base_cohort AS (

            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1

        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC

            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME

          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,

LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
        WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
          AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'I63%'
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'

    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix

     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc

          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)

     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (

        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d

    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,

    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,

    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(

        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',

SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID

        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS od
        WHERE od.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND od.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND od.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL
