-- 指标：NEU-DSA-06；部分：分母；负责科室：神经内二科
-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.OPERATION op
        WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND (op.OPERATION_CODE LIKE '88.4100%' OR op.OPERATION_CODE LIKE '88.4101%' OR op.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%脑血管造影%')
    ))
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d

    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,

    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,

    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        adm.文书内容,
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs adm
  ON adm.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND adm.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND adm.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND adm.文书序号 = 1
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs dis
  ON dis.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND dis.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND dis.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND dis.文书序号 = 1

-- 科室严格采用原表“科室范围”；按出院时间归年
-- 入院记录仅提取“主诉”；MTL与JHEMR并行期按既定规则UNION ALL
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
      WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1),
        '主[[:blank:]　]*诉[[:blank:]　]*[：:]?[[:blank:]　]*([^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']+)',
        1, 1, NULL, 1
    ) AS 主诉
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%')
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
  ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内一科一','神经内一科二','神经内一科三','神经内一科四','神经内科医疗组','神经功能性疾病与感染免疫专业','老年病与发作性疾病专业','神经介入与认知障碍专业','帕金森病与头痛头晕专业','神经电生理专业','神经内科')
  AND (EXISTS (

    ))
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01'
UNION ALL

-- 指标：NEU-DSA-07；部分：分子；负责科室：神经内二科
-- 每行唯一粒度：患者ID+住院次数；同类文书按文书时间倒序取第一份
-- MTL/JHEMR按确认区间UNION ALL；入院记录、出院记录正文安全截取2000字符
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
        pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
        pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
           FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
          WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
            AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
           FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
          WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
            AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
            AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME
           FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
          WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
            AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 入院科室,
        dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('神经内二科一','神经内二科二','神经内科二','神经康复科','神经内二科三','神经内二科四')
  AND (EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM HIS.OPERATION op
        WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
          AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
          AND (op.OPERATION_CODE LIKE '88.4100%' OR op.OPERATION_CODE LIKE '88.4101%' OR op.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%脑血管造影%')
    ))
  AND (v.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION = '3')
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
                THEN '出院记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
     AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
          OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
     AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID,
        b.住院次数,
        CASE WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录' ELSE '入院记录' END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID
     AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%' OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT
        d.患者ID,
        d.住院次数,
        d.文书类别,
        d.文书内容,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
            ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份,
    b.住院号 AS 住院号,
    b.患者ID AS 患者ID,
    b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数,
    b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称,
    b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称,
    b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室,
    b.入院时间 AS 入院时间,
    b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    adm.文书内容 AS 入院记录,
    dis.文书内容 AS 出院记录,

-- 颜色=黑 年份=[2025]
-- 行=45
-- 五源核查修订:文书/首页/离院/费用/医嘱时间窗
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK,0)=0 AND ((doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE,' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'))
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c ON c.UHID=doc.UHID AND c.段落编号=doc.ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('冠心病介入治疗科二','冠心病介入治疗科三','心内三科一','心内三科二') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC IN ('急性心肌梗死','急性ST段抬高型心肌梗死'))
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '阿司匹林') > 0)
UNION ALL
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND idx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG,0)=0 AND ((NVL(idx.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院记录%' OR NVL(idx.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院记满%' OR NVL(idx.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'))
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('冠心病介入治疗科二','冠心病介入治疗科三','心内三科一','心内三科二') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC IN ('急性心肌梗死','急性ST段抬高型心肌梗死'))
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, '阿司匹林') > 0)

       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('结构性心脏病科') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%急性ST段抬高型心肌梗死%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%急性ST段抬高型心肌梗死%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%ST段抬高型心肌梗死%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%ST抬高型心肌梗死%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%STEMI%'))

-- 行=75 pattern=den_dx_num_eq 诊断分母/分子
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

-- 五源核查修订:文书/首页/离院/费用/医嘱时间窗
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,

       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,

           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK,0)=0 AND ((doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE,' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'))
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c ON c.UHID=doc.UHID AND c.段落编号=doc.ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('冠心病介入科','冠心病介入治疗科一') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%心房颤动%'))
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '沙班') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '华法林') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '达比加群') > 0)

         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx

-- 行=116 pattern=den_dx_num_order 诊断+医嘱
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('冠心病介入科','冠心病介入治疗科一') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%心力衰竭%')) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL AND o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%心脏+心功能测定彩超%')))

-- 颜色=红 年份=[2022, 2023, 2024, 2025] 科室=['冠心病介入科', '冠心病介入治疗科一']
-- 行=121 pattern=den_dx_num_order 诊断+医嘱
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('冠心病介入科','冠心病介入治疗科一') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%布美他尼%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%螺内酯%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%心力衰竭%')) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL AND o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%噻米%')))

-- 颜色=红 年份=[2022, 2023, 2024, 2025] 科室=['心内科', '高血压', '心衰疾病科', '高血压、心衰疾病科', '高血压心衰疾病科']
-- 行=125 pattern=den_dx_num_order 诊断分母/分子
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('心内科','高血压','心衰疾病科','高血压、心衰疾病科','高血压心衰疾病科') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%布美他尼%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%螺内酯%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%心力衰竭%'))

       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,

       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,

       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,

       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc

JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c ON c.UHID=doc.UHID AND c.段落编号=doc.ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('冠心病介入科','冠心病介入治疗科一') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%心力衰竭%'))
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '普利') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '沙坦') > 0)
UNION ALL

           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND idx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG,0)=0 AND ((NVL(idx.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院记录%' OR NVL(idx.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院记满%' OR NVL(idx.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'))
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('冠心病介入科','冠心病介入治疗科一') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%心力衰竭%'))
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, '普利') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, '沙坦') > 0)

-- 颜色=红 年份=[2022, 2023, 2024, 2025] 科室=['心内科二', '心律失常科']
-- 行=149 pattern=den_dx_num_death 诊断分母/分子
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('心内科二','心律失常科') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%心力衰竭%'))

        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) 诊断名称,
    (SELECT OPERATION_CODE FROM his.OPERATION OP

-- 冠心病介入治疗科三 CVD-HT-01 分子
-- 颜色=红 年份=[2022, 2023, 2024, 2025] 科室=['冠心病介入治疗科二', '冠心病介入治疗科三', '心内三科一', '心内三科二']
-- 行=168 pattern=den_dx_num_order 诊断+医嘱
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('冠心病介入治疗科二','冠心病介入治疗科三','心内三科一','心内三科二') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%高血压%')) AND ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL AND o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%动态血压%')))

-- 行=177 pattern=den_dx_num_order 醛固酮+卡托普利
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       -- MTL：按住院号和住院次数取得出院记录正文
       (SELECT MAX(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容, 2000, 1))
          FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mx
          JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT md
            ON md.UHID = mx.UHID
           AND NVL(md.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
          JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc
            ON mc.UHID = md.UHID
           AND mc.段落编号 = md.ID
         WHERE mx.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
           AND mx.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
           AND NVL(mx.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
           AND (md.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
             OR md.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
           AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01') AS MTL出院记录,
       -- JHEMR：按患者ID和住院次数取得出院记录正文
       (SELECT MAX(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(jc.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1))
          FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
          JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT jc
            ON jc.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
         WHERE ji.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
           AND ji.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND NVL(ji.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
           AND ji.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%'
           AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01') AS JHEMR出院记录,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

-- 按出院时间归年，按该行科室范围过滤
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('冠心病介入科','冠心病介入治疗科一')
  -- 分母：任一病案首页出院诊断包含“原发性醛固酮增多症”
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
         WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
           AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
           AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%原发性醛固酮增多症%'
      )
  -- 分子：在完整分母基础上，存在符合名称要求的临时医嘱
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM HIS.ORDERS o
         WHERE o.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
           AND o.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND o.REPEAT_INDICATOR = 0
           AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL
           AND (o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%高血压五项%'
             OR o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%高血压七项%'
             OR o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%肾素%'
             OR o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%醛固酮%')
      )

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,

           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,

       (SELECT MAX(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容, 2000, 1))

          JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT md
            ON md.UHID = mx.UHID
           AND NVL(md.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
          JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc

JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

-- 心外科 CVD-CABG-02 分母
-- 颜色=红 年份=[2022, 2023, 2024, 2025]
-- 行=189
-- 五源核查修订:文书/首页/离院/费用/医嘱时间窗
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('心外重症医学科','心外科') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.OPERATION opx WHERE opx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND opx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND (opx.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%冠状动脉旁路移植%' OR opx.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%冠状动脉搭桥%'))

, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS 文书唯一标识
, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(2000)) AS 文书内容


FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,

           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,

         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,

       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK,0)=0 AND ((doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE,' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'))

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('心外重症医学科','心外科') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.OPERATION opx WHERE opx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND opx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND (opx.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%二尖瓣置换%' OR opx.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%二尖瓣成型%'))
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '华法林') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '利伐沙班') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '达比加群') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '阿哌沙班') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '抗凝') > 0)
UNION ALL

, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix

       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK,0)=0 AND ((((doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%病程%' OR NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE,' ') LIKE '%病程%') OR (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%手术记录%' OR NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE,' ') LIKE '%手术记录%'))) AND NVL(doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME,' ') NOT LIKE '%首次病程%' AND NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE,' ') NOT LIKE '%首次病程%')
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c ON c.UHID=doc.UHID AND c.段落编号=doc.ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('心内科','高血压','心衰疾病科','高血压、心衰疾病科','高血压心衰疾病科') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.OPERATION opx WHERE opx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND opx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND (opx.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%冠状动脉球囊扩张%'))
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '心脏压塞') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '室颤') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '室速') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '输血') > 0)
UNION ALL
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND idx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG,0)=0 AND ((((NVL(idx.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%病程%') OR (NVL(idx.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%手术记录%' OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME,' ') LIKE '%手术记录%'))) AND NVL(idx.TOPIC,' ') NOT LIKE '%首次病程%')
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('心内科','高血压','心衰疾病科','高血压、心衰疾病科','高血压心衰疾病科') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.OPERATION opx WHERE opx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND opx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND (opx.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%冠状动脉球囊扩张%'))
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, '心脏压塞') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, '室颤') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, '室速') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, '输血') > 0)

SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,

       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       -- MTL：按住院号和住院次数取得出院记录正文
       (SELECT MAX(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容, 2000, 1))
          FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mx
          JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT md
            ON md.UHID = mx.UHID
           AND NVL(md.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
          JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc
            ON mc.UHID = md.UHID
           AND mc.段落编号 = md.ID
         WHERE mx.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
           AND mx.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
           AND NVL(mx.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
           AND (md.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
             OR md.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
           AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01') AS MTL出院记录,
       -- JHEMR：按患者ID和住院次数取得出院记录正文
       (SELECT MAX(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(jc.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1))
          FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
          JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT jc
            ON jc.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
         WHERE ji.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
           AND ji.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND NVL(ji.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
           AND ji.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%'
           AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01') AS JHEMR出院记录,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

-- 结构性心脏病科 CVD-PCI-10 分子
-- 颜色=红 年份=[2022, 2023, 2024, 2025] 科室=['结构性心脏病科']
-- 行=405 pattern=den_op_num_order 手术+医嘱
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       -- MTL：按住院号和住院次数取得出院记录正文
       (SELECT MAX(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容, 2000, 1))
          FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mx
          JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT md
            ON md.UHID = mx.UHID
           AND NVL(md.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
          JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc
            ON mc.UHID = md.UHID
           AND mc.段落编号 = md.ID
         WHERE mx.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
           AND mx.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
           AND NVL(mx.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
           AND (md.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
             OR md.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
           AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01') AS MTL出院记录,
       -- JHEMR：按患者ID和住院次数取得出院记录正文
       (SELECT MAX(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(jc.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1))
          FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
          JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT jc
            ON jc.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
         WHERE ji.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
           AND ji.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND NVL(ji.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
           AND ji.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%'
           AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01') AS JHEMR出院记录,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

-- 按出院时间归年，按该行科室范围过滤
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('结构性心脏病科')
  -- 分母：病案首页手术名称包含“冠状动脉球囊扩张”
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM HIS.OPERATION opx
         WHERE opx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
           AND opx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND opx.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%冠状动脉球囊扩张%'
      )
  -- 分子：在完整分母基础上，临时医嘱满足任一双联抗血小板组合
  AND (
       (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.REPEAT_INDICATOR=0 AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL AND o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%阿司匹林%')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.REPEAT_INDICATOR=0 AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL AND o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%氯吡格雷%'))
    OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.REPEAT_INDICATOR=0 AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL AND o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%阿司匹林%')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.REPEAT_INDICATOR=0 AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL AND o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%替格瑞洛%'))
    OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.REPEAT_INDICATOR=0 AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL AND o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%吲哚布芬%')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.REPEAT_INDICATOR=0 AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL AND o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%氯吡格雷%'))
    OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.REPEAT_INDICATOR=0 AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL AND o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%吲哚布芬%')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.REPEAT_INDICATOR=0 AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL AND o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%替格瑞洛%'))
      )

sqls.sql_annotated:
SELECT
    x."年份",
    COUNT(*) "分母"
FROM (
    SELECT
        TO_CHAR(f.FORM_TIME, 'yyyy') "年份",
        f.PATIENT_UID,
        -- 同一患者同一自然年多次筛查，按用户确认采用最后一次。
        MAX(f.TOTAL_SCORE) KEEP (
            DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY f.FORM_TIME, f.ID
        ) "末次评分"
    FROM LUNA_MCS_SDSEY.MCS_DOC_FORM f
    WHERE f.FORM_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND f.FORM_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
      -- 仅采用本院正式NRS-2002模板。
      AND f.TEMPLATE_CODE IN ('616','766')
      AND NVL(f.IS_VALID, 1) = 1
    GROUP BY TO_CHAR(f.FORM_TIME, 'yyyy'), f.PATIENT_UID
) x
WHERE x."末次评分" >= 3
GROUP BY x."年份"
ORDER BY "年份"

sqls.sql_annotated:
-- 临床营养专业 NUT-P-03_num
-- 只读查询；结果字段使用中文；关键条件按工作簿统计口径。
SELECT DISTINCT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
        AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
        AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    iad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    ddp.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT iad ON iad.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ddp ON ddp.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
WHERE
    -- 全院住院指标按出院时间归年，不附加科室过滤。
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS d
        WHERE d.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND d.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND d.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%糖尿病%'
    )

    )

        WHERE od.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND od.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND od.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%偏瘫肢体综合训练%'
    )

-- 康复医学专业 REH-ADL-01 分母
-- 年份=[2022,2023,2024,2025]
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
        AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
        AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    iad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    ddp.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
-- 科室字典：按出院科室归属康复医学专业，入院科室仅作明细核查。
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ddp ON ddp.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT iad ON iad.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE
    -- 统计时间按出院时间，使用左闭右开区间。
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
    -- 科室范围严格采用工作簿“科室范围”列。
    AND ddp.DEPT_NAME IN ('康复医学科一','康复医学科二','康复医学科','康复医学一科','康复医学二科','康复医学四科','神经康复科','骨科中心北区')
    -- 以下为本指标分子/分母的诊断或医嘱条件。
    AND 1=1

-- 康复医学专业 REH-ADL-02 分母
-- 年份=[2022,2023,2024,2025]
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
        AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
        AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    iad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    ddp.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
-- 科室字典：按出院科室归属康复医学专业，入院科室仅作明细核查。
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ddp ON ddp.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT iad ON iad.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE
    -- 统计时间按出院时间，使用左闭右开区间。
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
    -- 科室范围严格采用工作簿“科室范围”列。
    AND ddp.DEPT_NAME IN ('康复医学科一','康复医学科二','康复医学科','康复医学一科','康复医学二科','康复医学四科','神经康复科','骨科中心北区')
    -- 以下为本指标分子/分母的诊断或医嘱条件。
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
        WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%截瘫%'
    )

-- 康复医学专业 REH-ADL-03 分母
-- 年份=[2022,2023,2024,2025]
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
        AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
        AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    iad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    ddp.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    iad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,

LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT iad ON iad.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID

    -- 统计时间按出院时间，使用左闭右开区间。

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,

-- 口径来源：同编码体部放疗科 SQL；出院科室替换为已确认肿瘤科范围。
-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-BC-03 分母 体部放疗科
-- 首次就诊=放疗相关科室范围内最小VISIT_ID
-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)
-- 科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'
-- 年份=[2024]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND v.VISIT_ID = (
    SELECT MIN(v2.VISIT_ID)
    FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v2
    JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT d2 ON d2.DEPT_CODE = v2.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
    WHERE v2.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND d2.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三')
  ) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C50%'))
UNION ALL
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,

    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,

    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE,doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID||'-'||TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容,2000,1) AS 文书内容

LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad ON ad.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO=pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID=dix.UHID

JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content

 AND content.段落编号=doc.ID

)
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%手术记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%手术记录%')

-- 指标: CA-BC-05 乳腺疾病科一 分子 N (2022-2024, 基于现有P列SQL时间窗口替换)
-- 备注: 分子=出院记录含放疗
-- 责任科室：乳腺疾病科一
-- 科室范围：乳腺疾病科,乳腺疾病科北区
-- 指标：CA-BC-05；部分：分子
-- 统计粒度：患者ID+住院次数；业务源库只读
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE,doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID||'-'||TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容,2000,1) AS 文书内容

LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad ON ad.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO=pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID=dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content

-- 指标: CA-BC-06 乳腺疾病科一 分子 N (2022-2024, 基于现有P列SQL时间窗口替换)

-- 责任科室：乳腺疾病科一
-- 科室范围：乳腺疾病科,乳腺疾病科北区
-- 指标：CA-BC-06；部分：分子
-- 统计粒度：患者ID+住院次数；业务源库只读
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE,doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID||'-'||TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容,2000,1) AS 文书内容
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad ON ad.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO=pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID=dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
  ON content.UHID=doc.UHID
 AND content.段落编号=doc.ID
-- MTL文书按确认的系统时间范围提取
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('乳腺疾病科','乳腺疾病科北区')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C50%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乳腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乳腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%左乳癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%右乳癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%双乳癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%术前恶性肿瘤化学治疗%'
      )
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.OPERATION op0
    WHERE op0.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op0.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.OPERATION op2
    WHERE op2.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op2.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND op2.OPERATION_DESC IN (
          '左侧乳腺改良根治术','右侧乳腺改良根治术',
          '单侧乳腺改良根治术','双侧乳腺改良根治术'
      )
)
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(content.段落内容, '放疗') > 0)

-- 指标: CA-BC-07 乳腺疾病科一 分母 O (2022-2024, 基于现有Q列SQL时间窗口替换)
-- 责任科室：乳腺疾病科一
-- 科室范围：乳腺疾病科,乳腺疾病科北区
-- 指标：CA-BC-07；部分：分母
-- 统计粒度：患者ID+住院次数；业务源库只读
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad ON ad.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
-- 按出院时间归年，并严格使用该行“科室范围”精确过滤
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('乳腺疾病科','乳腺疾病科北区')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C50%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乳腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乳腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%左乳癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%右乳癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%双乳癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%术前恶性肿瘤化学治疗%'
      )
)
  AND v.VISIT_ID = (
    SELECT MIN(v2.VISIT_ID)
    FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v2
    JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT d2 ON d2.DEPT_CODE=v2.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
    WHERE v2.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
      AND d2.DEPT_NAME IN ('乳腺疾病科','乳腺疾病科北区')
)

-- 口径来源：同编码体部放疗科 SQL；出院科室替换为已确认肿瘤科范围。
-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-BC-08 分子 体部放疗科
-- 首次就诊=放疗相关科室范围内最小VISIT_ID
-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)
-- 科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'
-- 年份=[2024]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND v.VISIT_ID = (
    SELECT MIN(v2.VISIT_ID)
    FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v2
    JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT d2 ON d2.DEPT_CODE = v2.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
    WHERE v2.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND d2.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三')
  ) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C50%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乳腺癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乳腺恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%左乳癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%右乳癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%双乳癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%术前恶性肿瘤化学治疗%')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ((dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%化学治疗%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%为肿瘤化学治疗%') OR (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%靶向治疗%') OR (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%内分泌治疗%') OR (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%免疫治疗%')))
UNION ALL

-- 科室范围：乳腺疾病科,乳腺疾病科北区

-- 统计粒度：患者ID+住院次数；业务源库只读
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE,doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID||'-'||TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容,2000,1) AS 文书内容
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad ON ad.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO=pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID=dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
  ON content.UHID=doc.UHID
 AND content.段落编号=doc.ID
-- MTL文书按确认的系统时间范围提取
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('乳腺疾病科','乳腺疾病科北区')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C50%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乳腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乳腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%左乳癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%右乳癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%双乳癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%术前恶性肿瘤化学治疗%'
      )

  AND EXISTS (

    WHERE dx2.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx2.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx2.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx2.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%内分泌治疗%'

  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(content.段落内容, '乳腺癌') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(content.段落内容, '乳腺恶性肿瘤') > 0)

        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,

       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,

, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
