-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-BC-10 体部放疗科 分母
-- 分母合并2021-2024（主表O列）
-- 科室: 体部放疗7科室 DEPT_CODE IN ('021703','021710','021714','021717','021718','021721','021738')
-- 时段: >= DATE '2021-01-01' AND < DATE '2025-01-01'（出院时间归年）
-- 执行环境: ODS 数据中心 (HIS.* + MTL + JHEMR)
-- 分子: 手工筛选（主表 N/P 留空）
-- 修订20260721: 分母=首页诊断；MTL+JHEMR 文书 LEFT JOIN；LIKE 目录；正文 LEFT JOIN
-- 去重说明: 明细可多文书多行；汇总按 PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID 去重
-- ============================================================
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书类型,
    mi.DOC_TITLE AS 文书名称,
    NVL(mi.DOC_SIGN_DATE, mi.DOC_CREATE_DATE) AS 文书时间,
    mid.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(mi.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书正文_前2000字
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
  ON mid.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(mid.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
LEFT JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi
  ON mi.UHID = mid.UHID
 AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND (
       mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
    OR mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
    OR mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入出院%'
    OR mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%24小时%'
 )
LEFT JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc
  ON mc.UHID = mi.UHID
 AND mc.段落编号 = mi.ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2021-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021703','021710','021714','021717','021718','021721','021738')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
    WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乳腺癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乳腺恶性肿瘤%')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
    WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%靶向治疗%'
  )
) mtl_part
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
    CASE
      WHEN NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入出院%' OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%24小时%' THEN '入出院记录'
      WHEN NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入院%' THEN '入院记录'
      WHEN NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院%' THEN '出院记录'
      ELSE NVL(ji.TOPIC, '其他')
    END AS 文书类型,
    ji.TOPIC AS 文书名称,
    NVL(ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME, ji.CREATE_DATE_TIME) AS 文书时间,
    TO_CHAR(ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书正文_前2000字
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
  ON ji.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND ji.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(ji.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
       NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入院记录%'
    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%24小时%入%出院%'
    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院记满%'
 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct
  ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2021-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021703','021710','021714','021717','021718','021721','021738')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
    WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乳腺癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乳腺恶性肿瘤%')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
    WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%靶向治疗%'
  )
  AND ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID IS NOT NULL
) jhemr_part
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 14, 15

-- 指标：CA-BC-10；部分：分子
-- 统计粒度：患者ID+住院次数；业务源库只读
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

-- 2026-07-22 按统计口径修订: 去除口径外条件(C50编码)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad ON ad.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
-- 按出院时间归年，并严格使用该行“科室范围”精确过滤
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('甲状腺疾病科二','乳腺疾病科二','乳腺疾病科二北区')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乳腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乳腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%左乳癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%右乳癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%双乳癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%术前恶性肿瘤化学治疗%'
      )
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx2
    WHERE dx2.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx2.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx2.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx2.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%靶向治疗%'
)

-- 责任科室：乳腺疾病科一

-- 指标：CA-BC-11；部分：分母
-- 统计粒度：患者ID+住院次数；业务源库只读
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op1.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE,doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID||'-'||TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容,2000,1) AS 文书内容
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad ON ad.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO=pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID=dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
  ON content.UHID=doc.UHID
 AND content.段落编号=doc.ID

        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%右乳癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%双乳癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%术前恶性肿瘤化学治疗%'
      )
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.OPERATION op0
    WHERE op0.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op0.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
)
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%手术记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%手术记录%')
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(content.段落内容, '改良根治术') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(content.段落内容, '腋窝淋巴结清扫术') > 0)

       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,

       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v

 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID

  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID

    WHERE v2.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND d2.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三')
  )
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%'))

JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('放疗科二','放疗科','肿瘤介入微创科','肿瘤综合科','肿瘤微创综合科','放疗中心','体部放疗科') AND v.VISIT_ID = (
    SELECT MIN(v2.VISIT_ID)
    FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v2
    JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT d2 ON d2.DEPT_CODE = v2.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
    WHERE v2.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND d2.DEPT_NAME IN ('放疗科二','放疗科','肿瘤介入微创科','肿瘤综合科','肿瘤微创综合科','放疗中心','体部放疗科')
  ) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%'))
UNION ALL

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,

           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (

LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt

    JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT d2 ON d2.DEPT_CODE = v2.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
    WHERE v2.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID

  ) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%'))

-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-LC-01 肺癌患者首次治疗前临床TNM分期诊断率
-- 部分: 分母
-- 科室: 头颈放疗科(021729) + 头颈放疗科二(021735) 出院科室精确IN
-- 年份: 2025 (DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= 2025-01-01 AND < 2026-01-01)
-- 口径: 出院科室 IN (头颈放疗科, 头颈放疗科二) AND 病案首页出院诊断含目标诊断
-- 分子: 手工筛选，按统一说明 5.2 不生成SQL，不填假数
-- ============================================================
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN MEDREC.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID=pmi.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021729','021735')   -- 头颈放疗科+头颈放疗科二
  AND EXISTS (   -- 病案首页出院诊断 含目标诊断
        SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dd
        WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
          AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺癌%'
            OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%')
      )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

    (SELECT d.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS d WHERE d.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND d.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND d.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,

    adm.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室, dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间, v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统, NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE,doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间, dix.UHID||'-'||TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容,2000,1) AS 文书内容
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT adm ON adm.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO=pmi.INP_NO AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc ON doc.UHID=dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content ON content.UHID=doc.UHID AND content.段落编号=doc.ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'

  AND EXISTS (

      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
      AND (dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺癌%' OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺鳞癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺腺癌%' OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%')
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.OPERATION op0
    WHERE op0.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op0.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND (op0.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%化疗%' OR op0.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%免疫%'
        OR op0.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%靶向%' OR op0.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%放射%')
)
  AND v.VISIT_ID = (
    SELECT MIN(v2.VISIT_ID)

)

-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-LC-02 分子 体部放疗科
-- 分子=分母人群+出院记录同时含T/N/M分期痕迹（三组AND，组内同义词OR）
-- 粒度=人次；科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'

SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID

-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-LC-02 肺癌患者首次治疗前临床TNM分期检查评估策略符合率
-- 部分: 分母
-- 科室: 头颈放疗科(021729) + 头颈放疗科二(021735) 出院科室精确IN
-- 年份: 2025 (DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= 2025-01-01 AND < 2026-01-01)
-- 口径: 出院科室 IN (头颈放疗科, 头颈放疗科二) AND 病案首页出院诊断含目标诊断
-- 分子: 手工筛选，按统一说明 5.2 不生成SQL，不填假数
-- ============================================================
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

JOIN MEDREC.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID=pmi.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021729','021735')   -- 头颈放疗科+头颈放疗科二

          AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺癌%'
            OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%')
      )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

    (SELECT d.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS d WHERE d.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND d.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND d.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT d.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS d WHERE d.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND d.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND d.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT o.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT o.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    adm.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室, dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间, v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统, NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE,doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间, dix.UHID||'-'||TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容,2000,1) AS 文书内容
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT adm ON adm.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO=pmi.INP_NO AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc ON doc.UHID=dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content ON content.UHID=doc.UHID AND content.段落编号=doc.ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('呼吸内科','呼吸内科一','呼吸与危重症医学科一','呼吸与危重症医学科二','呼吸与危重症医学科三','PCCM[Ⅰ-Ⅱ部]','PCCM[Ⅴ-Ⅵ部]','PCCM VII','呼吸内科二','PCCM[Ⅲ-Ⅳ部]','PCCM Ⅷ','RICU','PCCM','呼吸内科三','PCCM[Ⅶ-Ⅷ部]','PCCM[Ⅸ-Ⅹ部][RICU]')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
      AND (dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺癌%' OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺鳞癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺腺癌%' OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%')
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.OPERATION op0
    WHERE op0.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op0.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND (op0.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%化疗%' OR op0.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%免疫%'
        OR op0.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%靶向%' OR op0.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%放射%')
)
  AND v.VISIT_ID = (
    SELECT MIN(v2.VISIT_ID)
    FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v2
    JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT d2 ON d2.DEPT_CODE=v2.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
    WHERE v2.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d2.DEPT_NAME IN ('呼吸内科','呼吸内科一','呼吸与危重症医学科一','呼吸与危重症医学科二','呼吸与危重症医学科三','PCCM[Ⅰ-Ⅱ部]','PCCM[Ⅴ-Ⅵ部]','PCCM VII','呼吸内科二','PCCM[Ⅲ-Ⅳ部]','PCCM Ⅷ','RICU','PCCM','呼吸内科三','PCCM[Ⅶ-Ⅷ部]','PCCM[Ⅸ-Ⅹ部][RICU]')
)
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01'
  AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')

  AND EXISTS (

        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺腺癌%' OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%')

  AND EXISTS (

      AND (op0.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%化疗%' OR op0.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%免疫%'

)
  AND v.VISIT_ID = (

    WHERE v2.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d2.DEPT_NAME IN ('呼吸内科','呼吸内科一','呼吸与危重症医学科一','呼吸与危重症医学科二','呼吸与危重症医学科三','PCCM[Ⅰ-Ⅱ部]','PCCM[Ⅴ-Ⅵ部]','PCCM VII','呼吸内科二','PCCM[Ⅲ-Ⅳ部]','PCCM Ⅷ','RICU','PCCM','呼吸内科三','PCCM[Ⅶ-Ⅷ部]','PCCM[Ⅸ-Ⅹ部][RICU]')

-- 口径来源：同编码体部放疗科 SQL；出院科室替换为已确认肿瘤科范围。
-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-LC-03 分子 体部放疗科
-- 首次就诊=否
-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)
-- 科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'
-- 年份=[2024]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ((dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%'))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS d3 WHERE d3.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d3.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND d3.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (d3.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%病理%' OR d3.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%活检%' OR d3.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%穿刺%'))
UNION ALL

-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-LC-03 肺癌患者非手术治疗前病理学诊断率
-- 部分: 分母
-- 科室: 头颈放疗科(021729) + 头颈放疗科二(021735) 出院科室精确IN
-- 年份: 2025 (DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= 2025-01-01 AND < 2026-01-01)
-- 口径: 出院科室 IN (头颈放疗科, 头颈放疗科二) AND 病案首页出院诊断含目标诊断
-- 分子: 手工筛选，按统一说明 5.2 不生成SQL，不填假数
-- ============================================================
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN MEDREC.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID=pmi.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021729','021735')   -- 头颈放疗科+头颈放疗科二
  AND EXISTS (   -- 病案首页出院诊断 含目标诊断
        SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dd
        WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
          AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺癌%'
            OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%')
      )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号, v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID, pmi.NAME AS 姓名, v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT d.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS d WHERE d.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND d.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND d.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT d.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS d WHERE d.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND d.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND d.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT o.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT o.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    adm.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室, dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间, v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
LEFT JOIN MEDREC.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN COMM.DEPT_DICT adm ON adm.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN COMM.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('呼吸内科','呼吸内科一','呼吸与危重症医学科一','呼吸与危重症医学科二','呼吸与危重症医学科三','PCCM[Ⅰ-Ⅱ部]','PCCM[Ⅴ-Ⅵ部]','PCCM VII','呼吸内科二','PCCM[Ⅲ-Ⅳ部]','PCCM Ⅷ','RICU','PCCM','呼吸内科三','PCCM[Ⅶ-Ⅷ部]','PCCM[Ⅸ-Ⅹ部][RICU]')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
      AND (dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺癌%' OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺鳞癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺腺癌%' OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%')
)
  AND v.VISIT_ID = (
    SELECT MIN(v2.VISIT_ID)
    FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v2
    JOIN COMM.DEPT_DICT d2 ON d2.DEPT_CODE=v2.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
    WHERE v2.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d2.DEPT_NAME IN ('呼吸内科','呼吸内科一','呼吸与危重症医学科一','呼吸与危重症医学科二','呼吸与危重症医学科三','PCCM[Ⅰ-Ⅱ部]','PCCM[Ⅴ-Ⅵ部]','PCCM VII','呼吸内科二','PCCM[Ⅲ-Ⅳ部]','PCCM Ⅷ','RICU','PCCM','呼吸内科三','PCCM[Ⅶ-Ⅷ部]','PCCM[Ⅸ-Ⅹ部][RICU]')
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op0
    WHERE op0.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op0.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND (op0.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%化疗%' OR op0.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%免疫%'
        OR op0.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%靶向%' OR op0.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%放射%')
)
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS d3 WHERE d3.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d3.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND d3.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%病理号%')
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.OPERATION o3 WHERE o3.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o3.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND (o3.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%穿刺%' OR o3.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%活检%')))

-- 指标: CA-LC-04 肺癌患者术后病理TNM分期率
-- 部分: 分母
-- 科室: 头颈放疗科(021729) + 头颈放疗科二(021735) 出院科室精确IN
-- 年份: 2025 (DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= 2025-01-01 AND < 2026-01-01)
-- 口径: 出院科室 IN (头颈放疗科, 头颈放疗科二) AND 病案首页出院诊断含目标诊断
-- 分子: 手工筛选，按统一说明 5.2 不生成SQL，不填假数
-- ============================================================
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN MEDREC.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID=pmi.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021729','021735')   -- 头颈放疗科+头颈放疗科二
  AND EXISTS (   -- 病案首页出院诊断 含目标诊断
        SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dd
        WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
          AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺癌%'
            OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%')
      )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

sqls.sql_annotated:
-- 口径来源：同编码体部放疗科 SQL；出院科室替换为已确认肿瘤科范围。
-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-LC-07 分母 体部放疗科
-- 首次就诊=放疗相关科室范围内最小VISIT_ID
-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)
-- 科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'
-- 年份=[2024]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND v.VISIT_ID = (
    SELECT MIN(v2.VISIT_ID)
    FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v2

-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-LC-07 III期肺癌患者初始治疗综合治疗率
-- 部分: 分母
-- 科室: 头颈放疗科(021729) + 头颈放疗科二(021735) 出院科室精确IN
-- 年份: 2025 (DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= 2025-01-01 AND < 2026-01-01)
-- 口径: 出院科室 IN (头颈放疗科, 头颈放疗科二) AND 病案首页出院诊断含目标诊断
-- 分子: 手工筛选，按统一说明 5.2 不生成SQL，不填假数
-- ============================================================
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN MEDREC.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID=pmi.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021729','021735')   -- 头颈放疗科+头颈放疗科二
  AND EXISTS (   -- 病案首页出院诊断 含目标诊断
        SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dd
        WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
          AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺癌%'
            OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%')
      )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号, v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID, pmi.NAME AS 姓名, v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT d.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS d WHERE d.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND d.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND d.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT d.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS d WHERE d.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND d.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND d.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT o.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT o.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND o.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    adm.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室, dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间, v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
LEFT JOIN MEDREC.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN COMM.DEPT_DICT adm ON adm.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN COMM.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('呼吸内科','呼吸内科一','呼吸与危重症医学科一','呼吸与危重症医学科二','呼吸与危重症医学科三','PCCM[Ⅰ-Ⅱ部]','PCCM[Ⅴ-Ⅵ部]','PCCM VII','呼吸内科二','PCCM[Ⅲ-Ⅳ部]','PCCM Ⅷ','RICU','PCCM','呼吸内科三','PCCM[Ⅶ-Ⅷ部]','PCCM[Ⅸ-Ⅹ部][RICU]')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
      AND (dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺癌%' OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺鳞癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺腺癌%' OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%')
)
  AND v.VISIT_ID = (
    SELECT MIN(v2.VISIT_ID)
    FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v2
    JOIN COMM.DEPT_DICT d2 ON d2.DEPT_CODE=v2.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
    WHERE v2.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d2.DEPT_NAME IN ('呼吸内科','呼吸内科一','呼吸与危重症医学科一','呼吸与危重症医学科二','呼吸与危重症医学科三','PCCM[Ⅰ-Ⅱ部]','PCCM[Ⅴ-Ⅵ部]','PCCM VII','呼吸内科二','PCCM[Ⅲ-Ⅳ部]','PCCM Ⅷ','RICU','PCCM','呼吸内科三','PCCM[Ⅶ-Ⅷ部]','PCCM[Ⅸ-Ⅹ部][RICU]')
)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS d4 WHERE d4.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND d4.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND (d4.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%转移%' OR d4.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%继发%'))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.OPERATION o4 WHERE o4.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o4.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID)

-- 口径来源：同编码体部放疗科 SQL；出院科室替换为已确认肿瘤科范围。

-- 指标 CA-LC-08 分母 体部放疗科

-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)
-- 科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'
-- 年份=[2024]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ((dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C34%'))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%放射治疗%'))
UNION ALL
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,

       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
   NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记满%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
  ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ((dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C34%'))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%放射治疗%'))

    (

    (

-- 口径来源：同编码体部放疗科 SQL；出院科室替换为已确认肿瘤科范围。
-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-LC-11 分母 体部放疗科
-- 首次就诊=否
-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)
-- 科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'
-- 年份=[2024]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C34%'))
UNION ALL
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,

         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,

       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间

       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('放疗科二','放疗科','肿瘤介入微创科','肿瘤综合科','肿瘤微创综合科','放疗中心','体部放疗科') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C34%'))

       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统

, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
   NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记满%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
  ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID

-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-LC-10(R105) 肺癌患者接受分子靶向治疗前基因检测阳性率
-- 部分: 分母
-- 科室: 头颈放疗科(021729) + 头颈放疗科二(021735) 出院科室精确IN
-- 年份: 2025 (DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= 2025-01-01 AND < 2026-01-01)
-- 口径: 出院科室 IN (头颈放疗科, 头颈放疗科二) AND 病案首页出院诊断含目标诊断
-- 分子: 手工筛选，按统一说明 5.2 不生成SQL，不填假数
-- 行号: R105 (与 R100 分母口径完全一致)
-- ============================================================
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN MEDREC.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID=pmi.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021729','021735')   -- 头颈放疗科+头颈放疗科二
  AND EXISTS (   -- 病案首页出院诊断 含目标诊断
        SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dd
        WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
          AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺癌%'
            OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肺恶性肿瘤%')
      )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

-- 部分: 分母

-- 科室: 不限制出院科室（R115 口径与 R100/R105 不同）
-- 年份: 2025 (DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= 2025-01-01 AND < 2026-01-01)
-- 口径: 全院 + 病案首页出院诊断含"肺癌"或"肺恶性肿瘤"
-- 分子: 手工筛选，按统一说明 5.2 不生成SQL，不填假数
-- ============================================================
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,

LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
   NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记满%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
  ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID

      AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 出院主要诊断编码,
    (
    SELECT
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC 
    FROM
      diagnosis ds 
    WHERE
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
      AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID 
      AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID 
      AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 诊断名称,
    (
    SELECT
      OPERATION_CODE 
    FROM
      OPERATION OP 
    WHERE
      OP.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID 
      AND OP.VISIT_ID = V.VISIT_ID 
      AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 第一位手术编码,
    (
    SELECT
      OPERATION_DESC 
    FROM
      OPERATION OP 
    WHERE
      OP.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID 
      AND OP.VISIT_ID = V.VISIT_ID 
      AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 第一位手术名称,
    AD.DEPTNAME 入院科室,
    DD.DEPTNAME 出院科室,
    V.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME 入院时间,
    V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME 出院时间,
    ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER ( PARTITION BY v.PATIENT_ID ORDER BY v.Visit_id ) AS rn 
  FROM
    PAT_VISIT V
    LEFT JOIN PAT_MASTER_INDEX M ON V.PATIENT_ID = M.PATIENT_ID
    LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT AD ON V.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO = AD.DEPTCODE
    LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT DD ON V.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM = DD.DEPTCODE 
  WHERE
    V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= TO_DATE( '20210101', 'YYYYMMDD' ) 
    AND V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < TO_DATE( '20250101', 'YYYYMMDD' ) 
and  dd.deptname like '消化%'    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1 
    FROM
      DIAGNOSIS DD 
    WHERE
      DD.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID 
      AND DD.VISIT_ID = V.VISIT_ID 
      AND DD.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3

    ) 
  ) 
WHERE
  rn = 1 
ORDER BY
  入院时间;

-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-CNLC-03 分母 体部放疗科
-- 首次就诊=放疗相关科室范围内最小VISIT_ID
-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)
-- 科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'
-- 年份=[2024]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO

  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID

-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-CNLC-03 肝胆外科 分母
-- 时段: 2022_2024
-- 科室: 肝胆外科6科室精确 IN ('040121','040122','040112','040123','021723','021722')
-- 执行环境: HIS_SOURCE 端 (MEDREC/COMM)
-- 首次就诊(修订): 全期(2022-2026)最小 VISIT_ID, 在诊断/科室筛选后确定,
--   不在分子附加条件后; 按出院时间归年到当前时段, 不跨时段重复计
-- 分母: 首次就诊(全期)+肝胆6科室+肝癌/肝恶肿/肝内胆管癌
-- ============================================================
WITH first_visit AS (
    SELECT v.PATIENT_ID, MIN(v.VISIT_ID) AS FIRST_VISIT_ID
    FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
    WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('040121','040122','040112','040123','021723','021722')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dd
                  WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
                    AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肝癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肝恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肝内胆管癌%'))
    GROUP BY v.PATIENT_ID
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN MEDREC.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
JOIN first_visit fv ON fv.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND fv.FIRST_VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('040121','040122','040112','040123','021723','021722')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dd
              WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
                AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肝癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肝恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肝内胆管癌%'))
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

-- 口径来源：同编码体部放疗科 SQL；出院科室替换为已确认肿瘤科范围。
-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-CNLC-04 分母 体部放疗科
-- 首次就诊=否
-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)
-- 科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'
-- 年份=[2024]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C24.002%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C22.101%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C24.0%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C22.1%'))
UNION ALL
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op

, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统

, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-CNLC-04 肝胆外科 分母
-- 时段: 2022_2024
-- 科室: 肝胆外科6科室精确 IN ('040121','040122','040112','040123','021723','021722')
-- 执行环境: HIS_SOURCE 端 (MEDREC/COMM)
-- 首次就诊(修订): 全期(2022-2026)最小 VISIT_ID, 在诊断/科室筛选后确定,
--   不在分子附加条件后; 按出院时间归年到当前时段, 不跨时段重复计
-- 分母: 首次就诊(全期)+肝胆6科室+肝癌/肝恶肿/肝内胆管癌
-- ============================================================
WITH first_visit AS (
    SELECT v.PATIENT_ID, MIN(v.VISIT_ID) AS FIRST_VISIT_ID
    FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
    WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('040121','040122','040112','040123','021723','021722')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dd
                  WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
                    AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肝癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肝恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肝内胆管癌%'))
    GROUP BY v.PATIENT_ID
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN MEDREC.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
JOIN first_visit fv ON fv.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND fv.FIRST_VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('040121','040122','040112','040123','021723','021722')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dd

ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-CNLC-05 体部放疗科 分母
-- 分母2024 C24.002/C22.101
-- 科室: 体部放疗7科室 DEPT_CODE IN ('021703','021710','021714','021717','021718','021721','021738')
-- 时段: >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND < DATE '2025-01-01'（出院时间归年）
-- 执行环境: ODS 数据中心 (HIS.* + MTL + JHEMR)
-- 分子: 手工筛选（主表 N/P 留空）
-- 修订20260721: 分母=首页诊断；MTL+JHEMR 文书 LEFT JOIN；LIKE 目录；正文 LEFT JOIN
-- 去重说明: 明细可多文书多行；汇总按 PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID 去重
-- ============================================================
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书类型,
    mi.DOC_TITLE AS 文书名称,
    NVL(mi.DOC_SIGN_DATE, mi.DOC_CREATE_DATE) AS 文书时间,
    mid.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(mi.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书正文_前2000字
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
  ON mid.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(mid.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
LEFT JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi
  ON mi.UHID = mid.UHID
 AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND (
       mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
    OR mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
    OR mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入出院%'
    OR mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%24小时%'
 )
LEFT JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc
  ON mc.UHID = mi.UHID
 AND mc.段落编号 = mi.ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021703','021710','021714','021717','021718','021721','021738')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
    WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C24.002%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C22.101%')
  )
) mtl_part
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
    CASE
      WHEN NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入出院%' OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%24小时%' THEN '入出院记录'
      WHEN NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入院%' THEN '入院记录'
      WHEN NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院%' THEN '出院记录'
      ELSE NVL(ji.TOPIC, '其他')
    END AS 文书类型,
    ji.TOPIC AS 文书名称,
    NVL(ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME, ji.CREATE_DATE_TIME) AS 文书时间,
    TO_CHAR(ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书正文_前2000字
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
  ON ji.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND ji.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(ji.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
       NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入院记录%'
    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%24小时%入%出院%'
    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院记满%'
 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct
  ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021703','021710','021714','021717','021718','021721','021738')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
    WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C24.002%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C22.101%')
  )
  AND ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID IS NOT NULL
) jhemr_part
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 14, 15

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
  ON mid.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID

    OR mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
    OR mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入出院%'
    OR mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%24小时%'
 )
LEFT JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc
  ON mc.UHID = mi.UHID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-01-01'

SELECT

      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID

    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,

    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,

LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
  ON ji.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND ji.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(ji.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
       NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入院记录%'
    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'

    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院记满%'
 )

  ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
