-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-CNLC-10 肝胆外科 分子
-- 时段: 2022_2024
-- 科室: 肝胆外科6科室精确 IN ('040121','040122','040112','040123','021723','021722')
-- 执行环境: ODS 端 (HIS.* + MTL + JHEMR)
-- 首次就诊(修订): 全期(2022-2026)最小 VISIT_ID, 在诊断/科室筛选后确定,
--   不在分子附加条件后; 按出院时间归年到当前时段, 不跨时段重复计
-- 分子(分母住院键严格子集): 首次就诊+C22%+首页手术含'栓塞'
-- 修订(用户确认): 去掉IIb/IIIa文书关键词(当前TACE患者出院记录均不含IIb/IIIa, 用CNLC/BCLC体系)
-- 本口径为简化代理口径, 不是完整 CA-CNLC-10 国家定义; LEFT JOIN 文书仅供核查
-- ============================================================
WITH first_visit AS (
    SELECT v.PATIENT_ID, MIN(v.VISIT_ID) AS FIRST_VISIT_ID
    FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
    WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('040121','040122','040112','040123','021723','021722')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
                  WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
                    AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C22%')
    GROUP BY v.PATIENT_ID
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID, v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数, pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号, pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间, v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    emo.文书系统 AS 文书系统, emo.出院记录名称 AS 出院记录名称,
    emo.出院记录时间 AS 出院记录时间, emo.出院记录唯一标识 AS 出院记录唯一标识,
    emo.出院记录正文 AS 出院记录正文_前2000字
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
JOIN first_visit fv ON fv.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND fv.FIRST_VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
LEFT JOIN (
    -- MTL 出院记录: DOC_TYPE_NAME = '出院记录', 用 INP_NO 关联
    SELECT mid.P_INPATIENT_NO AS INP_NO, NULL AS PAT_ID, mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES AS VISIT_TIMES,
           'MTL' AS 文书系统,
           mi.DOC_TITLE AS 出院记录名称,
           mi.DOC_SIGN_DATE AS 出院记录时间,
           mid.UHID AS 出院记录唯一标识,
           DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 出院记录正文
    FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi ON mi.UHID = mid.UHID AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK,0)=0
                              AND mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME = '出院记录'
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc ON mc.UHID = mi.UHID AND mc.段落编号 = mi.ID
    WHERE NVL(mid.DELETEMARK,0)=0
      AND mid.P_OUTDATE >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND mid.P_OUTDATE < DATE '2025-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    -- JHEMR 出院记录: MR_CLASS IN ('EMR12.00','EMR09.00.02') AND TOPIC含'出院记录', 用 PATIENT_ID 关联
    SELECT NULL AS INP_NO, ji.PATIENT_ID AS PAT_ID, ji.VISIT_ID AS VISIT_TIMES,
           'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
           ji.TOPIC AS 出院记录名称,
           ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME AS 出院记录时间,
           ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID AS 出院记录唯一标识,
           DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 出院记录正文
    FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID

-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-CNLC-12 体部放疗科 分母
-- 分母2024 C22%+放射治疗
-- 科室: 体部放疗7科室 DEPT_CODE IN ('021703','021710','021714','021717','021718','021721','021738')
-- 时段: >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND < DATE '2025-01-01'（出院时间归年）
-- 执行环境: ODS 数据中心 (HIS.* + MTL + JHEMR)
-- 分子: 手工筛选（主表 N/P 留空）
-- 修订20260721: 分母=首页诊断；MTL+JHEMR 文书 LEFT JOIN；LIKE 目录；正文 LEFT JOIN
-- 去重说明: 明细可多文书多行；汇总按 PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID 去重
-- ============================================================
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书类型,
    mi.DOC_TITLE AS 文书名称,
    NVL(mi.DOC_SIGN_DATE, mi.DOC_CREATE_DATE) AS 文书时间,
    mid.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(mi.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书正文_前2000字
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
  ON mid.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(mid.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
LEFT JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi
  ON mi.UHID = mid.UHID
 AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND (
       mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
    OR mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
    OR mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入出院%'
    OR mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%24小时%'
 )
LEFT JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc
  ON mc.UHID = mi.UHID
 AND mc.段落编号 = mi.ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021703','021710','021714','021717','021718','021721','021738')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
    WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C22%'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
    WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%放射治疗%'
  )
) mtl_part
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds

        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
    CASE
      WHEN NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入出院%' OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%24小时%' THEN '入出院记录'
      WHEN NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入院%' THEN '入院记录'
      WHEN NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院%' THEN '出院记录'
      ELSE NVL(ji.TOPIC, '其他')
    END AS 文书类型,
    ji.TOPIC AS 文书名称,
    NVL(ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME, ji.CREATE_DATE_TIME) AS 文书时间,
    TO_CHAR(ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书正文_前2000字
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
  ON ji.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND ji.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(ji.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
       NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入院记录%'
    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%24小时%入%出院%'
    OR NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院记满%'
 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct
  ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021703','021710','021714','021717','021718','021721','021738')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
    WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C22%'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
    WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%放射治疗%'
  )
  AND ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID IS NOT NULL
) jhemr_part
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 14, 15

-- 口径来源：同编码体部放疗科 SQL；出院科室替换为已确认肿瘤科范围。
-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。

-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-CC-01 妇科 分母(2022_2024)
-- 科室: 妇科 5 科室精确 IN ('04070202','040704','040709','040710','040701')
-- 年份: 2022-2024 (DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= 2022-01-01 AND < 2025-01-01, 按出院时间归年)
-- 执行环境: HIS_SOURCE 端 (MEDREC/ORDADM/COMM)
-- 首次就诊: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PATIENT_ID ORDER BY VISIT_ID)=1
-- 诊断匹配: 严格按 I 列原文 LIKE '%宫颈恶性肿瘤%' OR LIKE '%宫颈癌%'
-- 分母: 妇科5科室 + 宫颈恶肿/宫颈癌 + 首次就诊; 分子=手工筛选(跳过)
-- ============================================================
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,

-- 口径来源：同编码体部放疗科 SQL；出院科室替换为已确认肿瘤科范围。
-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-CC-02 分母 体部放疗科
-- 首次就诊=否
-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)
-- 科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'
-- 年份=[2024]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C53%'))
UNION ALL
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,

         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v

JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx

   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'

LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt

SELECT
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.PATIENT_ID ORDER BY v.VISIT_ID) AS rn
  FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
    LEFT JOIN MEDREC.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
  WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('04070202','040704','040709','040710','040701')   -- 妇产科(妇科组)/妇科/妇科一/妇科二/妇科三 出院科室精确IN
    AND EXISTS (   -- 病案首页出院诊断含 宫颈恶性肿瘤或宫颈癌
          SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dd
          WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
            AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
            AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%宫颈恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%宫颈癌%')
        )
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY 入院时间

-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-CC-03 妇科 分母(2022_2024)
-- 科室: 妇科 5 科室精确 IN ('04070202','040704','040709','040710','040701')
-- 年份: 2022-2024 (DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= 2022-01-01 AND < 2025-01-01, 按出院时间归年)
-- 执行环境: HIS_SOURCE 端 (MEDREC/ORDADM/COMM)
-- 首次就诊: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PATIENT_ID ORDER BY VISIT_ID)=1
-- 诊断匹配: 严格按 I 列原文 LIKE '%宫颈恶性肿瘤%' OR LIKE '%宫颈癌%'
-- 分母: 妇科5科室 + 宫颈恶肿/宫颈癌 + 首次就诊; 分子=手工筛选(跳过)
-- ============================================================
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.PATIENT_ID ORDER BY v.VISIT_ID) AS rn
  FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
    LEFT JOIN MEDREC.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
  WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('04070202','040704','040709','040710','040701')   -- 妇产科(妇科组)/妇科/妇科一/妇科二/妇科三 出院科室精确IN
    AND EXISTS (   -- 病案首页出院诊断含 宫颈恶性肿瘤或宫颈癌
          SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dd
          WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
            AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
            AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%宫颈恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%宫颈癌%')
        )
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY 入院时间

-- 科室: 妇科 5 科室精确 IN ('04070202','040704','040709','040710','040701')
-- 年份: 2025-2025 (DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= 2025-01-01 AND < 2026-01-01, 按出院时间归年)
-- 执行环境: HIS_SOURCE 端 (MEDREC/ORDADM/COMM)
-- 首次就诊: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PATIENT_ID ORDER BY VISIT_ID)=1
-- 诊断匹配: 严格按 I 列原文 LIKE '%宫颈恶性肿瘤%' OR LIKE '%宫颈癌%'
-- 分母: 妇科5科室 + 宫颈恶肿/宫颈癌 + 首次就诊; 分子=手工筛选(跳过)
-- ============================================================
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.PATIENT_ID ORDER BY v.VISIT_ID) AS rn
  FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
    LEFT JOIN MEDREC.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
  WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('04070202','040704','040709','040710','040701')   -- 妇产科(妇科组)/妇科/妇科一/妇科二/妇科三 出院科室精确IN
    AND EXISTS (   -- 病案首页出院诊断含 宫颈恶性肿瘤或宫颈癌
          SELECT 1 FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS dd
          WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
            AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
            AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%宫颈恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%宫颈癌%')
        )
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY 入院时间

-- 年份=[2022, 2023, 2024, 2025]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,

-- 执行环境: ODS 端 (HIS.* + MTL + JHEMR)
-- 首次就诊: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PATIENT_ID ORDER BY VISIT_ID)=1
-- 诊断匹配: 严格按 I 列原文 LIKE '%宫颈恶性肿瘤%' OR LIKE '%宫颈癌%'

    SELECT
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID, v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数, pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号, pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,

        (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,

        )
)

        emo.文书系统 AS 文书系统, emo.出院记录名称 AS 出院记录名称,
        emo.出院记录时间 AS 出院记录时间, emo.出院记录唯一标识 AS 出院记录唯一标识,
        emo.出院记录正文 AS 出院记录正文_前2000字,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.PATIENT_ID ORDER BY v.VISIT_ID) AS rn
    FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
    LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
    JOIN (
        
        SELECT mid.P_INPATIENT_NO AS INP_NO, NULL AS PAT_ID, mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES AS VISIT_TIMES,
               'MTL' AS 文书系统,
               mi.DOC_TITLE AS 出院记录名称,
               mi.DOC_SIGN_DATE AS 出院记录时间,
               mid.UHID AS 出院记录唯一标识,
               DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 出院记录正文
        FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
        JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi ON mi.UHID = mid.UHID AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK,0)=0
        JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc ON mc.UHID = mi.UHID AND mc.段落编号 = mi.ID
        WHERE NVL(mid.DELETEMARK,0)=0
          AND (INSTR(NVL(mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME,''),'出院')>0 OR INSTR(NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE,''),'出院')>0)
          AND mid.P_OUTDATE >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND mid.P_OUTDATE < DATE '2025-07-01'
          AND (INSTR(mc.段落内容,'放疗')>0 OR INSTR(mc.段落内容,'放化疗')>0)
        UNION ALL
        
        SELECT NULL AS INP_NO, ji.PATIENT_ID AS PAT_ID, ji.VISIT_ID AS VISIT_TIMES,
               'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
               ji.TOPIC AS 出院记录名称,
               ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME AS 出院记录时间,
               ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID AS 出院记录唯一标识,
               DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 出院记录正文
        FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
        JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
        WHERE INSTR(NVL(ji.TOPIC,''),'出院')>0
          AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
          AND (INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT,'放疗')>0 OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT,'放化疗')>0)
    ) emo ON (emo.INP_NO = pmi.INP_NO OR emo.PAT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID)
           AND emo.VISIT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
    WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('04070202','040704','040709','040710','040701')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%宫颈恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%宫颈癌%'))
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY 入院时间

-- ============================================================
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,

    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.PATIENT_ID ORDER BY v.VISIT_ID) AS rn
  FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
    LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
  WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('04070202','040704','040709','040710','040701')   -- 妇产科(妇科组)/妇科/妇科一/妇科二/妇科三 出院科室精确IN
    AND EXISTS (   -- 病案首页出院诊断含 宫颈恶性肿瘤或宫颈癌

            AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
            AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%宫颈恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%宫颈癌%')
        )
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY 入院时间

-- 年份=[2022, 2023, 2024, 2025]

sqls.sql_annotated:
-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-CC-06 妇科 分子(2022_2024)
-- 科室: 妇科 5 科室精确 IN ('04070202','040704','040709','040710','040701')
-- 年份: 2022-2024 (DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= 2022-01-01 AND < 2025-01-01, 按出院时间归年)
-- 执行环境: ODS 端 (HIS.* + MTL + JHEMR)
-- 首次就诊: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PATIENT_ID ORDER BY VISIT_ID)=1
-- 诊断匹配: 严格按 I 列原文 LIKE '%宫颈恶性肿瘤%' OR LIKE '%宫颈癌%'
-- 分子: 分母 + 出院记录文书正文含 放疗 或 放化疗 (MTL+JHEMR UNION ALL)
-- ============================================================
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT
        v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID, v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数, pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号, pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
        (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
        (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
        (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
        (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
        (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
        (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
        v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间, v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
        emo.文书系统 AS 文书系统, emo.出院记录名称 AS 出院记录名称,
        emo.出院记录时间 AS 出院记录时间, emo.出院记录唯一标识 AS 出院记录唯一标识,
        emo.出院记录正文 AS 出院记录正文_前2000字,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.PATIENT_ID ORDER BY v.VISIT_ID) AS rn
    FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
    LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
    JOIN (
        -- MTL 出院记录: 含"放疗"或"放化疗", 用 INP_NO 关联
        SELECT mid.P_INPATIENT_NO AS INP_NO, NULL AS PAT_ID, mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES AS VISIT_TIMES,
               'MTL' AS 文书系统,
               mi.DOC_TITLE AS 出院记录名称,
               mi.DOC_SIGN_DATE AS 出院记录时间,
               mid.UHID AS 出院记录唯一标识,
               DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 出院记录正文
        FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
        JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi ON mi.UHID = mid.UHID AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK,0)=0
        JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc ON mc.UHID = mi.UHID AND mc.段落编号 = mi.ID
        WHERE NVL(mid.DELETEMARK,0)=0
          AND (INSTR(NVL(mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME,''),'出院')>0 OR INSTR(NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE,''),'出院')>0)
          AND mid.P_OUTDATE >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND mid.P_OUTDATE < DATE '2025-01-01'
          AND (INSTR(mc.段落内容,'放疗')>0 OR INSTR(mc.段落内容,'放化疗')>0)
        UNION ALL
        -- JHEMR 出院记录: 含"放疗"或"放化疗", 用 PATIENT_ID 关联
        SELECT NULL AS INP_NO, ji.PATIENT_ID AS PAT_ID, ji.VISIT_ID AS VISIT_TIMES,
               'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
               ji.TOPIC AS 出院记录名称,
               ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME AS 出院记录时间,
               ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID AS 出院记录唯一标识,
               DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 出院记录正文
        FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
        JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
        WHERE INSTR(NVL(ji.TOPIC,''),'出院')>0
          AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01' AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
          AND (INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT,'放疗')>0 OR INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT,'放化疗')>0)
    ) emo ON (emo.INP_NO = pmi.INP_NO OR emo.PAT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID)
           AND emo.VISIT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
    WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('04070202','040704','040709','040710','040701')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%宫颈恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%宫颈癌%'))
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY 入院时间

LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('放疗科二','放疗科','肿瘤介入微创科','肿瘤综合科','肿瘤微创综合科','放疗中心','体部放疗科') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ((dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C53%'))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%放射治疗%'))
UNION ALL
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统

JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID

 AND (

   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'

 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
  ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID

-- 口径来源：同编码体部放疗科 SQL；出院科室替换为已确认肿瘤科范围。
-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-GC-02 分子 体部放疗科
-- 分子=分母人群+出院记录同时含T/N/M分期痕迹（三组AND，组内同义词OR）
-- 粒度=人次；科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'

SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01'
  AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%胃癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%胃恶性肿瘤%'))
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T2') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T3') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T4') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Tis') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Tis') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'TX') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Tx') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 2') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 3') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 4') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'cT') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'pT') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'yT') > 0) AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N2') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N3') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'NX') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Nx') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N 0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N 1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N 2') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N 3') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'cN') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'pN') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'yN') > 0) AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'M0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'M1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'MX') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Mx') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'M 0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'M 1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'cM') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'pM') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'yM') > 0)
UNION ALL

SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op

           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
   NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记满%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'

 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'

-- CA-GC-02 分母 | 胃肠外科 | 2022-2025 | 颜色=red | 行=204 | 诊断:胃癌/胃恶性肿瘤/贲门恶性肿瘤 | 分子=hand | 写入=0
SELECT 
TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
(SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
(SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
(SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
(SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('040118','040119','040113','040125','040130')
  AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
  WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
    AND (
  dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%胃癌%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%胃恶性肿瘤%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%贲门恶性肿瘤%'
)
)
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('放疗科二','放疗科','肿瘤介入微创科','肿瘤综合科','肿瘤微创综合科','放疗中心','体部放疗科') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%胃癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%胃恶性肿瘤%'))

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,

         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,

       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
   NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记满%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
  ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('放疗科二','放疗科','肿瘤介入微创科','肿瘤综合科','肿瘤微创综合科','放疗中心','体部放疗科') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%胃癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%胃恶性肿瘤%'))

inner JOIN bl.pitaya t1 on t.test_no = t1.ReqNoteID
join (
SELECT
  to_char(discharge_date_time, 'yyyy') 年份,pmi.INP_NO 住院号,
  pmi.PATIENT_ID 患者ID,
  pmi.NAME 姓名,
  v.VISIT_ID 次数,
  (
  SELECT
    ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE 
  FROM
    his.diagnosis ds 
  WHERE
    ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
    AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID 
    AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID 
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
    AND ROWNUM = 1 
  ) 出院主要诊断编码,
        (
  SELECT
    ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC 
  FROM
        his.diagnosis ds 
  WHERE
    ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
    AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID 
    AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID 
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
    AND ROWNUM = 1 
  ) 诊断名称,
        (SELECT OPERATION_CODE FROM     his.OPERATION OP WHERE OP.PATIENT_ID=V.PATIENT_ID AND OP.VISIT_ID=V.VISIT_ID AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) 第一位手术编码,
         (SELECT OPERATION_DESC FROM     his.OPERATION OP WHERE OP.PATIENT_ID=V.PATIENT_ID AND OP.VISIT_ID=V.VISIT_ID AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) 第一位手术名称,
  e.dept_name 入院科室,
  t.DEPT_NAME 出院科室,
  v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME 入院时间,
  v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME 出院时间
FROM

    M.NAME 姓名,
    (
    SELECT
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE 
    FROM
      diagnosis ds 
    WHERE
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
      AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID 
      AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID 
      AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 出院主要诊断编码,
    (
    SELECT
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC 
    FROM
      diagnosis ds 
    WHERE
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
      AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID 
      AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID 
      AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 诊断名称,
    (
    SELECT
      OPERATION_CODE 
    FROM
      OPERATION OP 
    WHERE
      OP.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID 
      AND OP.VISIT_ID = V.VISIT_ID 
      AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 第一位手术编码,
    (
    SELECT
      OPERATION_DESC 
    FROM
      OPERATION OP 
    WHERE
      OP.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID 
      AND OP.VISIT_ID = V.VISIT_ID 
      AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 第一位手术名称,
    AD.DEPTNAME 入院科室,
    DD.DEPTNAME 出院科室,
    V.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME 入院时间,
    V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME 出院时间,
    ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER ( PARTITION BY v.PATIENT_ID ORDER BY v.Visit_id ) AS rn 
  FROM
    PAT_VISIT V
    LEFT JOIN PAT_MASTER_INDEX M ON V.PATIENT_ID = M.PATIENT_ID
    LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT AD ON V.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO = AD.DEPTCODE
    LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT DD ON V.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM = DD.DEPTCODE 
  WHERE
    V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= TO_DATE( '20210101', 'YYYYMMDD' ) 
    AND V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < TO_DATE( '20250101', 'YYYYMMDD' ) 
and (DD.Deptname like '胃肠%' )
    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1 
    FROM
      DIAGNOSIS DD 
    WHERE
      DD.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID 
      AND DD.VISIT_ID = V.VISIT_ID 
      AND DD.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
      AND ( DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%胃癌%' OR DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%胃恶性肿瘤%' OR DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%贲门恶性肿瘤%') 
    )

-- CA-GC-06 分母 | 胃肠外科 | 2025 | 颜色=black | 行=218 | 诊断:胃癌/胃恶性肿瘤/贲门恶性肿瘤 | 分子=hand | 写入=0
SELECT 
TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
(SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
(SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
(SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
(SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('040118','040119','040113','040125','040130')
  AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
  WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
    AND (
  dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%胃癌%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%胃恶性肿瘤%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%贲门恶性肿瘤%'
)
)
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME
-- 合计人次:63 分年:{2025: 63}

  pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
  pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
  pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
  v.VISIT_ID AS 次数,
  (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE 
   FROM his.diagnosis ds 
   WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
     AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID 
     AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID 
     AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
  (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC 
   FROM his.diagnosis ds 
   WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
     AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID 
     AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID 
     AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
  (SELECT OPERATION_CODE 
   FROM his.OPERATION op 
   WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID 
     AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID 
     AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
  (SELECT OPERATION_DESC 
   FROM his.OPERATION op 
   WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID 
     AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID 
     AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 
     AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
  e.dept_name AS 入院科室,
  t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
  v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
  v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
  row_number() over (partition by v.patient_id order by v.visit_id   ) rw 
             ,    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(段落内容, 2000, 1)   as 内容

FROM
  his.pat_visit v
  LEFT JOIN his.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
  LEFT JOIN his.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
  LEFT JOIN his.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
  join   mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t3 on t3.P_INPATIENT_NO=pmi.INP_NO and t3.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=v.visit_id
JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1 on t3.UHID=t1.UHID  and DOC_TITLE like '%出院记录%'
Join MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4 On t4.UHID=t3.UHID and t4.段落编号=T1.ID

  AND v.discharge_date_time < TO_DATE('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and t.dept_name in('胃肠外科一','胃肠外科二','胃肠外科','胃肠外科北区','胃肠外二科')
 and exists( select 1 
    from his.diagnosis dd
    where dd.patient_id = v.patient_id 
      and dd.visit_id = v.visit_id
      and dd.diagnosis_type='3' 
      and (dd.diagnosis_desc like '%胃癌%' or dd.diagnosis_desc like '%胃恶性肿瘤%' 
      or dd.diagnosis_desc like '%贲门恶性肿瘤%'))   and exists( select 1 
    from his.inp_bill_detail od
    where od.patient_id = v.patient_id 
      and od.visit_id = v.visit_id
      and od.ITEM_NAME like '%营养风险筛查%')

-- 首次就诊=放疗相关科室范围内最小VISIT_ID
-- 文书=出院记录

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,

       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,

, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID

JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID

-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。

-- 首次就诊=放疗相关科室范围内最小VISIT_ID
-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)

-- 年份=[2024]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID

    SELECT MIN(v2.VISIT_ID)
    FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v2
    JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT d2 ON d2.DEPT_CODE = v2.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
    WHERE v2.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND d2.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三')
  ) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C16%'))
UNION ALL

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统

JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
   NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'

   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'

 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt

       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,

         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,

, 'MTL' AS 文书系统

, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识

  )

       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
   NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记满%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
  ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('放疗科二','放疗科','肿瘤介入微创科','肿瘤综合科','肿瘤微创综合科','放疗中心','体部放疗科') AND v.VISIT_ID = (
    SELECT MIN(v2.VISIT_ID)
    FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v2
    JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT d2 ON d2.DEPT_CODE = v2.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
    WHERE v2.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND d2.DEPT_NAME IN ('放疗科二','放疗科','肿瘤介入微创科','肿瘤综合科','肿瘤微创综合科','放疗中心','体部放疗科')
  ) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C18%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C19%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C20%'))

-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-CRC-02 分子 体部放疗科
-- 分子=分母人群+出院记录同时含T/N/M分期痕迹（三组AND，组内同义词OR）
-- 粒度=人次；科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'

SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01'
  AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三')

  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T2') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T3') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T4') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Tis') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Tis') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'TX') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Tx') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 2') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 3') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 4') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'cT') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'pT') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'yT') > 0) AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N2') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N3') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'NX') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Nx') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N 0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N 1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N 2') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N 3') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'cN') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'pN') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'yN') > 0) AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'M0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'M1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'MX') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Mx') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'M 0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'M 1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'cM') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'pM') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'yM') > 0)
UNION ALL

-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-CRC-03 分母 体部放疗科
-- 首次就诊=否
-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)
-- 科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'
-- 年份=[2024]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0

           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op

-- 指标 CA-CRC-03 分母 体部放疗科
-- 首次就诊=否
-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)

-- 年份=[2025]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID

-- CA-CRC-03 分母 | 胃肠外科 | 2022-2025 | 颜色=red | 行=244 | 诊断:结直肠癌/恶性肿瘤诊断词 | 分子=hand | 写入=0
SELECT 
TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
(SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
(SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
(SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
(SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('040118','040119','040113','040125','040130')
  AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
  WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
    AND (
  dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%结肠癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%升结肠癌%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%横结肠癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%降结肠癌%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%直肠癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乙状结肠癌%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%结肠恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%升结肠恶性肿瘤%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%横结肠恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%降结肠恶性肿瘤%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%直肠恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乙状结肠恶性肿瘤%'
)
)
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt

-- 口径来源：同编码体部放疗科 SQL；出院科室替换为已确认肿瘤科范围。
-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-CRC-05 分母 体部放疗科
-- 首次就诊=否
-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)
-- 科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'
-- 年份=[2024]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C18%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C19%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C20%')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%免疫治疗%'))
UNION ALL
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,

         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,

, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识

-- CA-CRC-05 分母 | 胃肠外科 | 2022-2025 | 颜色=red | 行=250 | 诊断:结直肠类 + 化学治疗/靶向治疗/免疫治疗 | 分子=hand | 写入=0
SELECT 
TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
(SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
(SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
(SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
(SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('040118','040119','040113','040125','040130')
  AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
  WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
    AND (
  dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%结肠癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%升结肠癌%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%横结肠癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%降结肠癌%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%直肠癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乙状结肠癌%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%结肠恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%升结肠恶性肿瘤%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%横结肠恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%降结肠恶性肿瘤%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%直肠恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乙状结肠恶性肿瘤%'
)
) AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
  WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
    AND (
  dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%化学治疗%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%靶向治疗%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%免疫治疗%'
)
)
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

    v.PATIENT_ID 患者ID,
    v.Visit_id 住院次数,
    M.INP_NO 住院号,
    M.NAME 姓名,
    (
    SELECT
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE 
    FROM
      diagnosis ds 
    WHERE
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
      AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID 
      AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID 
      AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 出院主要诊断编码,
    (
    SELECT
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC 
    FROM
      diagnosis ds 
    WHERE
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
      AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID 
      AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID 
      AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 诊断名称,
    (
    SELECT
      OPERATION_CODE 
    FROM
      OPERATION OP 
    WHERE
      OP.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID 
      AND OP.VISIT_ID = V.VISIT_ID 
      AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 第一位手术编码,
    (
    SELECT
      OPERATION_DESC 
    FROM
      OPERATION OP 
    WHERE
      OP.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID 
      AND OP.VISIT_ID = V.VISIT_ID 
      AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 第一位手术名称,
    AD.DEPTNAME 入院科室,
    DD.DEPTNAME 出院科室,
    V.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME 入院时间,
    V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME 出院时间,
    ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER ( PARTITION BY v.PATIENT_ID ORDER BY v.Visit_id ) AS rn 
  FROM
    PAT_VISIT V
    LEFT JOIN PAT_MASTER_INDEX M ON V.PATIENT_ID = M.PATIENT_ID
    LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT AD ON V.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO = AD.DEPTCODE
    LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT DD ON V.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM = DD.DEPTCODE 
  WHERE
    V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= TO_DATE( '20210101', 'YYYYMMDD' ) 
    AND V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < TO_DATE( '20250101', 'YYYYMMDD' ) 
and (DD.Deptname like '胃肠%' )
    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1 
    FROM
      DIAGNOSIS DD 
    WHERE
      DD.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID 
      AND DD.VISIT_ID = V.VISIT_ID 
      AND DD.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
      AND ( DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%结肠癌%' OR DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%升结肠癌%' OR DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%横结肠癌%' OR DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%降结肠癌%' OR DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%直肠癌%' OR DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乙状结肠癌%' OR DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%结肠恶性肿瘤%' OR DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%升结肠恶性肿瘤%' OR DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%横结肠恶性肿瘤%' OR DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%降结肠恶性肿瘤%' OR DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%直肠恶性肿瘤%' OR DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乙状结肠恶性肿瘤%') 
    ) 
    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1 
    FROM
      OPERATION DD 
    WHERE
      DD.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID 
      AND DD.VISIT_ID = V.VISIT_ID 
    AND ( DD.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%化学治疗%' OR DD.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%靶向治疗%' OR DD.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%免疫治疗%') 
  )

-- CA-CRC-07 分母 | 胃肠外科 | 2025 | 颜色=black | 行=256 | 诊断:结直肠类 + 化学治疗/靶向治疗/免疫治疗 | 分子=hand | 写入=0
SELECT 
TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
(SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
(SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
(SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
(SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('040118','040119','040113','040125','040130')
  AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
  WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
    AND (
  dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%结肠癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%升结肠癌%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%横结肠癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%降结肠癌%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%直肠癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乙状结肠癌%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%结肠恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%升结肠恶性肿瘤%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%横结肠恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%降结肠恶性肿瘤%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%直肠恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乙状结肠恶性肿瘤%'
)
) AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
  WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
    AND (
  dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%化学治疗%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%靶向治疗%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%免疫治疗%'
)
)
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME
-- 合计人次:28 分年:{2025: 28}

      AND ROWNUM = 1

    (

    FROM

    WHERE
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
      AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID 
      AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID 
      AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 诊断名称,
    (
    SELECT
      OPERATION_CODE 
    FROM
      OPERATION OP 
    WHERE
      OP.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID 
      AND OP.VISIT_ID = V.VISIT_ID 
      AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 第一位手术编码,
    (
    SELECT
      OPERATION_DESC 
    FROM
      OPERATION OP 
    WHERE
      OP.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID

    DD.DEPTNAME 出院科室,
    V.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME 入院时间,

    ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER ( PARTITION BY v.PATIENT_ID ORDER BY v.Visit_id ) AS rn 
  FROM

    LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT AD ON V.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO = AD.DEPTCODE
