-- CA-CRC-09 分子 | 术后C级吻合口瘘 | 结直肠+手术+诊断吻合口瘘 | 核查修复 | 写入=0
SELECT 
TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
(SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
(SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
  WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
(SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
(SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('040118','040119','040113','040125','040130')
  AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
  WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
    AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
    AND (
  dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%结肠癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%升结肠癌%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%横结肠癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%降结肠癌%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%直肠癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乙状结肠癌%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%结肠恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%升结肠恶性肿瘤%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%横结肠恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%降结肠恶性肿瘤%'
  OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%直肠恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%乙状结肠恶性肿瘤%'
)
)
  AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
    WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
      AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%吻合口瘘%'
  )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

-- 口径来源：同编码体部放疗科 SQL；出院科室替换为已确认肿瘤科范围。
-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-CRC-11 分母 体部放疗科
-- 首次就诊=否
-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)
-- 科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'
-- 年份=[2024]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C18%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C19%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C20%')) AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'CT') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'MRI') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '超声') > 0)
UNION ALL
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
   NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记满%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
  ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C18%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C19%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C20%')) AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 'CT') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 'MRI') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, '超声') > 0)

         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('放疗科二','放疗科','肿瘤介入微创科','肿瘤综合科','肿瘤微创综合科','放疗中心','体部放疗科') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C18%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C19%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C20%')) AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'CT') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'MRI') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, '超声') > 0)

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,

, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v

JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx

 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
   NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记满%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'

 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt

  LEFT JOIN his.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
  LEFT JOIN his.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
    join

         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('放疗科二','放疗科','肿瘤介入微创科','肿瘤综合科','肿瘤微创综合科','放疗中心','体部放疗科') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C15%'))
UNION ALL
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
   NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记满%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
  ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('放疗科二','放疗科','肿瘤介入微创科','肿瘤综合科','肿瘤微创综合科','放疗中心','体部放疗科') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C15%'))

    AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
    AND ROWNUM = 1 
  ) 诊断名称,
        (SELECT OPERATION_CODE FROM     his.OPERATION OP WHERE OP.PATIENT_ID=V.PATIENT_ID AND OP.VISIT_ID=V.VISIT_ID AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) 第一位手术编码,
         (SELECT OPERATION_DESC FROM     his.OPERATION OP WHERE OP.PATIENT_ID=V.PATIENT_ID AND OP.VISIT_ID=V.VISIT_ID AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) 第一位手术名称,
  e.dept_name 入院科室,
  t.DEPT_NAME 出院科室,
  v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME 入院时间,
  v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME 出院时间,
  row_number() over (partition by v.patient_id order by v.visit_id   ) rw,rysj 送检病理,ZDYJ 病理意见,CLINICALDIAGNOSIS 病理诊断,HISTORYSUMMARY 
FROM
  his.pat_visit v
inner JOIN  his.lab_test_master t on t.patient_id=v.patient_id and t.visit_id=v.visit_id 
inner JOIN bl.pitaya t1 on t.test_no = t1.ReqNoteID
  LEFT JOIN his.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
  LEFT JOIN his.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
      LEFT JOIN his.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
     where exists  (select 1 from his.diagnosis dd
where dd.patient_id = v.patient_id and dd.visit_id = v.visit_id and dd.diagnosis_type='3'
and (dd.diagnosis_desc like'%食管%')
and (t1.rysj like '%癌%' or ZDYJ like '%癌%'   or CLINICALDIAGNOSIS like '%癌%'  or HISTORYSUMMARY like '%癌%'  )
)
and v.discharge_date_time>=to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and v.discharge_date_time<to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') 
and  t.dept_name like '胸外%')tt

-- ============================================================

-- 部分: 分子
-- 科室: 头颈外科 (020502)   年份: 2025
-- 口径: 在CA-EC-01分母基础上 AND 出院记录文书正文含T或N或M任一(按用户确认OR逻辑)
-- 文书: MTL(至2025-06-30) + JHEMR(从2024-06-01) UNION ALL
-- ============================================================
SELECT * FROM (
  -- MTL 段: 出院记录文书
  SELECT 'MTL' AS 文书系统,
         TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
         pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号, v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID, pmi.NAME AS 姓名, v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,

         (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
         (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
         v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
         t1.DOC_TITLE AS 文书名称, t1.DOC_SIGN_DATE AS 文书时间, t.UHID AS 文书唯一标识,
         DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容,2000,1) AS 文书内容
  FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t
  JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT t1 ON t.UHID=t1.UHID
  JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4 ON t4.UHID=t.UHID AND t4.段落编号=t1.ID
  JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON t.P_INPATIENT_NO=pmi.INP_NO
  JOIN HIS.PAT_VISIT v ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND t.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID
  WHERE NVL(t.DELETEMARK,0)=0 AND NVL(t1.DELETEMARK,0)=0
    AND t1.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
    AND (DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容,2000,1) LIKE '%T%'
      OR DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容,2000,1) LIKE '%N%'
      OR DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容,2000,1) LIKE '%M%')   -- 含T或N或M任一(OR)
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-07-01'   -- MTL取至2025-06-30
    AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM='020502'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
        AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%食管癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%食管恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%颈段食管癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%颈段食管恶性肿瘤%'))
  UNION ALL
  -- JHEMR 段: 出院记录文书
  SELECT 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
         TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,

         (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
         (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
         v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
         f.TOPIC AS 文书名称, f.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间, f.FILE_UNIQUE_ID AS 文书唯一标识,
         DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.MR_CONTENT,2000,1) AS 文书内容
  FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX f
  JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT c ON f.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=c.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
  JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON f.PATIENT_ID=pmi.PATIENT_ID
  JOIN HIS.PAT_VISIT v ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND f.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
  WHERE INSTR(f.TOPIC,'出院记录')>0
    AND (DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.MR_CONTENT,2000,1) LIKE '%T%'
      OR DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.MR_CONTENT,2000,1) LIKE '%N%'
      OR DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.MR_CONTENT,2000,1) LIKE '%M%')   -- 含T或N或M任一(OR)
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'   -- JHEMR覆盖2025全年
    AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM='020502'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
        AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%食管癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%食管恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%颈段食管癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%颈段食管恶性肿瘤%'))
) ORDER BY 年份, 出院时间

-- ============================================================

-- 部分: 分母
-- 科室: 头颈外科 (DEPT_CODE='020502', 经DEPT_DICT核对)
-- 年份: 2025 (DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= 2025-01-01 AND < 2026-01-01)
-- 口径: 出院科室=头颈外科 AND 病案首页出院诊断含食管癌/食管恶性肿瘤/颈段食管癌/颈段食管恶性肿瘤
-- ============================================================
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID=pmi.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM = '020502'   -- 头颈外科 出院科室精确IN
  AND EXISTS (   -- 病案首页出院诊断 含食管癌
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
        WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
          AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%食管癌%'
            OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%食管恶性肿瘤%'
            OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%颈段食管癌%'
            OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%颈段食管恶性肿瘤%')
      )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

-- 指标 CA-EC-02 分子 体部放疗科
-- 分子=分母人群+出院记录同时含T/N/M分期痕迹（三组AND，组内同义词OR）
-- 粒度=人次；科室='放疗科二','放疗科','肿瘤介入微创科','肿瘤综合科','肿瘤微创综合科','放疗中心','体部放疗科'

SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID

-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-EC-02 食管癌患者首次治疗前临床TNM分期检查评估策略符合率
-- 部分: 分子
-- 科室: 头颈外科 (020502)   年份: 2025
-- 口径: 在CA-EC-01分母基础上 AND 出院记录文书正文含T或N或M任一(按用户确认OR逻辑)
-- 文书: MTL(至2025-06-30) + JHEMR(从2024-06-01) UNION ALL
-- ============================================================
SELECT * FROM (
  -- MTL 段: 出院记录文书
  SELECT 'MTL' AS 文书系统,
         TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
         pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号, v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID, pmi.NAME AS 姓名, v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
         (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
         (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
         (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
         v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
         t1.DOC_TITLE AS 文书名称, t1.DOC_SIGN_DATE AS 文书时间, t.UHID AS 文书唯一标识,
         DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容,2000,1) AS 文书内容
  FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t
  JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT t1 ON t.UHID=t1.UHID
  JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4 ON t4.UHID=t.UHID AND t4.段落编号=t1.ID
  JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON t.P_INPATIENT_NO=pmi.INP_NO
  JOIN HIS.PAT_VISIT v ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND t.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID
  WHERE NVL(t.DELETEMARK,0)=0 AND NVL(t1.DELETEMARK,0)=0
    AND t1.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
    AND (DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容,2000,1) LIKE '%T%'
      OR DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容,2000,1) LIKE '%N%'
      OR DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容,2000,1) LIKE '%M%')   -- 含T或N或M任一(OR)
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-07-01'   -- MTL取至2025-06-30
    AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM='020502'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
        AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%食管癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%食管恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%颈段食管癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%颈段食管恶性肿瘤%'))
  UNION ALL
  -- JHEMR 段: 出院记录文书
  SELECT 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
         TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
         pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号, v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID, pmi.NAME AS 姓名, v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
         (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
         (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
         (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
         v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
         f.TOPIC AS 文书名称, f.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间, f.FILE_UNIQUE_ID AS 文书唯一标识,
         DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.MR_CONTENT,2000,1) AS 文书内容
  FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX f
  JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT c ON f.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=c.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
  JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON f.PATIENT_ID=pmi.PATIENT_ID
  JOIN HIS.PAT_VISIT v ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND f.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
  WHERE INSTR(f.TOPIC,'出院记录')>0
    AND (DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.MR_CONTENT,2000,1) LIKE '%T%'
      OR DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.MR_CONTENT,2000,1) LIKE '%N%'
      OR DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.MR_CONTENT,2000,1) LIKE '%M%')   -- 含T或N或M任一(OR)
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'   -- JHEMR覆盖2025全年
    AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM='020502'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
        AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%食管癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%食管恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%颈段食管癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%颈段食管恶性肿瘤%'))
) ORDER BY 年份, 出院时间

-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-EC-03 食管癌患者首次抗肿瘤治疗前病理学诊断率
-- 部分: 分子
-- 科室: 头颈外科 (020502)   年份: 2025
-- 口径: 在CA-EC-01分母基础上 AND 出院记录文书正文含T或N或M任一(按用户确认OR逻辑)
-- 文书: MTL(至2025-06-30) + JHEMR(从2024-06-01) UNION ALL
-- ============================================================
SELECT * FROM (
  -- MTL 段: 出院记录文书
  SELECT 'MTL' AS 文书系统,
         TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
         pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号, v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID, pmi.NAME AS 姓名, v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
         (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
         (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
         (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
         v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
         t1.DOC_TITLE AS 文书名称, t1.DOC_SIGN_DATE AS 文书时间, t.UHID AS 文书唯一标识,
         DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容,2000,1) AS 文书内容
  FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t
  JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT t1 ON t.UHID=t1.UHID
  JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4 ON t4.UHID=t.UHID AND t4.段落编号=t1.ID
  JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON t.P_INPATIENT_NO=pmi.INP_NO
  JOIN HIS.PAT_VISIT v ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND t.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID
  WHERE NVL(t.DELETEMARK,0)=0 AND NVL(t1.DELETEMARK,0)=0
    AND t1.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%'
    AND (DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容,2000,1) LIKE '%T%'
      OR DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容,2000,1) LIKE '%N%'
      OR DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容,2000,1) LIKE '%M%')   -- 含T或N或M任一(OR)
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-07-01'   -- MTL取至2025-06-30
    AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM='020502'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
        AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%食管癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%食管恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%颈段食管癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%颈段食管恶性肿瘤%'))
  UNION ALL
  -- JHEMR 段: 出院记录文书
  SELECT 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
         TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
         pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号, v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID, pmi.NAME AS 姓名, v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
         (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
         (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
         (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
         v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
         f.TOPIC AS 文书名称, f.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间, f.FILE_UNIQUE_ID AS 文书唯一标识,
         DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.MR_CONTENT,2000,1) AS 文书内容
  FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX f
  JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT c ON f.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=c.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
  JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON f.PATIENT_ID=pmi.PATIENT_ID
  JOIN HIS.PAT_VISIT v ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND f.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
  WHERE INSTR(f.TOPIC,'出院记录')>0
    AND (DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.MR_CONTENT,2000,1) LIKE '%T%'
      OR DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.MR_CONTENT,2000,1) LIKE '%N%'
      OR DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.MR_CONTENT,2000,1) LIKE '%M%')   -- 含T或N或M任一(OR)
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'   -- JHEMR覆盖2025全年
    AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM='020502'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
        AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%食管癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%食管恶性肿瘤%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%颈段食管癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%颈段食管恶性肿瘤%'))
) ORDER BY 年份, 出院时间

-- 口径: 出院科室=头颈外科 AND 病案首页出院诊断含食管癌 AND 有手术记录
-- 参考原SQL行300: 分母基础人群 + 手术记录文书

WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        q.年份, q.住院号, q.患者ID, q.姓名, q.住院次数,
        q.出院主要诊断编码, q.诊断名称, q.第一位手术编码, q.第一位手术名称,
        q.入院科室, q.出院科室, q.入院时间, q.出院时间
    FROM (
        SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
  ON ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('甲状腺疾病科')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%'
      )
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.OPERATION op0
    WHERE op0.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND op0.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
)
    ) q
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前小结%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前讨论%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%手术记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%病程%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别, d.文书时间, d.文书内容,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
               ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
           ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份, b.住院号 AS 住院号, b.患者ID AS 患者ID, b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数, b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称, b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称, b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室, b.入院时间 AS 入院时间, b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    d1.文书内容 AS 入院记录
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs d1
  ON d1.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND d1.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND d1.文书类别 = '入院记录'

-- 指标：CA-TC-02；部分：分子；负责科室：甲状腺疾病科一
-- 科室范围使用“甲状腺疾病科”；每次住院一行；同类文书取最新有效文书
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        q.年份, q.住院号, q.患者ID, q.姓名, q.住院次数,
        q.出院主要诊断编码, q.诊断名称, q.第一位手术编码, q.第一位手术名称,
        q.入院科室, q.出院科室, q.入院时间, q.出院时间
    FROM (
        SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
  ON ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
  ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('甲状腺疾病科')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%'
      )
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.OPERATION op0
    WHERE op0.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND op0.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
)
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01'
  AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
        OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前小结%'
        OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前讨论%'
        OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
        OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前小结%'
        OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前讨论%')
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(content.段落内容, '穿刺') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(content.段落内容, '细胞学穿刺') > 0)

UNION ALL
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
    idx.TOPIC AS 文书名称,
    idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间,
    TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
  ON ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
  ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('甲状腺疾病科')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'

-- 责任科室：甲状腺疾病科二
-- 科室范围：甲状腺疾病科二,乳腺疾病科二,乳腺疾病科二北区
-- 统计年度：2025；按出院时间、出院科室统计
-- 粒度：患者ID+住院次数；业务源库只读
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
  ON ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
  ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
-- MTL按确认的系统时间范围查询
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('甲状腺疾病科二','乳腺疾病科二','乳腺疾病科二北区')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%'
      )
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.OPERATION op0
    WHERE op0.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND op0.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
)
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01'
  AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%'
        OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前小结%'
        OR doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前讨论%'
        OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%'
        OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前小结%'
        OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前讨论%')
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(content.段落内容, '穿刺') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(content.段落内容, '细胞学穿刺') > 0)

UNION ALL
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,

    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,

    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
    idx.TOPIC AS 文书名称,
    idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间,
    TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK,0)=0 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c ON c.UHID=doc.UHID AND c.段落编号=doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C73%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'))
UNION ALL

SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND idx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG,0)=0 AND (NVL(idx.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院记录%' OR NVL(idx.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%出院记满%' OR NVL(idx.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%' OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME,' ') LIKE '%出院记录%')
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C73%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'))

-- 指标：CA-TC-03；部分：分母；负责科室：甲状腺疾病科一
-- 科室范围使用“甲状腺疾病科”；每次住院一行；同类文书取最新有效文书
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        q.年份, q.住院号, q.患者ID, q.姓名, q.住院次数,
        q.出院主要诊断编码, q.诊断名称, q.第一位手术编码, q.第一位手术名称,
        q.入院科室, q.出院科室, q.入院时间, q.出院时间
    FROM (
        SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
  ON ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('甲状腺疾病科')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%'
      )
)
    ) q
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前小结%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前讨论%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%手术记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%病程%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0

            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别, d.文书时间, d.文书内容,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
               ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
           ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份, b.住院号 AS 住院号, b.患者ID AS 患者ID, b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数, b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称, b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称, b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室, b.入院时间 AS 入院时间, b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    d1.文书内容 AS 入院记录
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs d1
  ON d1.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND d1.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND d1.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND d1.文书序号 = 1

-- 指标：CA-TC-04；部分：分子；负责科室：甲状腺疾病科一
-- 科室范围使用“甲状腺疾病科”；每次住院一行；同类文书取最新有效文书
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        q.年份, q.住院号, q.患者ID, q.姓名, q.住院次数,
        q.出院主要诊断编码, q.诊断名称, q.第一位手术编码, q.第一位手术名称,
        q.入院科室, q.出院科室, q.入院时间, q.出院时间
    FROM (
        SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
  ON ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('甲状腺疾病科')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%'
      )
)
    ) q
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前小结%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前讨论%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%手术记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%病程%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别, d.文书时间, d.文书内容,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
               ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
           ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份, b.住院号 AS 住院号, b.患者ID AS 患者ID, b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数, b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称, b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称, b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室, b.入院时间 AS 入院时间, b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    d1.文书内容 AS 出院记录
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs d1
  ON d1.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND d1.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND d1.文书类别 = '出院记录'
 AND d1.文书序号 = 1

WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(d1.文书内容, '(^|[^A-Za-z])([Tt][0-4Xx]|[Nn][0-3Xx]|[Mm][01Xx])([^A-Za-z]|$)')

        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
  ON ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('甲状腺疾病科二','乳腺疾病科二','乳腺疾病科二北区')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%'
      )
)

-- ============================================================
-- 指标: CA-TC-05 甲状腺疾病科 分子(2022_2024)
-- 科室: 甲状腺疾病科 IN ('040115') | 业务源库写入=0
-- 2026-07-21 修订: MTL文书条件去除P_OUTDATE过滤(活库实测为0001年脏值,旧版MTL分支全部失效);
--   分母去除病历文书输出列(一人一行); 分子阴性匹配改CLOB全文; 分子限定术后病程(术后首次病程 或 全切手术时间后的日常病程);
--   分子采用单遍文书扫描(negdocs)避免逐行EXISTS超时
-- ============================================================
WITH core_cohort AS (
    SELECT b.PATIENT_ID, b.VISIT_ID, b.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME, b.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,
           b.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO, b.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM, b.INP_NO, b.NAME
    FROM (
        SELECT v.PATIENT_ID, v.VISIT_ID, v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME, v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,
               v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO, v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM, pmi.INP_NO, pmi.NAME
        FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
        JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
        WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
          AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
          AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('040115')
          AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
                WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
                  AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
                  AND (
                        dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%'
                     OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
                     OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'
                     OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%'
                  )
          )
    ) b
    WHERE
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM HIS.OPERATION op
            WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = b.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = b.VISIT_ID
              AND (
                    op.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺全部切除%'
                 OR op.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺全切%'
              )
        )
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
            JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi
              ON mi.UHID = mid.UHID AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
             AND mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME = '手术记录'
            JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc
              ON mc.UHID = mi.UHID AND mc.段落编号 = mi.ID
            WHERE NVL(mid.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
              AND mid.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.INP_NO
              AND mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.VISIT_ID
              AND (
                    DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '甲状腺全部切除') > 0
                 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '甲状腺全切') > 0
                 OR NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE, ' ') LIKE '%甲状腺全部切除%'
                 OR NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE, ' ') LIKE '%甲状腺全切%'
              )
        )
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
            JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct
              ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
            WHERE ji.PATIENT_ID = b.PATIENT_ID
              AND ji.VISIT_ID = b.VISIT_ID
              AND NVL(ji.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
              AND ji.MR_CLASS IN ('EMR12.00', 'EMR10.00.07')
              AND INSTR(NVL(ji.TOPIC, ''), '手术记录') > 0
              AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01'
              AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
              AND (
                    DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '甲状腺全部切除') > 0
                 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '甲状腺全切') > 0
                 OR NVL(ji.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%甲状腺全部切除%'
                 OR NVL(ji.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%甲状腺全切%'
              )
        )
),
surg AS (
    SELECT op2.PATIENT_ID, op2.VISIT_ID, MIN(op2.OPERATING_DATE) AS T0
    FROM HIS.OPERATION op2
    WHERE (op2.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺全部切除%' OR op2.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺全切%')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core_cohort c2 WHERE c2.PATIENT_ID=op2.PATIENT_ID AND c2.VISIT_ID=op2.VISIT_ID)
    GROUP BY op2.PATIENT_ID, op2.VISIT_ID
),
negdocs AS (
    SELECT mid.P_INPATIENT_NO AS INP_NO, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS PAT_ID, mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES AS VISIT_TIMES
    FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi ON mi.UHID=mid.UHID AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK,0)=0
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc ON mc.UHID=mi.UHID AND mc.段落编号=mi.ID
    JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi2 ON pmi2.INP_NO=mid.P_INPATIENT_NO
    LEFT JOIN surg s2 ON s2.PATIENT_ID=pmi2.PATIENT_ID AND s2.VISIT_ID=mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES
    WHERE NVL(mid.DELETEMARK,0)=0
      AND mid.P_INPATIENT_NO IN (SELECT INP_NO FROM core_cohort)
      AND (mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术后首次病程%'
        OR (mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%日常病程%' AND mi.DOC_SIGN_DATE > NVL(s2.T0, DATE '1900-01-01')))
      AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容,'麻木')>0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容,'抽搐')>0)
      AND (
              DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无手足麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无手足抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无麻木抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无四肢麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无四肢抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '未诉手足麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '未诉手足抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '未诉麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '未诉抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无手足麻木抽搐') > 0
           OR REGEXP_LIKE(mc.段落内容, '无[^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']{0,12}(手足麻木|抽搐|四肢麻木|四肢抽搐|麻木抽搐)')
           OR REGEXP_LIKE(mc.段落内容, '未[^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']{0,8}(麻木|抽搐)')
          )
    GROUP BY mid.P_INPATIENT_NO, mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES
    UNION
    SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)), ji.PATIENT_ID, ji.VISIT_ID
    FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    LEFT JOIN surg s3 ON s3.PATIENT_ID=ji.PATIENT_ID AND s3.VISIT_ID=ji.VISIT_ID
    WHERE ji.PATIENT_ID IN (SELECT PATIENT_ID FROM core_cohort)
      AND NVL(ji.DELETE_FLAG,0)=0
      AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01' AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND (NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%术后首次病程%'
        OR (NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%病程%' AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME > NVL(s3.T0, DATE '1900-01-01')))
      AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT,'麻木')>0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT,'抽搐')>0)
      AND (
              DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无手足麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无手足抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无麻木抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无四肢麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无四肢抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '未诉手足麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '未诉手足抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '未诉麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '未诉抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无手足麻木抽搐') > 0
           OR REGEXP_LIKE(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无[^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']{0,12}(手足麻木|抽搐|四肢麻木|四肢抽搐|麻木抽搐)')
           OR REGEXP_LIKE(ct.MR_CONTENT, '未[^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']{0,8}(麻木|抽搐)')
          )
    GROUP BY ji.PATIENT_ID, ji.VISIT_ID
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(c.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    c.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    c.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    c.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    c.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = c.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = c.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = c.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = c.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = c.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = c.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    c.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    c.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM core_cohort c
WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM negdocs nd
        WHERE (nd.INP_NO = c.INP_NO OR nd.PAT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID)
          AND nd.VISIT_TIMES = c.VISIT_ID
      )
ORDER BY c.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME
-- 2022-2024分子(去重人次): 136（2022=30, 2023=71, 2024=35）

                 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '甲状腺全切') > 0
                 OR NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE, ' ') LIKE '%甲状腺全部切除%'
                 OR NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE, ' ') LIKE '%甲状腺全切%'
              )
        )
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
            JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct
              ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
            WHERE ji.PATIENT_ID = b.PATIENT_ID
              AND ji.VISIT_ID = b.VISIT_ID
              AND NVL(ji.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
              AND ji.MR_CLASS IN ('EMR12.00', 'EMR10.00.07')
              AND INSTR(NVL(ji.TOPIC, ''), '手术记录') > 0
              AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01'
              AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
              AND (
                    DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '甲状腺全部切除') > 0
                 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '甲状腺全切') > 0
                 OR NVL(ji.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%甲状腺全部切除%'
                 OR NVL(ji.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%甲状腺全切%'
              )
        )
),
surg AS (
    SELECT op2.PATIENT_ID, op2.VISIT_ID, MIN(op2.OPERATING_DATE) AS T0
    FROM HIS.OPERATION op2
    WHERE (op2.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺全部切除%' OR op2.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺全切%')
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core_cohort c2 WHERE c2.PATIENT_ID=op2.PATIENT_ID AND c2.VISIT_ID=op2.VISIT_ID)
    GROUP BY op2.PATIENT_ID, op2.VISIT_ID
),
negdocs AS (
    SELECT mid.P_INPATIENT_NO AS INP_NO, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS PAT_ID, mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES AS VISIT_TIMES
    FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi ON mi.UHID=mid.UHID AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK,0)=0
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc ON mc.UHID=mi.UHID AND mc.段落编号=mi.ID
    JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi2 ON pmi2.INP_NO=mid.P_INPATIENT_NO
    LEFT JOIN surg s2 ON s2.PATIENT_ID=pmi2.PATIENT_ID AND s2.VISIT_ID=mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES
    WHERE NVL(mid.DELETEMARK,0)=0
      AND mid.P_INPATIENT_NO IN (SELECT INP_NO FROM core_cohort)
      AND (mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术后首次病程%'
        OR (mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%日常病程%' AND mi.DOC_SIGN_DATE > NVL(s2.T0, DATE '1900-01-01')))
      AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容,'麻木')>0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容,'抽搐')>0)
      AND (
              DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无手足麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无手足抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无麻木抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无四肢麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无四肢抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '未诉手足麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '未诉手足抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '未诉麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '未诉抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '无手足麻木抽搐') > 0
           OR REGEXP_LIKE(mc.段落内容, '无[^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']{0,12}(手足麻木|抽搐|四肢麻木|四肢抽搐|麻木抽搐)')
           OR REGEXP_LIKE(mc.段落内容, '未[^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']{0,8}(麻木|抽搐)')
          )
    GROUP BY mid.P_INPATIENT_NO, mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES
    UNION
    SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)), ji.PATIENT_ID, ji.VISIT_ID
    FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    LEFT JOIN surg s3 ON s3.PATIENT_ID=ji.PATIENT_ID AND s3.VISIT_ID=ji.VISIT_ID
    WHERE ji.PATIENT_ID IN (SELECT PATIENT_ID FROM core_cohort)
      AND NVL(ji.DELETE_FLAG,0)=0
      AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01' AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND (NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%术后首次病程%'
        OR (NVL(ji.TOPIC,' ') LIKE '%病程%' AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME > NVL(s3.T0, DATE '1900-01-01')))
      AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT,'麻木')>0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT,'抽搐')>0)
      AND (
              DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无手足麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无手足抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无麻木抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无四肢麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无四肢抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '未诉手足麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '未诉手足抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '未诉麻木') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '未诉抽搐') > 0
           OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无手足麻木抽搐') > 0
           OR REGEXP_LIKE(ct.MR_CONTENT, '无[^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']{0,12}(手足麻木|抽搐|四肢麻木|四肢抽搐|麻木抽搐)')
           OR REGEXP_LIKE(ct.MR_CONTENT, '未[^' || CHR(13) || CHR(10) || ']{0,8}(麻木|抽搐)')
          )
    GROUP BY ji.PATIENT_ID, ji.VISIT_ID
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(c.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    c.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    c.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    c.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    c.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = c.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = c.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = c.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = c.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = c.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = c.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    c.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,

FROM core_cohort c
WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM negdocs nd
        WHERE (nd.INP_NO = c.INP_NO OR nd.PAT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID)
          AND nd.VISIT_TIMES = c.VISIT_ID

ORDER BY c.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

              AND INSTR(NVL(ji.TOPIC, ''), '手术记录') > 0
              AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01'
              AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2025-01-01'
              AND (

        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,

-- 2026-07-21 修订: MTL文书条件去除P_OUTDATE过滤(活库实测为0001年脏值,旧版MTL分支全部失效);
--   分母去除病历文书输出列(一人一行); 分子阴性匹配改CLOB全文; 分子限定术后病程(术后首次病程 或 全切手术时间后的日常病程);
--   分子采用单遍文书扫描(negdocs)避免逐行EXISTS超时
-- ============================================================
WITH core_cohort AS (
    SELECT b.PATIENT_ID, b.VISIT_ID, b.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME, b.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,
           b.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO, b.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM, b.INP_NO, b.NAME
    FROM (
        SELECT v.PATIENT_ID, v.VISIT_ID, v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME, v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,
               v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO, v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM, pmi.INP_NO, pmi.NAME
        FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
        JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
        WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
          AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
          AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('040115')
          AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
                WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
                  AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
                  AND (
                        dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%'
                     OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
                     OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'
                     OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%'
                  )
          )
    ) b
    WHERE
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM HIS.OPERATION op
            WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = b.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = b.VISIT_ID
              AND (
                    op.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺全部切除%'
                 OR op.OPERATION_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺全切%'
              )
        )
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
            JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi
              ON mi.UHID = mid.UHID AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
             AND mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME = '手术记录'
            JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc
              ON mc.UHID = mi.UHID AND mc.段落编号 = mi.ID
            WHERE NVL(mid.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
              AND mid.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.INP_NO
              AND mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.VISIT_ID
              AND (
                    DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '甲状腺全部切除') > 0
                 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(mc.段落内容, '甲状腺全切') > 0
                 OR NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE, ' ') LIKE '%甲状腺全部切除%'
                 OR NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE, ' ') LIKE '%甲状腺全切%'
              )
        )
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
            JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct
              ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
            WHERE ji.PATIENT_ID = b.PATIENT_ID
              AND ji.VISIT_ID = b.VISIT_ID
              AND NVL(ji.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
              AND ji.MR_CLASS IN ('EMR12.00', 'EMR10.00.07')
              AND INSTR(NVL(ji.TOPIC, ''), '手术记录') > 0
              AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
              AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
              AND (
                    DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '甲状腺全部切除') > 0
                 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, '甲状腺全切') > 0
                 OR NVL(ji.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%甲状腺全部切除%'
                 OR NVL(ji.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%甲状腺全切%'
              )
        )
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(c.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    c.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    c.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    c.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    c.NAME AS 姓名,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = c.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = c.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = c.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = c.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = c.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = c.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE = c.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    c.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    c.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM core_cohort c
ORDER BY c.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME
