-- 责任科室：甲状腺疾病科二
-- 科室范围：甲状腺疾病科二,乳腺疾病科二,乳腺疾病科二北区
-- 统计年度：2025；按出院时间、出院科室统计
-- 粒度：患者ID+住院次数；业务源库只读
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
  ON ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
  ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
-- MTL按确认的系统时间范围查询
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('甲状腺疾病科二','乳腺疾病科二','乳腺疾病科二北区')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%'
      )
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.OPERATION op0
    WHERE op0.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND op0.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
)
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01'
  AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%手术记录%'
        OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%手术记录%')
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(content.段落内容, '甲状腺全切') > 0)

UNION ALL
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
    idx.TOPIC AS 文书名称,
    idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间,
    TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
  ON ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
  ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
-- JHEMR按确认的系统时间范围查询，文书名称使用TOPIC
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('甲状腺疾病科二','乳腺疾病科二','乳腺疾病科二北区')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%'
      )
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.OPERATION op0
    WHERE op0.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND op0.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
)
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01'
  AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%手术记录%'
        OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%手术记录%')
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, '甲状腺全切') > 0)

       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,

               OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺未分化癌%'
               OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%')
      )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

-- 指标：CA-TC-06；部分：分母；负责科室：甲状腺疾病科一
-- 科室范围使用“甲状腺疾病科”；每次住院一行；同类文书取最新有效文书
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        q.年份, q.住院号, q.患者ID, q.姓名, q.住院次数,
        q.出院主要诊断编码, q.诊断名称, q.第一位手术编码, q.第一位手术名称,
        q.入院科室, q.出院科室, q.入院时间, q.出院时间
    FROM (
        SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
  ON ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('甲状腺疾病科')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%'
      )
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.OPERATION op0
    WHERE op0.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND op0.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
)
    ) q
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前小结%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前讨论%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%手术记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%病程%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别, d.文书时间, d.文书内容,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
               ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
           ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份, b.住院号 AS 住院号, b.患者ID AS 患者ID, b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数, b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称, b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称, b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室, b.入院时间 AS 入院时间, b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    d1.文书内容 AS 入院记录
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs d1
  ON d1.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND d1.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND d1.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND d1.文书序号 = 1

    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%'
      )
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.OPERATION op0
    WHERE op0.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND op0.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
)
    ) q
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前小结%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前讨论%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%手术记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%病程%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%入院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%入院记录%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%入院记录%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别, d.文书时间, d.文书内容,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
               ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
           ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份, b.住院号 AS 住院号, b.患者ID AS 患者ID, b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数, b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称, b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称, b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室, b.入院时间 AS 入院时间, b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    d1.文书内容 AS 入院记录
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs d1
  ON d1.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND d1.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND d1.文书类别 = '入院记录'
 AND d1.文书序号 = 1

-- 责任科室：甲状腺疾病科二
-- 科室范围：甲状腺疾病科二,乳腺疾病科二,乳腺疾病科二北区
-- 统计年度：2025；按出院时间、出院科室统计
-- 粒度：患者ID+住院次数；业务源库只读
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
  ON ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
-- 科室按“科室范围”列的当前名称精确过滤
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('甲状腺疾病科二','乳腺疾病科二','乳腺疾病科二北区')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%'
      )
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.OPERATION op0
    WHERE op0.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND op0.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
)

-- 科室范围使用“甲状腺疾病科”；每次住院一行；同类文书取最新有效文书
WITH base_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        q.年份, q.住院号, q.患者ID, q.姓名, q.住院次数,
        q.出院主要诊断编码, q.诊断名称, q.第一位手术编码, q.第一位手术名称,
        q.入院科室, q.出院科室, q.入院时间, q.出院时间
    FROM (
        SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'MTL' AS 文书系统,
    NVL(doc.DOC_TITLE, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME) AS 文书名称,
    doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
    dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
  ON ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
  ON content.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('甲状腺疾病科')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'

        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'

      )
)

    FROM HIS.OPERATION op0

      AND op0.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
)
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01'
  AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%病程%'
        OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%病程%')
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(content.段落内容, '发热') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(content.段落内容, '切口感染') > 0)

UNION ALL
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,

    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT dx1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
       FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx1
      WHERE dx1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND dx1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    ad.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
    idx.TOPIC AS 文书名称,
    idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间,
    TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识,
    DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
  ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT ad
  ON ad.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
  ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('甲状腺疾病科')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
      AND dx.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
      AND (
           dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺恶性肿瘤%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺髓样癌%'
        OR dx.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%甲状腺乳头状癌%'
      )
)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.OPERATION op0
    WHERE op0.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND op0.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
)
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01'
  AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%病程%'
        OR idx.TOPIC LIKE '%病程%')
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, '发热') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, '切口感染') > 0)
    ) q
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前小结%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前讨论%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%手术记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%病程%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%病程%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%病程%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%病程%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别, d.文书时间, d.文书内容,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
               ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
           ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份, b.住院号 AS 住院号, b.患者ID AS 患者ID, b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数, b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称, b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称, b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室, b.入院时间 AS 入院时间, b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    d1.文书内容 AS 病程记录
FROM base_cohort b

JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'

    SELECT 1
    FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dx
    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID

)
    ) q
),
doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前小结%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前讨论%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%手术记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%病程%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'

        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,

     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%病程%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%病程%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%病程%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'

ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别, d.文书时间, d.文书内容,

    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室, b.入院时间 AS 入院时间, b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,

        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'

        AND dx1.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'

        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_CODE
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1

        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1
        AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op1.OPERATION_DESC
       FROM HIS.OPERATION op1
      WHERE op1.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
        AND op1.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
        AND op1.OPERATION_NO = 1

    WHERE dx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
      AND dx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID

doc_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前小结%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%术前讨论%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%手术记录%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%病程%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END AS 文书类别,
        doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(content.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
      ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = b.住院号
     AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
      ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
     AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%病程%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%病程%')
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT content
      ON content.UHID = doc.UHID AND content.段落编号 = doc.ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 < DATE '2025-07-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        b.患者ID, b.住院次数,
        CASE
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%出院记录%' THEN '出院记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前小结%' THEN '术前小结'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%术前讨论%' THEN '术前讨论'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%手术记录%' THEN '手术记录'
            WHEN idx.TOPIC LIKE '%病程%' THEN '病程记录'
            ELSE '入院记录'
        END,
        idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME,
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1)
    FROM base_cohort b
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
      ON idx.PATIENT_ID = b.患者ID AND idx.VISIT_ID = b.住院次数
     AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
     AND (idx.TOPIC LIKE '%病程%')
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
      ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE b.出院时间 >= DATE '2024-06-01'
),
ranked_docs AS (
    SELECT d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别, d.文书时间, d.文书内容,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY d.患者ID, d.住院次数, d.文书类别
               ORDER BY d.文书时间 DESC NULLS LAST
           ) AS 文书序号
    FROM doc_candidates d
)
SELECT
    b.年份 AS 年份, b.住院号 AS 住院号, b.患者ID AS 患者ID, b.姓名 AS 姓名,
    b.住院次数 AS 住院次数, b.出院主要诊断编码 AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    b.诊断名称 AS 诊断名称, b.第一位手术编码 AS 第一位手术编码,
    b.第一位手术名称 AS 第一位手术名称, b.入院科室 AS 入院科室,
    b.出院科室 AS 出院科室, b.入院时间 AS 入院时间, b.出院时间 AS 出院时间,
    d1.文书内容 AS 病程记录
FROM base_cohort b
LEFT JOIN ranked_docs d1
  ON d1.患者ID = b.患者ID
 AND d1.住院次数 = b.住院次数
 AND d1.文书类别 = '病程记录'
 AND d1.文书序号 = 1

       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,

         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,

         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,

       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op

JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID

sqls.sql_annotated:
-- 口径来源：同编码体部放疗科 SQL；出院科室替换为已确认肿瘤科范围。
-- 统计年份：2024、2025；按出院时间归年。
-- 指标 CA-PCA-02 分子 体部放疗科
-- 分子=分母人群+出院记录同时含T/N/M分期痕迹（三组AND，组内同义词OR）
-- 粒度=人次；科室='肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三'

SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-07-01'
  AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C61%'))
  AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T2') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T3') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T4') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Tis') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Tis') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'TX') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Tx') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 2') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 3') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'T 4') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'cT') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'pT') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'yT') > 0) AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N2') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N3') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'NX') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Nx') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N 0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N 1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N 2') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'N 3') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'cN') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'pN') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'yN') > 0) AND (DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'M0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'M1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'MX') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'Mx') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'M 0') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'M 1') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'cM') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'pM') > 0 OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(c.段落内容, 'yM') > 0)
UNION ALL

SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统
, NVL(idx.TOPIC, idx.FILE_NAME) AS 文书名称
, idx.CREATE_DATE_TIME AS 文书时间
, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
  ON idx.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND idx.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG, 0) = 0
 AND (
   NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记满%'
   OR NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'
   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%入出院记录%'
 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
  ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'

-- 指标 CA-PCA-06 分母 体部放疗科
-- 首次就诊=否
-- 文书=出院记录
-- 粒度=人次(PATIENT_ID+VISIT_ID)
-- 科室='放疗科二','放疗科','肿瘤介入微创科','肿瘤综合科','肿瘤微创综合科','放疗中心','体部放疗科'
-- 年份=[2025]
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       pmi.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
         WHERE op.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND op.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       e.DEPT_NAME AS 入院科室,
       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'MTL' AS 文书系统
, doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME AS 文书名称
, doc.DOC_CREATE_DATE AS 文书时间
, dix.UHID || '-' || TO_CHAR(doc.ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
  ON dix.P_INPATIENT_NO = pmi.INP_NO
 AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = v.VISIT_ID
 AND NVL(dix.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc
  ON doc.UHID = dix.UHID
 AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK, 0) = 0
 AND doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%出院记录%'
JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT c
  ON c.UHID = doc.UHID
 AND c.段落编号 = doc.ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.DEPT_NAME IN ('肿瘤内科','肿瘤化疗一','肿瘤化疗二','血液、肿瘤化疗科一','血液、肿瘤化疗科二','血液、肿瘤化疗科三','肿瘤内科一','肿瘤内科二','生物治疗科','肿瘤内科五','肿瘤内科三') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'C61%'))
UNION ALL

       t.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间


, 'JHEMR' AS 文书系统

, TO_CHAR(idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID) AS 文书唯一标识
, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(txt.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 文书内容

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT t ON t.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT e ON e.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO

JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx

   NVL(idx.TOPIC, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'

   OR NVL(idx.FILE_NAME, ' ') LIKE '%出院记录%'

 )
LEFT JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT txt
  ON txt.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID

SELECT
v.PATIENT_ID 患者ID,
    v.Visit_id 住院次数,
    M.INP_NO 住院号,
    M.NAME 姓名,
    (
    SELECT
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE 
    FROM
      diagnosis ds 
    WHERE
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
      AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID 
      AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID 
      AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 出院主要诊断编码,
    (
    SELECT
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC 
    FROM
      diagnosis ds 
    WHERE
      ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
      AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID 
      AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID 
      AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 诊断名称,
    (
    SELECT
      OPERATION_CODE 
    FROM
      OPERATION OP 
    WHERE
      OP.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID 
      AND OP.VISIT_ID = V.VISIT_ID 
      AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 第一位手术编码,
    (
    SELECT
      OPERATION_DESC 
    FROM
      OPERATION OP 
    WHERE
      OP.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID 
      AND OP.VISIT_ID = V.VISIT_ID 
      AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 
      AND ROWNUM = 1 
    ) 第一位手术名称,
    AD.DEPTNAME 入院科室,
    DD.DEPTNAME 出院科室,
    V.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME 入院时间,
    V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME 出院时间,
    ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER ( PARTITION BY v.PATIENT_ID ORDER BY v.Visit_id ) AS rn 
  FROM
    PAT_VISIT V
    LEFT JOIN PAT_MASTER_INDEX M ON V.PATIENT_ID = M.PATIENT_ID
    LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT AD ON V.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO = AD.DEPTCODE
    LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT DD ON V.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM = DD.DEPTCODE 
  WHERE
    V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= TO_DATE( '20210101', 'YYYYMMDD' ) 
    AND V.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < TO_DATE( '20250101', 'YYYYMMDD' ) 
and  dd.deptname like '泌尿%'
    AND EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1 
    FROM
      DIAGNOSIS DD 
    WHERE
      DD.PATIENT_ID = V.PATIENT_ID 
      AND DD.VISIT_ID = V.VISIT_ID 
      AND DD.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 
      AND ( DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%前列腺癌%' OR DD.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%前列腺恶性肿瘤%') 
    )

           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
         WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
           AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS 诊断名称,

       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=tp.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=tp.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=tp.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=tp.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=tp.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=tp.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=tp.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=tp.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
       tp.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       tp.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
       tp.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION2 AS 离院方式编码,
       emo.文书系统 AS 文书系统,
       emo.入院记录名称 AS 入院记录名称,
       emo.入院记录时间 AS 入院记录时间,
       emo.入院记录唯一标识 AS 入院记录唯一标识,
       emo.入院记录正文 AS 入院记录正文_前2000字
FROM target_patients tp
LEFT JOIN (
    
    SELECT mid.P_INPATIENT_NO AS INP_NO, NULL AS PAT_ID, mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES AS VISIT_TIMES,
           'MTL' AS 文书系统,
           mi.DOC_TITLE AS 入院记录名称,
           mi.DOC_SIGN_DATE AS 入院记录时间,
           mid.UHID AS 入院记录唯一标识,
           DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容, 2000, 1) AS 入院记录正文
    FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
    JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi ON mi.UHID = mid.UHID AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK,0)=0
    JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc ON mc.UHID = mi.UHID AND mc.段落编号 = mi.ID
    WHERE NVL(mid.DELETEMARK,0)=0
      AND (INSTR(NVL(mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME,''),'入院')>0 OR INSTR(NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE,''),'入院')>0)
      AND mid.P_OUTDATE >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND mid.P_OUTDATE < DATE '2025-07-01'
      AND mid.P_INPATIENT_NO IN (SELECT INP_NO FROM target_patients)
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT NULL AS INP_NO, ji.PATIENT_ID AS PAT_ID, ji.VISIT_ID AS VISIT_TIMES,
           'JHEMR' AS 文书系统,
           ji.TOPIC AS 入院记录名称,
           ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME AS 入院记录时间,
           ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID AS 入院记录唯一标识,
           DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT, 2000, 1) AS 入院记录正文
    FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
    JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID = ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
    WHERE INSTR(NVL(ji.TOPIC,''),'入院')>0
      AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01' AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND ji.PATIENT_ID IN (SELECT PATIENT_ID FROM target_patients)
) emo ON (emo.INP_NO = tp.INP_NO OR emo.PAT_ID = tp.PATIENT_ID)
       AND emo.VISIT_TIMES = tp.VISIT_ID

ORDER BY tp.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

-- 年份: 2022-2025 (DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= 2022-01-01 AND < 2026-01-01, 按出院时间归年)
-- 执行环境: HIS_SOURCE 端 (MEDREC/ORDADM/COMM)
-- 分母: PHN初诊(PHN定义同PM-PHN-01)
-- ============================================================
SELECT TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
       pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
       v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
       pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
       v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
       (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM MEDREC.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
       (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM MEDREC.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
       (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM COMM.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
       v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
       v.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION2 AS 离院方式编码
FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN MEDREC.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON v.PATIENT_ID=pmi.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'

  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('030434','030439')   -- 疼痛科 出院科室精确IN

          AND (INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'带状疱疹性神经痛')>0
            OR (INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'带状疱疹后遗症')>0

                            WHERE dd2.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd2.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
                              AND dd2.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
                              AND INSTR(dd2.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'疼痛')>0)))
      )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

-- 口径: 分母 + 入院后24小时内医嘱含「疼痛综合评估」
-- 数据源: ODS HIS.* + HIS.ORDERS | 业务源库写入=0
SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'

  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
        WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
          AND (INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'癌')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'恶性肿瘤')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'肉瘤')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'白血病')>0)
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
        WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
          AND INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'疼痛')>0
      )

  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o
        WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL
          AND INSTR(o.ORDER_TEXT,'疼痛综合评估')>0
          AND o.ENTER_DATE_TIME >= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
          AND o.ENTER_DATE_TIME < v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME + 1
      )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

-- 指标: PM-CP-01 分子 | 科室: 肿瘤科 | 年份区间: [2022-01-01,2025-01-01)
-- 2026-07-21 按科室修订后口径重写：分母=科室范围7码+癌症诊断+NRS评分(移动护理YDHL疼痛模板,TOTAL_SCORE达标)
-- NRS疼痛模板: (29,722,579,780,781,294,717,719,381,382,530,674,582,568)（已排除营养NRS-2002）; 关联: INP_NO=MRN, VISIT_ID=SERIES, PATIENT_UID=PAT_INDEX_NO
-- 口径: 分母 + 入院24h内医嘱含疼痛综合评估
-- 数据源: ODS 单库(HIS.* + YDHL.*) | 业务源库写入=0
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
       (SELECT MAX(f.TOTAL_SCORE)
          FROM YDHL.INPATIENTS i
          JOIN YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM f ON f.PATIENT_UID=i.PAT_INDEX_NO
         WHERE i.MRN=pmi.INP_NO AND i.SERIES=v.VISIT_ID
           AND f.TEMPLATE_CODE IN (29,722,579,780,781,294,717,719,381,382,530,674,582,568)
           AND NVL(f.IS_VALID,'1')='1'
           AND f.TOTAL_SCORE >= 1
           AND f.FORM_TIME >= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
           AND f.FORM_TIME < v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME + 1
       ) AS 最高疼痛评分
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021704','021706','021707','021730','021731','021732','021740','021741','021743')
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
        WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
          AND (INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'癌')>0

-- NRS疼痛模板: (29,722,579,780,781,294,717,719,381,382,530,674,582,568)（已排除营养NRS-2002）; 关联: INP_NO=MRN, VISIT_ID=SERIES, PATIENT_UID=PAT_INDEX_NO
-- 口径: 科室为放疗科或肿瘤科,NRS评分>=1的癌症疼痛患者
-- 数据源: ODS 单库(HIS.* + YDHL.*) | 业务源库写入=0
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,

          AND (INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'癌')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'恶性肿瘤')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'肉瘤')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'白血病')>0)
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM YDHL.INPATIENTS i
        JOIN YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM f ON f.PATIENT_UID = i.PAT_INDEX_NO
        WHERE i.MRN = pmi.INP_NO AND i.SERIES = v.VISIT_ID

          AND f.FORM_TIME >= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME

      )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

-- 2026-07-21 按科室修订后口径重写：分母=科室范围7码+癌症诊断+NRS评分(移动护理YDHL疼痛模板,TOTAL_SCORE达标)
-- NRS疼痛模板: (29,722,579,780,781,294,717,719,381,382,530,674,582,568)（已排除营养NRS-2002）; 关联: INP_NO=MRN, VISIT_ID=SERIES, PATIENT_UID=PAT_INDEX_NO
-- 口径: 分母 + 入院24h内医嘱含疼痛综合评估
-- 数据源: ODS 单库(HIS.* + YDHL.*) | 业务源库写入=0
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
       (SELECT MAX(f.TOTAL_SCORE)
          FROM YDHL.INPATIENTS i
          JOIN YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM f ON f.PATIENT_UID=i.PAT_INDEX_NO
         WHERE i.MRN=pmi.INP_NO AND i.SERIES=v.VISIT_ID
           AND f.TEMPLATE_CODE IN (29,722,579,780,781,294,717,719,381,382,530,674,582,568)
           AND NVL(f.IS_VALID,'1')='1'
           AND f.TOTAL_SCORE >= 1
           AND f.FORM_TIME >= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
           AND f.FORM_TIME < v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME + 1
       ) AS 最高疼痛评分
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021703','021710','021714','021717','021718','021721','021738')
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
        WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
          AND (INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'癌')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'恶性肿瘤')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'肉瘤')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'白血病')>0)
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM YDHL.INPATIENTS i
        JOIN YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM f ON f.PATIENT_UID = i.PAT_INDEX_NO
        WHERE i.MRN = pmi.INP_NO AND i.SERIES = v.VISIT_ID
          AND f.TEMPLATE_CODE IN (29,722,579,780,781,294,717,719,381,382,530,674,582,568)
          AND NVL(f.IS_VALID,'1') = '1'
          AND f.TOTAL_SCORE >= 1
          AND f.FORM_TIME >= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
          AND f.FORM_TIME < v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME + 1
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o
        WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL
          AND INSTR(o.ORDER_TEXT,'疼痛综合评估')>0
          AND o.ENTER_DATE_TIME >= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
          AND o.ENTER_DATE_TIME < v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME + 1
      )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

-- 口径: 分母 + 医嘱含曲马多/路盖克/可普芬/地佐辛/吗啡/羟考酮/芬太尼(口径原7药,已按口径剔除布桂嗪)
-- 数据源: ODS 单库(HIS.* + YDHL.*) | 业务源库写入=0
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
       (SELECT MAX(f.TOTAL_SCORE)
          FROM YDHL.INPATIENTS i
          JOIN YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM f ON f.PATIENT_UID=i.PAT_INDEX_NO
         WHERE i.MRN=pmi.INP_NO AND i.SERIES=v.VISIT_ID
           AND f.TEMPLATE_CODE IN (29,722,579,780,781,294,717,719,381,382,530,674,582,568)
           AND NVL(f.IS_VALID,'1')='1'
           AND f.TOTAL_SCORE >= 4
           AND f.FORM_TIME >= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
           AND f.FORM_TIME < v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME + 1
       ) AS 最高疼痛评分
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021704','021706','021707','021730','021731','021732','021740','021741','021743')
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
        WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
          AND (INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'癌')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'恶性肿瘤')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'肉瘤')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'白血病')>0)
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM YDHL.INPATIENTS i
        JOIN YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM f ON f.PATIENT_UID = i.PAT_INDEX_NO
        WHERE i.MRN = pmi.INP_NO AND i.SERIES = v.VISIT_ID
          AND f.TEMPLATE_CODE IN (29,722,579,780,781,294,717,719,381,382,530,674,582,568)
          AND NVL(f.IS_VALID,'1') = '1'
          AND f.TOTAL_SCORE >= 4
          AND f.FORM_TIME >= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
          AND f.FORM_TIME < v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME + 1
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o
        WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL
          AND (INSTR(o.ORDER_TEXT,'曲马多')>0 OR INSTR(o.ORDER_TEXT,'路盖克')>0
            OR INSTR(o.ORDER_TEXT,'可普芬')>0 OR INSTR(o.ORDER_TEXT,'地佐辛')>0
            OR INSTR(o.ORDER_TEXT,'吗啡')>0 OR INSTR(o.ORDER_TEXT,'羟考酮')>0
            OR INSTR(o.ORDER_TEXT,'芬太尼')>0)
      )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

-- 2026-07-21 按科室修订后口径重写：分母=科室范围7码+癌症诊断+NRS评分(移动护理YDHL疼痛模板,TOTAL_SCORE达标)
-- NRS疼痛模板: (29,722,579,780,781,294,717,719,381,382,530,674,582,568)（已排除营养NRS-2002）; 关联: INP_NO=MRN, VISIT_ID=SERIES, PATIENT_UID=PAT_INDEX_NO
-- 口径: 科室为放疗科或体部放疗科,NRS评分>=4的癌症疼痛患者
-- 数据源: ODS 单库(HIS.* + YDHL.*) | 业务源库写入=0

    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
       (SELECT MAX(f.TOTAL_SCORE)

          JOIN YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM f ON f.PATIENT_UID=i.PAT_INDEX_NO
         WHERE i.MRN=pmi.INP_NO AND i.SERIES=v.VISIT_ID

          AND (INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'癌')>0

            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'肉瘤')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'白血病')>0)
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM YDHL.INPATIENTS i
        JOIN YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM f ON f.PATIENT_UID = i.PAT_INDEX_NO
        WHERE i.MRN = pmi.INP_NO AND i.SERIES = v.VISIT_ID
          AND f.TEMPLATE_CODE IN (29,722,579,780,781,294,717,719,381,382,530,674,582,568)
          AND NVL(f.IS_VALID,'1') = '1'
          AND f.TOTAL_SCORE >= 4
          AND f.FORM_TIME >= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
          AND f.FORM_TIME < v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME + 1
      )
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

(SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,

,
       NVL(v.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION2,v.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION) AS 离院方式编码,
       emo.文书系统, emo.病程文书名称, emo.病程文书时间, emo.病程文书唯一标识, emo.病程摘要 AS 病程摘要_前2000字
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID

JOIN (
  SELECT mid.P_INPATIENT_NO AS INP_NO, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS PAT_ID, mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES AS VISIT_TIMES,
         'MTL' AS 文书系统, mi.DOC_TITLE AS 病程文书名称, mi.DOC_SIGN_DATE AS 病程文书时间,
         mid.UHID AS 病程文书唯一标识, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容,2000,1) AS 病程摘要
  FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
  JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi ON mi.UHID=mid.UHID AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK,0)=0
  JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc ON mc.UHID=mi.UHID AND mc.段落编号=mi.ID
  WHERE NVL(mid.DELETEMARK,0)=0
    AND (INSTR(NVL(mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME,''),'病程')>0 OR INSTR(NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE,''),'病程')>0)
    AND mid.P_OUTDATE >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND mid.P_OUTDATE < DATE '2025-07-01'
    AND INSTR(mc.段落内容,'转移')>0 AND INSTR(mc.段落内容,'疼痛')>0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)), ji.PATIENT_ID, ji.VISIT_ID,
         'JHEMR', ji.TOPIC, ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME,
         ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT,2000,1)
  FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
  JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
  WHERE (INSTR(NVL(ji.MR_CLASS,''),'EMR10.00.0')>0 OR INSTR(NVL(ji.TOPIC,''),'病程')>0)
    AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01' AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT,'转移')>0 AND INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT,'疼痛')>0
) emo ON (emo.INP_NO=pmi.INP_NO OR emo.PAT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID) AND emo.VISIT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'

  AND NVL(v.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION2, v.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION) IN ('1','4')
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

  WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
(SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间
,
       emo.文书系统, emo.病程文书名称, emo.病程文书时间, emo.病程文书唯一标识, emo.病程摘要 AS 病程摘要_前2000字
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID

JOIN (
  SELECT mid.P_INPATIENT_NO AS INP_NO, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS PAT_ID, mid.P_INPATIENT_TIMES AS VISIT_TIMES,
         'MTL' AS 文书系统, mi.DOC_TITLE AS 病程文书名称, mi.DOC_SIGN_DATE AS 病程文书时间,
         mid.UHID AS 病程文书唯一标识, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(mc.段落内容,2000,1) AS 病程摘要
  FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX mid
  JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT mi ON mi.UHID=mid.UHID AND NVL(mi.DELETEMARK,0)=0
  JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT mc ON mc.UHID=mi.UHID AND mc.段落编号=mi.ID
  WHERE NVL(mid.DELETEMARK,0)=0
    AND (INSTR(NVL(mi.DOC_TYPE_NAME,''),'病程')>0 OR INSTR(NVL(mi.DOC_TITLE,''),'病程')>0)
    AND mid.P_OUTDATE >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND mid.P_OUTDATE < DATE '2025-07-01'
    AND INSTR(mc.段落内容,'转移')>0 AND INSTR(mc.段落内容,'疼痛')>0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)), ji.PATIENT_ID, ji.VISIT_ID,
         'JHEMR', ji.TOPIC, ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME,
         ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT,2000,1)
  FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX ji
  JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT ct ON ct.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=ji.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
  WHERE (INSTR(NVL(ji.MR_CLASS,''),'EMR10.00.0')>0 OR INSTR(NVL(ji.TOPIC,''),'病程')>0)
    AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-06-01' AND ji.FIRST_MR_SIGN_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT,'转移')>0 AND INSTR(ct.MR_CONTENT,'疼痛')>0
) emo ON (emo.INP_NO=pmi.INP_NO OR emo.PAT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID) AND emo.VISIT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021729','021735')
ORDER BY v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

-- 2026-07-21 按科室修订后口径重写：分母=科室范围7码+癌症诊断+NRS评分(移动护理YDHL疼痛模板,TOTAL_SCORE达标)
-- NRS疼痛模板: (29,722,579,780,781,294,717,719,381,382,530,674,582,568)（已排除营养NRS-2002）; 关联: INP_NO=MRN, VISIT_ID=SERIES, PATIENT_UID=PAT_INDEX_NO
-- 口径: 科室为放疗科或体部放疗科,NRS评分>=4的癌症疼痛患者; 分子为出院后7天随访(纸质随访本),不取数
-- 数据源: ODS 单库(HIS.* + YDHL.*) | 业务源库写入=0
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds
      WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op
      WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
        AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT d.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT d WHERE d.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) AS 出院科室,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
       (SELECT MAX(f.TOTAL_SCORE)
          FROM YDHL.INPATIENTS i
          JOIN YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM f ON f.PATIENT_UID=i.PAT_INDEX_NO
         WHERE i.MRN=pmi.INP_NO AND i.SERIES=v.VISIT_ID
           AND f.TEMPLATE_CODE IN (29,722,579,780,781,294,717,719,381,382,530,674,582,568)
           AND NVL(f.IS_VALID,'1')='1'
           AND f.TOTAL_SCORE >= 4
           AND f.FORM_TIME >= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
           AND f.FORM_TIME < v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME + 1
       ) AS 最高疼痛评分
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v

  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN ('021703','021710','021714','021717','021718','021721','021738')
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
        WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
          AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
          AND (INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'癌')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'恶性肿瘤')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'肉瘤')>0
            OR INSTR(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'白血病')>0)
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM YDHL.INPATIENTS i
        JOIN YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM f ON f.PATIENT_UID = i.PAT_INDEX_NO
        WHERE i.MRN = pmi.INP_NO AND i.SERIES = v.VISIT_ID
          AND f.TEMPLATE_CODE IN (29,722,579,780,781,294,717,719,381,382,530,674,582,568)

          AND f.TOTAL_SCORE >= 4
          AND f.FORM_TIME >= v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
          AND f.FORM_TIME < v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME + 1

-- 指标：ID-FLU-01；负责部门/科室：感染性疾病科
-- 门诊指标按就诊日期归年，并精确过滤就诊科室“感染性疾病科”
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM OUTPDOCT.OUTP_MR mr
        WHERE mr.PATIENT_ID = cm.PATIENT_ID
          AND mr.VISIT_DATE = cm.VISIT_DATE
          AND mr.VISIT_NO = cm.VISIT_NO
          AND (NVL(mr.ILLNESS_DESC,'') || NVL(mr.ANAMNESIS,'') ||
               NVL(mr.DIAG_DESC,'') || NVL(mr.MEDICAL_RECORD,'') ||
               NVL(mr.MEMO,'')) LIKE '%流感抗原阳性%'
    ) THEN cm.PATIENT_ID || '-' || TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE,'yyyymmdd') || '-' || TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_NO) END) AS 分子,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cm.PATIENT_ID || '-' || TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE,'yyyymmdd') || '-' || TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_NO)) AS 分母
FROM OUTPADM.CLINIC_MASTER cm
JOIN COMM.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE = cm.VISIT_DEPT
WHERE cm.VISIT_DATE >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND cm.VISIT_DATE < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('感染性疾病科','感染性疾病科门诊')
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM OUTPBILL.OUTP_RCPT_MASTER rm
        JOIN OUTPBILL.OUTP_BILL_ITEMS bi ON bi.RCPT_NO = rm.RCPT_NO
        WHERE rm.PATIENT_ID = cm.PATIENT_ID
          AND rm.BZ = cm.CLINIC_NO
          AND (bi.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%奥司他韦%' OR bi.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%玛巴洛沙韦%' OR bi.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%帕拉米韦%')
    )
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE, 'yyyy')
ORDER BY 年份

-- 指标：ID-FLU-02；负责部门/科室：感染性疾病科
-- 门诊指标按就诊日期归年，并精确过滤就诊科室“感染性疾病科”
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM OUTPBILL.OUTP_RCPT_MASTER rm
        JOIN OUTPBILL.OUTP_BILL_ITEMS bi ON bi.RCPT_NO = rm.RCPT_NO
        WHERE rm.PATIENT_ID = cm.PATIENT_ID
          AND rm.BZ = cm.CLINIC_NO
          AND (bi.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%阿莫西林%' OR bi.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%头孢%' OR bi.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%左氧氟沙星%' OR bi.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%罗红霉素%' OR bi.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%阿奇霉素%' OR bi.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%依替米星%')
    ) THEN cm.PATIENT_ID || '-' || TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE,'yyyymmdd') || '-' || TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_NO) END) AS 分子,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cm.PATIENT_ID || '-' || TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE,'yyyymmdd') || '-' || TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_NO)) AS 分母
FROM OUTPADM.CLINIC_MASTER cm
JOIN COMM.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE = cm.VISIT_DEPT
WHERE cm.VISIT_DATE >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND cm.VISIT_DATE < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('感染性疾病科','感染性疾病科门诊')

        SELECT 1
        FROM OUTPDOCT.OUTP_MR_DIAG_DESC od

    )
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE, 'yyyy')
ORDER BY 年份

            WHERE r.PATIENT_ID=c.PATIENT_ID AND TRUNC(r.VISIT_DATE)=TRUNC(c.VISIT_DATE)
              AND  ITEM_CODE in (

-- 指标：ID-ID-01；负责部门/科室：感染性疾病科

SELECT
    TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS 分子,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cm.PATIENT_ID || '-' || TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE,'yyyymmdd') || '-' || TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_NO)) AS 分母
FROM OUTPADM.CLINIC_MASTER cm
JOIN COMM.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE = cm.VISIT_DEPT

  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('感染性疾病科','感染性疾病科门诊')
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM OUTPDOCT.OUTP_MR_DIAG_DESC od
        WHERE od.PATIENT_ID = cm.PATIENT_ID
          AND od.VISIT_NO = cm.VISIT_NO
          AND (od.DIAG_DESC LIKE '%感染性腹泻%' OR od.DIAG_DESC LIKE '%肠炎%')
    )
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE, 'yyyy')
ORDER BY 年份

-- 指标：ID-ID-02；负责部门/科室：感染性疾病科
-- 门诊指标按就诊日期归年，并精确过滤就诊科室“感染性疾病科”
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM OUTPBILL.OUTP_RCPT_MASTER rm
        JOIN OUTPBILL.OUTP_BILL_ITEMS bi ON bi.RCPT_NO = rm.RCPT_NO
        WHERE rm.PATIENT_ID = cm.PATIENT_ID
          AND rm.BZ = cm.CLINIC_NO
          AND (bi.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%左氧氟沙星%' OR bi.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%头孢%' OR bi.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%依替米星%' OR bi.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%利福昔明%')
    ) THEN cm.PATIENT_ID || '-' || TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE,'yyyymmdd') || '-' || TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_NO) END) AS 分子,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cm.PATIENT_ID || '-' || TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE,'yyyymmdd') || '-' || TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_NO)) AS 分母
FROM OUTPADM.CLINIC_MASTER cm
JOIN COMM.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE = cm.VISIT_DEPT
WHERE cm.VISIT_DATE >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND cm.VISIT_DATE < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND dd.DEPT_NAME IN ('感染性疾病科','感染性疾病科门诊')
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM OUTPDOCT.OUTP_MR_DIAG_DESC od
        WHERE od.PATIENT_ID = cm.PATIENT_ID
          AND od.VISIT_NO = cm.VISIT_NO
          AND (od.DIAG_DESC LIKE '%感染性腹泻%' OR od.DIAG_DESC LIKE '%肠炎%')
    )
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(cm.VISIT_DATE, 'yyyy')
ORDER BY 年份

SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,'yyyy') AS 年份,
    '住院' AS 就诊类型,
    v.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    v.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 就诊时间,
    v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院主要诊断编码,
    (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS ds WHERE ds.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 诊断名称,
    (SELECT ad.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT ad WHERE ad.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO AND ROWNUM=1) AS 入院科室,
    (SELECT dd2.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT dd2 WHERE dd2.DEPT_CODE=v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM AND ROWNUM=1) AS 出院科室,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_CODE FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术编码,
    (SELECT op.OPERATION_DESC FROM HIS.OPERATION op WHERE op.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND op.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID AND op.OPERATION_NO=1 AND ROWNUM=1) AS 第一位手术名称
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID
WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2027-01-01'
  AND v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM IN  ('030503','030505','030507','030508','030509','030511','030504','030511','030512')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd WHERE dd.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dd.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
            AND dd.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3' AND (dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%肠炎%' OR dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC LIKE '%胃肠炎%'))
  AND (
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HIS.ORDERS o WHERE o.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND o.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
            AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL AND (o.ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%口服补液盐%'))
    OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX dix
            JOIN MTL.EPR_INPATIENT doc ON doc.UHID=dix.UHID AND NVL(doc.DELETEMARK,0)=0
            JOIN MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT ct ON ct.UHID=doc.UHID AND ct.段落编号=doc.ID
            JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi2 ON pmi2.INP_NO=dix.P_INPATIENT_NO
            WHERE NVL(dix.DELETEMARK,0)=0
              AND (doc.DOC_TYPE_NAME LIKE '%首次病程%' OR doc.DOC_TITLE LIKE '%首次病程%')
              AND pmi2.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND dix.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=v.VISIT_ID
              AND DBMS_LOB.INSTR(ct.段落内容,'口服补液盐')>0)
    OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_INDEX idx
            JOIN JHEMR.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT t ON t.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=idx.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
            WHERE idx.PATIENT_ID=v.PATIENT_ID AND idx.VISIT_ID=v.VISIT_ID
              AND NVL(idx.DELETE_FLAG,0)=0 AND idx.TOPIC LIKE '%首次病程%'
              AND DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t.MR_CONTENT,'口服补液盐')>0)
  )
UNION ALL
SELECT

    '门诊' AS 就诊类型,

      AND (d.DIAG_DESC LIKE '%肠炎%' OR d.DIAG_DESC LIKE '%胃肠炎%')
    UNION
    SELECT mr.VISIT_DATE, mr.PATIENT_ID, c.NAME, mr.VISIT_NO, mr.DIAG_DESC, c.DOCTOR_DEPT,
           (SELECT dd4.DEPT_NAME FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT dd4 WHERE dd4.DEPT_CODE=c.DOCTOR_DEPT AND ROWNUM=1)

    JOIN HIS.CLINIC_MASTER c ON c.PATIENT_ID=mr.PATIENT_ID AND c.VISIT_DATE=mr.VISIT_DATE AND c.VISIT_NO=mr.VISIT_NO
    WHERE mr.VISIT_DATE >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND mr.VISIT_DATE < DATE '2027-01-01'
      AND (c.DOCTOR_DEPT IN  ('030503','030505','030507','030508','030509','030511','030504','030511','030512')OR c.VISIT_DEPT IN  ('030503','030505','030507','030508','030509','030511','030504','030511','030512'))
      AND (NVL(mr.DIAG_DESC,' ') LIKE '%肠炎%' OR NVL(mr.DIAG_DESC,' ') LIKE '%胃肠炎%')

WHERE EXISTS (

-- 指标：ID-HC-01；2022—2025年首次检出HCV抗体阳性患者HCV-RNA检测
-- LAB_RESULT为巨表，始终通过LAB_TEST_MASTER.TEST_NO受限关联
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(x.首次抗体阳性时间, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM LAB.LAB_TEST_MASTER tm2
        JOIN LAB.LAB_RESULT lr2 ON lr2.TEST_NO = tm2.TEST_NO
        WHERE tm2.PATIENT_ID = x.PATIENT_ID
          AND NVL(tm2.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME, lr2.RESULT_DATE_TIME) >= x.首次抗体阳性时间
          AND NVL(tm2.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME, lr2.RESULT_DATE_TIME) < DATE '2026-01-01'
          AND (lr2.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%HCV%RNA%' OR lr2.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%丙肝病毒%RNA%'
               OR lr2.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%丙型肝炎病毒%RNA%')
    ) THEN x.PATIENT_ID END) AS 分子,
    COUNT(DISTINCT x.PATIENT_ID) AS 分母
FROM (
    SELECT
        tm.PATIENT_ID,
        MIN(NVL(tm.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME, lr.RESULT_DATE_TIME)) AS 首次抗体阳性时间
    FROM LAB.LAB_TEST_MASTER tm
    JOIN LAB.LAB_RESULT lr ON lr.TEST_NO = tm.TEST_NO
    WHERE NVL(tm.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME, lr.RESULT_DATE_TIME) >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND NVL(tm.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME, lr.RESULT_DATE_TIME) < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND (lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%HCV%抗体%' OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%丙肝抗体%'
           OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%丙型肝炎病毒抗体%')
      -- 活库值域显示丙肝抗体阳性主要标记为H，另兼容文本阳性及P标志
      AND (lr.RESULT LIKE '%阳性%' OR UPPER(lr.RESULT) LIKE '%POSITIVE%'
           OR lr.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR IN ('H','P'))
    GROUP BY tm.PATIENT_ID
) x
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(x.首次抗体阳性时间, 'yyyy')
ORDER BY 年份

sqls.sql_annotated:
WITH anesthesia_cases AS (
    SELECT
        TO_CHAR(m.start_date_time, 'yyyy') AS year_label,
        m.patient_id,
        m.visit_id,
        m.oper_id,
        CASE
            WHEN NVL(m.blood_transfered, 0) > 0
              OR NVL(m.blood_whole_self, 0) > 0
              OR NVL(m.blood_whole, 0) > 0
              OR NVL(m.blood_rbc, 0) > 0
              OR NVL(m.blood_plasm, 0) > 0
              OR NVL(m.blood_other, 0) > 0
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS transfusion_flag
    FROM medsurgery.med_operation_master m
    WHERE m.start_date_time >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND m.start_date_time <  DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND m.oper_status >= 35
      AND m.patient_id IS NOT NULL
      AND m.anesthesia_method IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(m.anesthesia_method) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    year_label AS "年份",
    COUNT(*) AS "同期麻醉手术台次",
    SUM(transfusion_flag) AS "接受输血手术台次",
    ROUND(
        SUM(transfusion_flag)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
        * 100,
        2
    ) AS "手术台次比例百分比"
FROM anesthesia_cases
GROUP BY year_label
ORDER BY year_label;

sqls.sql_annotated:
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(m.start_date_time, 'yyyy') AS "年份",
    COUNT(DISTINCT
        m.patient_id || '|' ||
        TO_CHAR(m.visit_id) || '|' ||
        TO_CHAR(m.oper_id)
    ) AS "低体温手术台数"
FROM medsurgery.med_operation_master m
JOIN medsurgery.med_anesthesia_input_data i
  ON i.patient_id = m.patient_id
 AND i.visit_id   = m.visit_id
 AND i.oper_id    = m.oper_id
WHERE m.start_date_time >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND m.start_date_time <  DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND m.oper_status >= 35
  AND m.anesthesia_method LIKE '%全身麻醉%'
  AND i.temperature_in_oper = 1
  AND NVL(m.operation_name, ' ') NOT LIKE '%气管切开%'
  AND NVL(m.operation_name, ' ') NOT LIKE '%气管造口再造%'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM medcomm.med_vital_sign_merge v
      WHERE v.patient_id = m.patient_id
        AND v.visit_id   = m.visit_id
        AND v.oper_id    = m.oper_id
        AND v.item_code IN (
            '100', '50006', '104', '105', '106',
            '107', '1012', '3203', '3204', '3205'
        )
        AND v.time_point >= NVL(m.anes_start_time, m.start_date_time)
        AND v.time_point <= NVL(m.anes_end_time, m.end_date_time)
        AND REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(v.item_value), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
        AND TO_NUMBER(TRIM(v.item_value)) >= 25
        AND TO_NUMBER(TRIM(v.item_value)) < 36
  )
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(m.start_date_time, 'yyyy')
ORDER BY 1;
