-- 麻醉专业 AQI-IUR-19 分子，年份=2025
-- MED_CUSTOM_DATA仅通过患者ID+住院次数+手术序号受限关联，避免全表扫描。
-- 口径原文：分子=麻醉质控单→非计划二次气管插管 勾选是的手术。
-- 值域核查结论：麻醉质控单的勾选项未镜像到ODS——SM.MED_CUSTOM_DATA中'麻醉质控%'前缀
-- 仅有'麻醉质控.签名日期'/'麻醉质控.麻醉医师签名'/'麻醉质控单.PDF'/'麻醉质控国标.PDF'（2022-2025多年核查），
-- 无'非计划二次气管插管'项目；SM schema下亦无麻醉质控专用表，MED_ANESTHESIA_SUMMARY为187个无字典
-- 证据的字母列，不得猜测列含义。
-- 替代取数（待确认）：术后访视记录单'麻醉术后访视.再插管1'勾选'是'即术后非计划再插管事件，
-- 2025年值域为 是=3、否=13931、NULL=657，本SQL按该勾选取数，口径待科室确认后修订。
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(m.START_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    m.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    m.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    m.OPER_ID AS 手术序号,
    m.OPERATION_NAME AS 手术名称,
    m.ANESTHESIA_METHOD AS 麻醉方式,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 患者科室,
    m.IN_DATE_TIME AS 入手术室时间,
    m.ANES_START_TIME AS 麻醉开始时间,
    m.ANES_END_TIME AS 麻醉结束时间,
    m.START_DATE_TIME AS 手术开始时间,
    m.END_DATE_TIME AS 手术结束时间,
    m.IN_PACU_DATE_TIME AS 入PACU时间,
    m.OUT_PACU_DATE_TIME AS 出PACU时间
FROM SM.MED_OPERATION_MASTER m
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=m.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=m.DEPT_STAYED
WHERE
    -- 手麻指标按手术开始时间归年；按自然年分片防止明细截断。
    m.START_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND m.START_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
    -- 以下为本指标分子或分母的正式条件。
    -- 分子（替代口径，待确认）=术后访视记录单中再插管勾选'是'的手术。
    AND m.OPER_STATUS >= 35 AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM SM.MED_CUSTOM_DATA cd
        WHERE cd.PATIENT_ID=m.PATIENT_ID AND cd.VISIT_ID=m.VISIT_ID AND cd.OPER_ID=m.OPER_ID
          AND cd.ITEM_NAME IN ('麻醉术后访视.再插管1') AND cd.ITEM_VALUE = '是'
    )

-- 口径原文：分子=麻醉质控单→非计划二次气管插管 勾选是的手术。
-- 值域核查结论：麻醉质控单的勾选项未镜像到ODS——SM.MED_CUSTOM_DATA中'麻醉质控%'前缀
-- 仅有'麻醉质控.签名日期'/'麻醉质控.麻醉医师签名'/'麻醉质控单.PDF'/'麻醉质控国标.PDF'（2022-2025多年核查），
-- 无'非计划二次气管插管'项目；SM schema下亦无麻醉质控专用表，MED_ANESTHESIA_SUMMARY为187个无字典
-- 证据的字母列，不得猜测列含义。
-- 替代取数（待确认）：术后访视记录单'麻醉术后访视.再插管1'勾选'是'即术后非计划再插管事件，
-- 2025年值域为 是=3、否=13931、NULL=657，本SQL按该勾选取数，口径待科室确认后修订。
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(m.START_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    m.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    m.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    m.OPER_ID AS 手术序号,
    m.OPERATION_NAME AS 手术名称,
    m.ANESTHESIA_METHOD AS 麻醉方式,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 患者科室,
    m.IN_DATE_TIME AS 入手术室时间,
    m.ANES_START_TIME AS 麻醉开始时间,
    m.ANES_END_TIME AS 麻醉结束时间,
    m.START_DATE_TIME AS 手术开始时间,
    m.END_DATE_TIME AS 手术结束时间,
    m.IN_PACU_DATE_TIME AS 入PACU时间,
    m.OUT_PACU_DATE_TIME AS 出PACU时间
FROM SM.MED_OPERATION_MASTER m
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=m.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=m.DEPT_STAYED
WHERE
    -- 手麻指标按手术开始时间归年；按自然年分片防止明细截断。
    m.START_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
    AND m.START_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
    -- 以下为本指标分子或分母的正式条件。
    -- 分子（替代口径，待确认）=术后访视记录单中再插管勾选'是'的手术。
    AND m.OPER_STATUS >= 35 AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM SM.MED_CUSTOM_DATA cd
        WHERE cd.PATIENT_ID=m.PATIENT_ID AND cd.VISIT_ID=m.VISIT_ID AND cd.OPER_ID=m.OPER_ID
          AND cd.ITEM_NAME IN ('麻醉术后访视.再插管1') AND cd.ITEM_VALUE = '是'
    )
SELECT *  FROM SM.MED_CUSTOM_DATA cd where  ITEM_NAME like '%麻醉术后访视%气管导管拔除%'

    AND m.START_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
    -- 以下为本指标分子或分母的正式条件。
    -- 分母=术后访视记录单中气管导管拔除勾选'是'的手术。
    AND m.OPER_STATUS >= 35 AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM SM.MED_CUSTOM_DATA cd
        WHERE cd.PATIENT_ID=m.PATIENT_ID AND cd.VISIT_ID=m.VISIT_ID AND cd.OPER_ID=m.OPER_ID
          AND cd.ITEM_NAME IN ('麻醉术后访视.气管导管拔除1') AND cd.ITEM_VALUE = '是'

-- 麻醉专业 AQI-TPM-25 分子（麻醉后24小时内死亡），年份=2025
-- 证据：HIS.ORDERS 中 ORDER_TEXT LIKE '%临床死亡%' 2025 年存在 500 余条（含「临床死亡（补）」等变体）；
--   死亡时间取该医嘱 START_DATE_TIME，与 m.ANES_END_TIME 之差 <1 天（即 24 小时内）。
-- 分母按统计口径（入PACU）；探测另显示：2025 年全部麻醉患者中 24 小时内死亡 13 台（不限 PACU），
--   限定入PACU分母后为 0 台，口径冲突待确认。
-- HIS.ORDERS 为大表，附加绝对时间边界以满足只读校验并限制扫描范围。
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(m.START_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,

-- 分子=候选分母（阴道分娩产妇）中，同次住院 SM.MED_OPERATION_MASTER 存在椎管内麻醉方式
--   （椎管内/腰硬/硬膜外）的手术记录。
-- 证据与局限：探测显示候选分母 25 人次中仅 2 人次有手麻记录、椎管内麻醉 0 人次，
--   且手麻镜像 2025 年无任何「分娩/助产/无痛分娩/分娩镇痛」术式记录，
--   提示分娩镇痛未录入手麻系统，本候选分子预计为 0，真实数据应以麻醉科手工统计为准，待用户确认。
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(pv.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    pmi.INP_NO AS 住院号,
    pv.PATIENT_ID AS 患者ID,
    pmi.NAME AS 姓名,
    pv.VISIT_ID AS 住院次数,
    dd.DEPT_NAME AS 出院科室,
    pv.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME AS 入院时间,
    pv.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME AS 出院时间,
    (SELECT LISTAGG(d.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, '、') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.DIAGNOSIS_DESC)
     FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS d
     WHERE d.PATIENT_ID=pv.PATIENT_ID AND d.VISIT_ID=pv.VISIT_ID
       AND (d.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'O80%' OR d.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'O81%'
            OR d.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'O83%' OR d.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'O84%')
    ) AS 阴道分娩诊断,
    (SELECT LISTAGG(m.ANESTHESIA_METHOD, '、') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.ANESTHESIA_METHOD)
     FROM SM.MED_OPERATION_MASTER m
     WHERE m.PATIENT_ID=pv.PATIENT_ID AND m.VISIT_ID=pv.VISIT_ID
       AND (m.ANESTHESIA_METHOD LIKE '%椎管内%' OR m.ANESTHESIA_METHOD LIKE '%腰硬%' OR m.ANESTHESIA_METHOD LIKE '%硬膜外%')
    ) AS 椎管内麻醉方式
FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT pv
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON pmi.PATIENT_ID=pv.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd ON dd.DEPT_CODE=pv.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM
WHERE
    -- 分娩指标按出院时间归年。
    pv.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND pv.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
    -- 以下为本指标分子的正式条件：阴道分娩产妇且同次住院存在椎管内麻醉记录。
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS d
        WHERE d.PATIENT_ID=pv.PATIENT_ID AND d.VISIT_ID=pv.VISIT_ID
          AND (d.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'O80%' OR d.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'O81%'
               OR d.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'O83%' OR d.DIAGNOSIS_CODE LIKE 'O84%')
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM SM.MED_OPERATION_MASTER m
        WHERE m.PATIENT_ID=pv.PATIENT_ID AND m.VISIT_ID=pv.VISIT_ID
          AND (m.ANESTHESIA_METHOD LIKE '%椎管内%' OR m.ANESTHESIA_METHOD LIKE '%腰硬%' OR m.ANESTHESIA_METHOD LIKE '%硬膜外%')
    )

      (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_CODE FROM his.diagnosis ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 AND ds.PATIENT_ID = b.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = b.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO= 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) as 出院主要诊断编码,
      (SELECT ds.DIAGNOSIS_DESC FROM his.diagnosis ds WHERE ds.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = 3 AND ds.PATIENT_ID = b.PATIENT_ID AND ds.VISIT_ID = b.VISIT_ID AND ds.DIAGNOSIS_NO= 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) as 诊断名称,
      (SELECT OPERATION_CODE FROM  his.OPERATION OP WHERE OP.PATIENT_ID=b.PATIENT_ID AND OP.VISIT_ID=b.VISIT_ID AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) 第一位手术编码,
      (SELECT OPERATION_DESC FROM  his.OPERATION OP WHERE OP.PATIENT_ID=b.PATIENT_ID AND OP.VISIT_ID=b.VISIT_ID AND OP.OPERATION_NO = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1) 第一位手术名称,
      (select d.DEPT_NAME from his.dept_dict d where b.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO=d.DEPT_CODE) as 入院科室,
      (select d.DEPT_NAME from his.dept_dict d where b.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM=d.DEPT_CODE) as 出院科室,
       b.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME as 入院时间,
       b.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME as 出院时间,
       e.STRING_VALUE as 内容
from his.pat_visit b 
join his.pat_master_index c on b.patient_id =c.patient_id
join his.dept_dict e  on  b.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM=e.DEPT_CODE
join ydhl.INPATIENTS d  on b.PATIENT_ID||'_'||to_char(b.VISIT_ID) =d.PATIENT_ID

AND (b.DEPT_ADMISSION_TO IN ('040704','040709','040710','040701')  or e.DEPT_NAME like '妇产科%')

)t

sqls.sql_annotated:
SELECT a1.name     AS 患者姓名,
       a1.inp_no   AS 住院号,
       v.visit_id  AS 住院次,
       us.超声结论,
       us.检查时间,
       pa.病理结果
FROM his.pat_visit v
    JOIN his.pat_master_index a1 
        ON v.patient_id = a1.patient_id
    JOIN (
        SELECT b.patient_id,
               b.visit_id,
               DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c."OPSDiagnose", 2000, 1) AS 超声结论,
               b.EXAM_DATE_TIME                           AS 检查时间,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY b.patient_id, b.visit_id
                   ORDER BY b.EXAM_DATE_TIME ASC
               ) AS rn
        FROM his.exam_master b
            JOIN cs.BHosCheckUS c 
                ON b.exam_no = c.HISID1
        WHERE (DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c."OPSDiagnose", 2000, 1) LIKE '%乳腺%炎%'or DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(c."OPSDiagnose", 2000, 1) LIKE '%乳腺%结节%')
    ) us
        ON  v.patient_id = us.patient_id
        AND v.visit_id   = us.visit_id
        AND us.rn = 1
    JOIN (
        SELECT d.patient_id,
               d.visit_id,
               t1.ZDYJ AS 病理结果,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY d.patient_id, d.visit_id
                   ORDER BY d.test_no ASC
               ) AS rn
        FROM his.lab_test_master d
            JOIN bl.pitaya t1 
                ON d.test_no = t1.ReqNoteID
        WHERE (t1.ZDYJ LIKE '%乳腺%')
    ) pa
        ON  v.patient_id = pa.patient_id
        AND v.visit_id   = pa.visit_id
        AND pa.rn = 1
WHERE v.discharge_date_time >= TO_DATE('2021-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')
  AND v.discharge_date_time <  TO_DATE('2026-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd');

d.patient_id ID号，
e.name 姓名,
       d.item_code as 项目代码,
       d.item_name as 项目名称,
       d.billing_date_time 时间 ,
              d.amount as 数量,
              d.charges as 费用,
       c.class_name as 费用类别,
       (select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code = d.ordered_by) as 开单科室，
   '' AS 开单医生所在科室,
       '' AS 开单人,
       (select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code = d.performed_by) as 执行科室,

    '急诊转住院' AS 来源
       
  from inp_bill_detail d, reck_item_class_dict c,pat_master_index e 
 where d.outp_rcpt_no is not null and e.patient_id=d.patient_id
   and d.operator_no = '1111'
   and c.class_code = d.class_on_reckoning
   and d.billing_date_time >= to_date('20210101', 'yyyyMMdd')

SELECT
    to_char(b.visit_date, 'yyyy-MM') AS 月份,
    p.patient_id AS ID号,
    p.name AS 姓名,
    b.item_code AS 项目编码,
    b.item_name AS 项目名称,
    b.visit_date AS 时间,
    SUM(b.amount) AS 数量,
    SUM(b.costs) AS 金额,
    a.class_name AS 归属类别,
    d1.dept_name AS 开单科室,
    d2.dept_name AS 开单医生所在科室,
    s.name AS 开单人,
    d3.dept_name AS 执行科室,
    '' AS 执行人,
    '门诊' AS 来源
FROM
    reck_item_class_dict a
INNER JOIN outp_bill_items b
    ON a.class_code = b.class_on_reckoning
    inner join OUTP_RCPT_MASTER oo on oo.rcpt_no=b.RCPT_NO
INNER JOIN outp_order_desc c
    ON b.rcpt_no = c.rcpt_no
    AND b.visit_no = c.visit_no
    AND b.visit_date = c.visit_date
INNER JOIN pat_master_index p
    ON c.patient_id = p.patient_id
LEFT JOIN dept_dict d1
    ON b.ordered_by_dept = d1.dept_code  -- 开单科室
LEFT JOIN doctor_group dg
    ON b.ordered_by_doctor = dg.doctor_user
LEFT JOIN dept_dict d2
    ON dg.order_group = d2.dept_code     -- 开单医生所在科室
LEFT JOIN staff_dict s
    ON b.ordered_by_doctor = s.emp_no    -- 开单人
LEFT JOIN dept_dict d3
    ON b.performed_by = d3.dept_code    -- 执行科室
WHERE
    b.item_name LIKE '%心肺复苏%'
and b.visit_date >= TO_DATE('20210101', 'yyyyMMdd')
    AND b.visit_date < TO_DATE('20250101', 'yyyyMMdd')
 and    CHARGE_INDICATOR<>2
GROUP BY
    to_char(b.visit_date, 'yyyy-MM'),  -- 按月份分组（核心优化）
    p.patient_id,
    p.name,
    b.item_code,
    b.item_name,
    b.visit_date,
    a.class_name,
    d1.dept_name,
    d2.dept_name,
    s.name,
    d3.dept_name
ORDER BY
    月份, ID号, 时间

sqls.sql_annotated:
SELECT
    q.STAT_YEAR,
    COUNT(*) AS NUMERATOR
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        x.STAT_YEAR,
        x.PATIENT_ID,
        x.VISIT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pv.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME) AS STAT_YEAR,
            b.PATIENT_ID,
            b.VISIT_ID,
            b.ACTION,
            b.WARD_CODE AS TO_WARD_CODE,
            LAG(b.WARD_CODE) OVER (
                PARTITION BY b.PATIENT_ID, b.VISIT_ID
                ORDER BY b.LOG_DATE_TIME, b.BED_NO, b.ACTION
            ) AS FROM_WARD_CODE
        FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT pv
        JOIN INPADM.BED_TRANS_LOG b
          ON b.PATIENT_ID = pv.PATIENT_ID
         AND b.VISIT_ID = pv.VISIT_ID
        WHERE pv.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
          AND pv.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
          AND NVL(pv.PATIENT_CLASS, ' ') <> '1'
          AND b.LOG_DATE_TIME >= pv.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
          AND b.LOG_DATE_TIME <  pv.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME + 2
    ) x
    WHERE x.ACTION = '转入'
      AND x.FROM_WARD_CODE IS NOT NULL
      AND x.FROM_WARD_CODE <> x.TO_WARD_CODE
      AND x.FROM_WARD_CODE NOT IN (
          '0210', '021001H', '021002', '030325', '030327',
          '030422H', '030505', '030506H', '030610', '030611H'
      )
      AND x.TO_WARD_CODE NOT IN (
          '0210', '021001H', '021002', '030325', '030327',
          '030422H', '030505', '030506H', '030610', '030611H'
      )
) q
GROUP BY q.STAT_YEAR
ORDER BY q.STAT_YEAR

            LAG(b.WARD_CODE) OVER (
                PARTITION BY b.PATIENT_ID, b.VISIT_ID
                ORDER BY b.LOG_DATE_TIME, b.BED_NO, b.ACTION
            ) AS FROM_WARD_CODE
        FROM MEDREC.PAT_VISIT pv
        JOIN INPADM.BED_TRANS_LOG b
          ON b.PATIENT_ID = pv.PATIENT_ID
         AND b.VISIT_ID = pv.VISIT_ID
        WHERE pv.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
          AND pv.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'
          AND NVL(pv.PATIENT_CLASS, ' ') <> '1'
          AND b.LOG_DATE_TIME >= pv.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
          AND b.LOG_DATE_TIME <  pv.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME + 2
    ) x
    WHERE x.ACTION = '转入'
      AND x.FROM_WARD_CODE IS NOT NULL
      AND x.FROM_WARD_CODE <> x.TO_WARD_CODE
      AND x.FROM_WARD_CODE NOT IN (
          '0210', '021001H', '021002', '030325', '030327',
          '030422H', '030505', '030506H', '030610', '030611H'
      )
      AND x.TO_WARD_CODE NOT IN (
          '0210', '021001H', '021002', '030325', '030327',
          '030422H', '030505', '030506H', '030610', '030611H'
      )
) q
GROUP BY q.STAT_YEAR
ORDER BY q.STAT_YEAR

/* ============================================================
   R10 手术患者出院时一级护理患者数量——分子年度统计

   分子定义：
   有手术的住院患者中，出院前最后一条有效护理等级医嘱
   为“一级护理”或“Ⅰ级护理”的患者数量。

   统计粒度：
   一次住院计算1人次。
   ============================================================ */

SELECT
    TO_CHAR(x.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,
    COUNT(*) AS 分子

FROM (
    SELECT
        v.PATIENT_ID,
        v.VISIT_ID,
        v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME,
        o.ORDER_TEXT,
        o.START_DATE_TIME,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY v.PATIENT_ID, v.VISIT_ID
            ORDER BY
                o.START_DATE_TIME DESC,
                o.ROWID DESC
        ) AS RN

    FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v

    JOIN HIS.ORDERS o
      ON o.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
     AND o.VISIT_ID   = v.VISIT_ID

    WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'

      /* 住院期间存在手术记录 */
      AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM HIS.OPERATION_MASTER m
            WHERE m.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
              AND m.VISIT_ID   = v.VISIT_ID
          )

      /* 长期护理等级医嘱 */
      AND o.REPEAT_INDICATOR = 1
      AND o.ORDER_CLASS = 'H'

      /* 排除被取消的医嘱 */
      AND o.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL

      /* 必须是出院前开立的护理等级医嘱 */
      AND o.START_DATE_TIME IS NOT NULL
      AND o.START_DATE_TIME <= v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME

      /* 先提取所有护理等级 */
      AND REGEXP_LIKE(
            REGEXP_REPLACE(o.ORDER_TEXT, '[[:space:]]', ''),
            '^(特级护理|一级护理|二级护理|三级护理|Ⅰ级护理|Ⅱ级护理|Ⅲ级护理)([.。；;，,（(]|$)'
          )
) x

WHERE x.RN = 1

  /* 取最后一条后，再判断是否为一级护理 */
  AND REGEXP_LIKE(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(x.ORDER_TEXT, '[[:space:]]', ''),
        '^(一级护理|Ⅰ级护理)([.。；;，,（(]|$)'
      )

GROUP BY TO_CHAR(x.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy')
ORDER BY 年份;

sqls.sql_annotated:
/* ============================================================
   同一时间同一主刀医师 / 第一麻醉医师手术重叠率

   分母：
   同期有效住院患者手术总台次数。

   主刀医师分子：
   同一主刀医师的前一台手术尚未结束，
   又开始下一台手术的台次数。

   麻醉医师分子：
   仅取第一麻醉医师 ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR；
   同一第一麻醉医师的前一台手术尚未结束，
   又开始下一台手术的台次数。

   重叠示例：
   手术A：16:00—17:00
   手术B：16:30—18:00
   同一医师时，后开始的手术B计入分子1例。

   不重叠示例：
   手术A：16:00—17:00
   手术B：17:00—18:00
   首尾时间相等，不计重叠。

   手术台次：
   PATIENT_ID + VISIT_ID + OPER_ID。
   ============================================================ */

WITH staff_raw AS (
    /* 人员编号 */
    SELECT
        TRIM(u.USER_ID) AS RAW_VALUE,
        TRIM(u.USER_ID) AS PERSON_KEY
    FROM MEDCOMM.MED_HIS_USERS u
    WHERE u.USER_ID IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    /* 人员姓名 */
    SELECT
        TRIM(u.USER_NAME) AS RAW_VALUE,
        TRIM(u.USER_ID) AS PERSON_KEY
    FROM MEDCOMM.MED_HIS_USERS u
    WHERE u.USER_NAME IS NOT NULL
      AND u.USER_ID IS NOT NULL
),

staff_map AS (
    /*
       只保留能够唯一对应一个人员编号的值，
       避免同名医师被错误识别为同一个人。
    */
    SELECT
        RAW_VALUE,
        MIN(PERSON_KEY) AS PERSON_KEY
    FROM staff_raw
    WHERE RAW_VALUE IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY RAW_VALUE
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT PERSON_KEY) = 1
),

base_oper AS (
    SELECT
        TO_CHAR(m.START_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS STAT_YEAR,

        m.PATIENT_ID,
        m.VISIT_ID,
        m.OPER_ID,

        m.START_DATE_TIME,
        m.END_DATE_TIME,

        TRIM(m.SURGEON) AS SURGEON_RAW,

        /* 只取第一麻醉医师 */
        TRIM(m.ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR) AS ANES_RAW,

        m.PATIENT_ID
            || '|' || TO_CHAR(m.VISIT_ID)
            || '|' || TO_CHAR(m.OPER_ID) AS OPER_KEY

    FROM MEDSURGERY.MED_OPERATION_MASTER m

    WHERE m.START_DATE_TIME >= TO_DATE('2022-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')
      AND m.START_DATE_TIME <  TO_DATE('2026-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')

      /* 仅住院手术 */
      AND m.VISIT_ID > 0

      /* 手术时间必须完整有效 */
      AND m.START_DATE_TIME IS NOT NULL
      AND m.END_DATE_TIME IS NOT NULL
      AND m.END_DATE_TIME > m.START_DATE_TIME

      /* 正式手术状态 */
      AND m.OPER_STATUS >= 35

      /* 排除取消手术 */
      AND m.CANCEL_DATE_TIME IS NULL
),

surgeon_assign AS (
    SELECT
        b.STAT_YEAR,
        b.OPER_KEY,
        b.START_DATE_TIME,
        b.END_DATE_TIME,
        s.PERSON_KEY

    FROM base_oper b

    JOIN staff_map s
      ON s.RAW_VALUE = b.SURGEON_RAW

    WHERE b.SURGEON_RAW IS NOT NULL
),

anes_assign AS (
    SELECT
        b.STAT_YEAR,
        b.OPER_KEY,
        b.START_DATE_TIME,
        b.END_DATE_TIME,
        s.PERSON_KEY

    FROM base_oper b

    JOIN staff_map s
      ON s.RAW_VALUE = b.ANES_RAW

    WHERE b.ANES_RAW IS NOT NULL
),

surgeon_overlap AS (
    /*
       b代表后开始的手术，a代表先开始的手术。

       判断条件：
       1. 同一主刀医师；
       2. 不是同一手术台次；
       3. a早于b开始；
       4. b开始时a仍未结束。
    */
    SELECT DISTINCT
        b.STAT_YEAR,
        b.OPER_KEY

    FROM surgeon_assign b

    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM surgeon_assign a
        WHERE a.PERSON_KEY = b.PERSON_KEY
          AND a.OPER_KEY <> b.OPER_KEY

          AND (
                a.START_DATE_TIME < b.START_DATE_TIME

                OR (
                       a.START_DATE_TIME = b.START_DATE_TIME
                   AND a.OPER_KEY < b.OPER_KEY
                   )
              )

          /* 后一台开始时，前一台尚未结束 */
          AND b.START_DATE_TIME < a.END_DATE_TIME
    )
),

anes_overlap AS (
    /*
       第一麻醉医师重叠判断：
       b代表后开始的手术，a代表先开始的手术。
    */
    SELECT DISTINCT
        b.STAT_YEAR,
        b.OPER_KEY

    FROM anes_assign b

    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM anes_assign a
        WHERE a.PERSON_KEY = b.PERSON_KEY
          AND a.OPER_KEY <> b.OPER_KEY

          AND (
                a.START_DATE_TIME < b.START_DATE_TIME

                OR (
                       a.START_DATE_TIME = b.START_DATE_TIME
                   AND a.OPER_KEY < b.OPER_KEY
                   )
              )

          /* 后一台开始时，前一台尚未结束 */
          AND b.START_DATE_TIME < a.END_DATE_TIME
    )
),

denom AS (
    SELECT
        STAT_YEAR,
        COUNT(DISTINCT OPER_KEY) AS TOTAL_OPER_COUNT
    FROM base_oper
    GROUP BY STAT_YEAR
),

surgeon_num AS (
    SELECT
        STAT_YEAR,
        COUNT(DISTINCT OPER_KEY) AS SURGEON_OVERLAP_COUNT
    FROM surgeon_overlap
    GROUP BY STAT_YEAR
),

anes_num AS (
    SELECT
        STAT_YEAR,
        COUNT(DISTINCT OPER_KEY) AS ANES_OVERLAP_COUNT
    FROM anes_overlap
    GROUP BY STAT_YEAR
)

SELECT
    d.STAT_YEAR AS 年份,

    d.TOTAL_OPER_COUNT AS 同期住院患者手术总例数,

    NVL(s.SURGEON_OVERLAP_COUNT, 0)
        AS 同一主刀医师时间重叠手术例数,

    ROUND(
        NVL(s.SURGEON_OVERLAP_COUNT, 0)
        * 100
        / NULLIF(d.TOTAL_OPER_COUNT, 0),
        4
    ) AS 同一主刀医师时间重叠率,

    NVL(a.ANES_OVERLAP_COUNT, 0)
        AS 第一麻醉医师时间重叠手术例数,

    ROUND(
        NVL(a.ANES_OVERLAP_COUNT, 0)
        * 100
        / NULLIF(d.TOTAL_OPER_COUNT, 0),
        4
    ) AS 第一麻醉医师时间重叠率

FROM denom d

LEFT JOIN surgeon_num s
  ON s.STAT_YEAR = d.STAT_YEAR

LEFT JOIN anes_num a
  ON a.STAT_YEAR = d.STAT_YEAR

ORDER BY d.STAT_YEAR;

/* ============================================================
   四级手术并发症发生率 / 三级手术并发症发生率
   年度分子、分母、发生率合并统计

   手术台次：
   HIS.OPERATION_MASTER 每条记录代表一次手术台次；
   PATIENT_ID + VISIT_ID + OPER_ID 唯一表示一台手术。

   四级手术：
   手术台次关联的任一手术编码在 OPERATION_DICT 中
   OPERATION_SCALE = '四'。

   三级手术：
   手术台次关联的任一手术编码在 OPERATION_DICT 中
   OPERATION_SCALE = '三'；
   如果同一台次同时存在“四”和“三”，统一归入四级。

   并发症：
   同次住院出院诊断中存在指定手术并发症。
   ============================================================ */

SELECT
    x.年份,

    /* 四级手术 */
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 1 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS 四级手术分母,

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 1
             AND x.是否存在并发症 = 1
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS 四级并发症分子,

    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 1
                 AND x.是否存在并发症 = 1
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 1 THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            0
        ) * 100,
        2
    ) AS 四级手术并发症发生率,

    /* 三级手术：排除已归为四级的台次 */
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 0
             AND x.是否三级手术 = 1
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS 三级手术分母,

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 0
             AND x.是否三级手术 = 1
             AND x.是否存在并发症 = 1
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS 三级并发症分子,

    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 0
                 AND x.是否三级手术 = 1
                 AND x.是否存在并发症 = 1
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 0
                     AND x.是否三级手术 = 1
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            0
        ) * 100,
        2
    ) AS 三级手术并发症发生率

FROM (
    SELECT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,

        m.PATIENT_ID,
        m.VISIT_ID,
        m.OPER_ID,

        /* 同一手术台次任一术式为四级，即判定为四级手术 */
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN d.OPERATION_SCALE = '四' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS 是否四级手术,

        /* 同一手术台次任一术式为三级，即标记为三级 */
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN d.OPERATION_SCALE = '三' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS 是否三级手术,

        /* 同次住院是否存在手术并发症诊断 */
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS diag
                WHERE diag.PATIENT_ID = m.PATIENT_ID
                  AND diag.VISIT_ID   = m.VISIT_ID
                  AND diag.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE = '3'
                  AND (
                         INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '肺栓塞') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '深静脉血栓') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '脓毒症') > 0

                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '术后出血') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '手术后出血') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '出血或血肿') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '血肿') > 0

                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '伤口裂开') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '切口裂开') > 0

                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '呼吸衰竭') > 0

                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '生理紊乱') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '代谢紊乱') > 0

                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '手术部位感染') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '手术相关感染') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '操作相关感染') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '术后感染') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '切口感染') > 0

                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '异物遗留') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '异物残留') > 0

                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '麻醉并发症') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '麻醉意外') > 0

                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '肺部感染') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '肺机能不全') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '肺功能不全') > 0

                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '意外穿刺') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '意外撕裂') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '穿刺伤') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '撕裂伤') > 0

                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '急性肾衰竭') > 0
                      OR INSTR(NVL(diag.DIAGNOSIS_DESC, ' '), '急性肾功能衰竭') > 0
                      )
            )
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS 是否存在并发症

    FROM HIS.OPERATION_MASTER m

    JOIN HIS.PAT_VISIT v
      ON v.PATIENT_ID = m.PATIENT_ID
     AND v.VISIT_ID   = m.VISIT_ID

    JOIN HIS.OPERATION_NAME n
      ON n.PATIENT_ID = m.PATIENT_ID
     AND n.VISIT_ID   = m.VISIT_ID
     AND n.OPER_ID    = m.OPER_ID

    LEFT JOIN (
        /* 同一手术编码在字典存在多条时，只保留优先级最高的一条 */
        SELECT
            OPERATION_CODE,
            OPERATION_SCALE
        FROM (
            SELECT
                od.OPERATION_CODE,
                od.OPERATION_SCALE,

                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY od.OPERATION_CODE
                    ORDER BY
                        NVL(od.STOP_FLAG, 0),
                        NVL(od.APPROVED_INDICATOR, 0) DESC,
                        NVL(od.STD_INDICATOR, 0) DESC,
                        od.ROWID
                ) AS RN

            FROM HIS.OPERATION_DICT od
            WHERE od.OPERATION_CODE IS NOT NULL
        )
        WHERE RN = 1
    ) d
      ON d.OPERATION_CODE = n.OPERATION_CODE

    WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'

    GROUP BY
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy'),
        m.PATIENT_ID,
        m.VISIT_ID,
        m.OPER_ID
) x

/* 只保留三级或四级手术台次 */
WHERE x.是否四级手术 = 1
   OR x.是否三级手术 = 1

GROUP BY x.年份
ORDER BY x.年份;

/* ============================================================
   四级手术患者死亡率 / 三级手术患者死亡率
   年度分子、分母合并统计

   手术数据源：
   HIS.OPERATION_MASTER + HIS.OPERATION_NAME + HIS.OPERATION_DICT

   四级手术患者：
   同次住院任一手术台次的任一术式
   OPERATION_SCALE = '四'。

   三级手术患者：
   同次住院存在 OPERATION_SCALE = '三' 的手术，
   且该次住院不存在四级手术。

   死亡：
   PAT_VISIT.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION = '3'。

   统计粒度：
   PATIENT_ID + VISIT_ID，一次住院只计算一次。
   ============================================================ */

SELECT
    x.年份,

    /* 四级手术患者 */
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 1
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS 四级手术患者分母,

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 1
             AND x.是否死亡 = 1
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS 四级手术死亡分子,

    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 1
                 AND x.是否死亡 = 1
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 1
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            0
        ) * 100,
        2
    ) AS 四级手术患者死亡率,

    /* 三级手术患者，排除同次住院存在四级手术的患者 */
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 0
             AND x.是否三级手术 = 1
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS 三级手术患者分母,

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 0
             AND x.是否三级手术 = 1
             AND x.是否死亡 = 1
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS 三级手术死亡分子,

    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 0
                 AND x.是否三级手术 = 1
                 AND x.是否死亡 = 1
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN x.是否四级手术 = 0
                     AND x.是否三级手术 = 1
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            0
        ) * 100,
        2
    ) AS 三级手术患者死亡率

FROM (
    SELECT
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,

        m.PATIENT_ID,
        m.VISIT_ID,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN d.OPERATION_SCALE = '四'
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS 是否四级手术,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN d.OPERATION_SCALE = '三'
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS 是否三级手术,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN v.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION = '3'
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS 是否死亡

    FROM HIS.OPERATION_MASTER m

    JOIN HIS.PAT_VISIT v
      ON v.PATIENT_ID = m.PATIENT_ID
     AND v.VISIT_ID   = m.VISIT_ID

    JOIN HIS.OPERATION_NAME n
      ON n.PATIENT_ID = m.PATIENT_ID
     AND n.VISIT_ID   = m.VISIT_ID
     AND n.OPER_ID    = m.OPER_ID

    LEFT JOIN (
        /* 手术字典同一编码存在多条时只保留一条 */
        SELECT
            OPERATION_CODE,
            OPERATION_SCALE
        FROM (
            SELECT
                od.OPERATION_CODE,
                od.OPERATION_SCALE,

                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY od.OPERATION_CODE
                    ORDER BY
                        NVL(od.STOP_FLAG, 0),
                        NVL(od.APPROVED_INDICATOR, 0) DESC,
                        NVL(od.STD_INDICATOR, 0) DESC,
                        od.ROWID
                ) AS RN

            FROM HIS.OPERATION_DICT od
            WHERE od.OPERATION_CODE IS NOT NULL
        )
        WHERE RN = 1

    WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'

    GROUP BY
        TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy'),
        m.PATIENT_ID,
        m.VISIT_ID
) x

   OR x.是否三级手术 = 1

   分子：
   相关手术科室出院患者的手术台次数。

   分母：
   相关手术科室出院患者人次数。

   手术台次：
   HIS.OPERATION_MASTER
   PATIENT_ID + VISIT_ID + OPER_ID 一台手术统计一次。

   科室口径：
   按出院科室名称判断；
   同时纳入指定科室的下属分组及相似专业科室；
   排除护理单元、手术室、麻醉科等非临床出院科室。
   ============================================================ */

SELECT
    TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy') AS 年份,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT
        v.PATIENT_ID || '|' || TO_CHAR(v.VISIT_ID)
    ) AS 相关科室出院人次,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT
        CASE
            WHEN m.OPER_ID IS NOT NULL
            THEN m.PATIENT_ID
                 || '|' || TO_CHAR(m.VISIT_ID)
                 || '|' || TO_CHAR(m.OPER_ID)
        END
    ) AS 相关科室手术人次,

    ROUND(
        COUNT(
            DISTINCT
            CASE
                WHEN m.OPER_ID IS NOT NULL
                THEN m.PATIENT_ID
                     || '|' || TO_CHAR(m.VISIT_ID)
                     || '|' || TO_CHAR(m.OPER_ID)
            END
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            COUNT(
                DISTINCT
                v.PATIENT_ID || '|' || TO_CHAR(v.VISIT_ID)
            ),
            0
        ) * 100,
        2
    ) AS 手术人次占出院人次比例

FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT v

JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
  ON dd.DEPT_CODE = v.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM

LEFT JOIN HIS.OPERATION_MASTER m
  ON m.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID
 AND m.VISIT_ID   = v.VISIT_ID

WHERE v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2026-01-01'

  /* 排除护理单元及非临床手术相关科室 */
  AND INSTR(NVL(dd.DEPT_NAME, ' '), '护理单元') = 0
  AND INSTR(NVL(dd.DEPT_NAME, ' '), '手术室') = 0
  AND INSTR(NVL(dd.DEPT_NAME, ' '), '麻醉科') = 0
  AND INSTR(NVL(dd.DEPT_NAME, ' '), '产房') = 0

  AND (
        /* 耳外科相关 */
        dd.DEPT_NAME = '耳外科'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME = '耳神经侧颅底外科'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME = '耳整形外科'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME = '听觉植入科'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME = '临床听力学中心'

        /* 头颈、咽喉、鼻外科相关 */
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%头颈外科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%嗓音疾病科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%结构性鼻病科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%鼻-颅底肿瘤科%'

        /* 神经外科相关 */
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '神经外一科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '神经外二科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '神经外四科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME = '神经外科'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '神经外三科%'

        /* 心脏外科相关 */
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%结构性心脏病科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%心外科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%心外重症医学科%'

        /* 肝胆、胃肠及肛肠外科相关 */
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%肝胆外科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%肝胆外二科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%肝胆胰外科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%胃肠外科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%胃肠外二科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%肛肠科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%肛肠外科%'

        /* 脊柱、关节、创伤及骨科相关 */
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%脊柱外科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%关节外科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%创伤骨科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%骨外科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%骨科中心%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%手足外科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%手足显微外科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%运动医学%'

        /* 眼科及下属专业组 */
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME = '眼科'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '眼科（%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '眼科(%'

        /* 胸外科相关 */
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%胸外科%'

        /* 泌尿外科相关 */
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%泌尿微创科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%泌尿外科%'

        /* 口腔相关 */
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME = '口腔科'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%口腔颌面外科%'

        /* 血管外科 */
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%血管外科%'

        /* 烧伤整形 */
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%烧伤整形科%'
     OR dd.DEPT_NAME LIKE '%整形外科%'
      )

GROUP BY TO_CHAR(v.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy')
ORDER BY 年份;
